papers.title: Computing Weighted Set Covers with Heterogeneous Stochastic Oracles: Deadline-Constrained Token Complexity
papers.abstract: We study computation in which a probabilistic Turing machine (PTM) uses AI systems, abstracted as heterogeneous stochastic oracles (HSOs), to solve Weighted Set Cover. A pilot study shows that an LLM can outperform weighted greedy. HSOs differ in capabilities, response distributions, latencies, and token costs. We study how the PTM selects HSOs to obtain, by a deadline and with a required success probability, a full cover satisfying a prescribed weight threshold, and we analyze expected token cost. For queries requesting full covers, assuming independent call successes and uninformative failures, we characterize by linear programming the minimum expected token cost for every feasible success probability. An optimal policy randomizes over at most two preselected sequences of oracle batches. Among policies attaining maximum success probability, the expected cost reduction of two-batch selection relative to querying all oracles in one batch is nonnegative and submodular. We construct an FPTAS for near-optimal cost reduction under heterogeneous response-time bounds. Computing an optimal two-batch selection is NP-hard but admits a pseudopolynomial algorithm for positive integral expected token costs. For partial-cover responses, the PTM combines returned sets across batches and turns. Once their union covers the universe, it verifies total weight directly or obtains a guarantee from LP-dual tests on retained partial covers. We give one-turn probability, token-cost, and hardness results and adaptive token-cost bounds under per-batch assumptions. A constructed instance shows that residual-guided querying can reduce expected token cost by a factor linear in the number of possible residual subproblems.

translation.title: 利用异构随机预言机计算加权集合覆盖：截止期约束下的 token 复杂度
translation.abstract: 我们研究概率图灵机（PTM）利用 AI 系统（抽象为异构随机预言机，HSO）来求解加权集合覆盖（Weighted Set Cover）的计算问题。一项初步研究表明，LLM 的表现可以优于加权贪心算法。HSO 在能力、响应分布、延迟和 token 成本上各不相同。我们研究 PTM 如何选择 HSO，以在截止期之前、以要求的成功概率获得满足规定权重阈值的完整覆盖，并分析期望 token 成本。对于请求完整覆盖的查询，在假设调用成功相互独立且失败不提供信息的前提下，我们用线性规划刻画了每个可行成功概率下的最小期望 token 成本。最优策略在至多两个预选的预言机批次序列上进行随机化。在达到最大成功概率的策略中，两批次选择相对于单批次查询所有预言机的期望成本降低量是非负且次模的。我们构造了一个 FPTAS，在异构响应时间约束下获得近最优的成本降低。计算最优两批次选择是 NP 难的，但当期望 token 成本为正整数时存在伪多项式算法。对于部分覆盖响应，PTM 跨批次和轮次合并返回的集合；一旦其并集覆盖全集，它直接验证总权重，或通过对保留的部分覆盖进行 LP 对偶检验来获得保证。我们给出了单轮的概率、token 成本和难度结果，以及在每批次假设下的自适应 token 成本界。一个构造的实例表明，基于残差引导的查询可以将期望 token 成本降低一个与可能残差子问题数量呈线性关系的因子。
translation.brief: 研究概率图灵机如何在截止期和成功概率约束下选择异构随机预言机求解加权集合覆盖，并用线性规划、随机化策略和近似算法刻画最小期望 token 成本。

papers.title: BitPrefill: W1.58A4 Tensor-Core Acceleration for Compute-Bound LLM Prefill
papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces large language model (LLM) inference cost, yet implementations optimized for memory-bound decode can leave compute-bound prefill on BF16 tensor cores. This gap matters for input-heavy workloads, including long-context and multimodal applications, where prefill can account for a substantial fraction of inference latency. We propose a W1.58A4 operator that quantizes weights to ternary values and activations to 4-bit, while executing the linear projection on native INT4 general matrix multiply (GEMM) tensor cores, turning prefill from a full-precision matrix multiply into a low-bit one. We deploy the operator for BitNet-b1.58 on a single RTX 4090 and a Jetson Orin Nano edge device, and report GEMM-kernel latency, end-to-end LLMs prefill latency, and task accuracy against bf16 and BitNet/BitBLAS baselines. Our proposed kernel achieves ~1.42x acceleration compared to the original BF16 prefill phase, with negligible reduction on model accuracy.

translation.title: BitPrefill：面向计算受限 LLM Prefill 的 W1.58A4 张量核加速
translation.abstract: 低比特量化可以降低大语言模型（LLM）的推理成本，然而针对内存受限 decode 优化的实现可能使计算受限的 prefill 仍运行在 BF16 张量核上。这一差距对于输入密集型工作负载（包括长上下文和多模态应用）尤为重要，因为 prefill 可能占推理延迟的很大一部分。我们提出一种 W1.58A4 算子，将权重量化为三值、激活量化为 4 比特，同时在原生 INT4 通用矩阵乘（GEMM）张量核上执行线性投影，将 prefill 从全精度矩阵乘法转变为低比特矩阵乘法。我们在单张 RTX 4090 和 Jetson Orin Nano 边缘设备上为 BitNet-b1.58 部署该算子，并报告 GEMM 核延迟、端到端 LLM prefill 延迟以及相对 bf16 和 BitNet/BitBLAS 基线的任务准确率。我们提出的核相比原始 BF16 prefill 阶段实现约 1.42 倍加速，且模型准确率损失可忽略。
translation.brief: 针对计算受限的 LLM prefill 阶段，提出将权重三值化、激活 4 比特量化并在原生 INT4 GEMM 张量核上执行的 W1.58A4 算子来加速推理。

papers.title: Adding One More Agent: How AI Team Size and Formation Shape Productivity and Diversity in Human-AI Brainstorming Teams
papers.abstract: Generative AI has improved individual productivity, but whether adding a plurality of AI partners helps or hurts remains open. We crossed AI partnership (one versus two) with behavioral formation (calibrated to average human behavior versus customized by the participant) in a brainstorming experiment ($N$=168) with human-human dyads as reference. Two-AI rooms posted more ideas to the shared board, but human-authored ideas dropped substantially. With one AI partner, formation mattered: humans paired with an average-calibrated AI posted more than any other condition. With two, this effect vanished. Humans continued talking but converted fewer ideas into board posts. AI social talk predicted more human posts, while AI posting volume predicted fewer. AI presence increased global diversity of human-authored ideas, but only a second AI increased within-session differentiation. The number of AI partners and their formation can reshape what the human contributes; single-agent results do not generalize to multi-agent teams.

translation.title: 再多加一个智能体：AI 团队规模与组建方式如何影响人机头脑风暴团队的生产力与多样性
translation.abstract: 生成式 AI 提升了个人生产力，但增加多个 AI 伙伴究竟有益还是有害仍悬而未决。我们在一项头脑风暴实验（N=168）中将 AI 伙伴数量（一个 versus 两个）与行为组建方式（校准到平均人类行为 versus 由参与者定制）进行交叉设计，并以人-人二人组作为参照。双 AI 房间在共享看板上发布了更多想法，但人类创作的想法大幅减少。只有一个 AI 伙伴时，组建方式很重要：与平均校准 AI 配对的人类发布的想法多于任何其他条件。有两个 AI 时，这一效应消失。人类继续交谈，但将想法转化为看板帖子的比例下降。AI 的社交性谈话预测更多的人类发帖，而 AI 的发帖量预测更少的人类发帖。AI 的存在提高了人类创作想法的全局多样性，但只有第二个 AI 才增加了会话内的差异化。AI 伙伴的数量及其组建方式可以重塑人类的贡献；单智能体的结果不能推广到多智能体团队。
translation.brief: 通过头脑风暴实验考察 AI 伙伴数量（一个或两个）及其组建方式对人机团队创意产出数量与多样性的影响。

papers.title: How developers split roles among them and a coding agent and what "collaboration" means
papers.abstract: Background: Coding agents such as Claude Code become more and more competent, so that their role in the development process can grow. Objective: How do developers characterize the role-split between them and their agent? How would they ideally want to collaborate with their agent? Methods: We perform a 3-step, mixed-methods study. We apply qualitative open coding to 2025 early adopters' blog articles; perform a quantitative survey of 2026 practitioners; develop and apply a method for coding-agent-supported open coding of survey freetext responses. Results: The 2025 practitioners have the agent work in supporting roles only. Accountability was firmly human. In 2026, both are fundamentally still true. Gradually, however, the role-split is now different, with much more agent involvement. The developers' notion of collaboration has three facets: Predominantly a separation into human-only, agent-only, and collaborative work steps, with defined conditions and goals. Second, accommodating personal preferences without engineering justification. Third, a holistic view of collaboration covering the entire development process. Conclusions: Defining one's role relative to the agent will need to be a recurring activity. The different views on collaboration are likely a source of friction and conflict for teams; future work should find out how to cope with that.

translation.title: 开发者如何在自身与编码智能体之间划分角色，以及“协作”意味着什么
translation.abstract: 背景：像 Claude Code 这样的编码智能体能力日益增强，其在开发过程中的角色可以不断扩大。目标：开发者如何描述自己与智能体之间的角色分工？他们理想中希望如何与智能体协作？方法：我们开展了一项三步骤的混合方法研究。我们对 2025 年早期采用者的博客文章进行定性开放编码；对 2026 年从业者进行定量调查；开发并应用一种由编码智能体辅助的调查自由文本开放编码方法。结果：2025 年的从业者仅让智能体承担辅助角色。责任归属坚定地归于人类。到 2026 年，这两点在根本上仍然成立。然而，角色分工正在逐渐改变，智能体的参与程度大大提高。开发者对协作的理解包含三个方面：首先，主要是划分为仅人类、仅智能体和协作的工作步骤，并带有明确的条件和目标；其次，在没有工程依据的情况下迁就个人偏好；第三，一种覆盖整个开发过程的整体协作观。结论：定义自己相对于智能体的角色将需要成为一项经常性的活动。对协作的不同看法很可能是团队摩擦与冲突的来源；未来工作应研究如何应对这一问题。
translation.brief: 通过博客开放编码与从业者调查，研究开发者与编码智能体之间的角色分工方式及其对“协作”的理解。

papers.title: Federated KPI Aggregation with Local Privacy Constraints and Coordinated OLAP Roll-Ups
papers.abstract: Cross-organizational KPI analysis can require aggregated results from independently administered data warehouses without centralizing detailed records. To limit disclosure from small local groups, a site can require a minimum number of contributing records before releasing a KPI value for a group. If each site applies this rule independently, different local contributions may be suppressed and the combined KPI can become incomplete. This paper investigates whether OLAP granularity can be coordinated before local query results are released so that all sites satisfy their local minimum-cohort rules and contribute at the same analytical level. The proposed method selects the least-generalized common roll-up accepted by every site. Site agents coordinate current capabilities and approved local execution across independently administered sites, with privacy checks and aggregate computation remaining deterministic local functions. In a four-site prototype, coordinated roll-up retained all contributions and reproduced the corresponding centralized result, compared with 78.3% retained under independent suppression. A capability-change experiment showed fewer candidate checks and replies and no unsupported requests when current site-agent state was used. The results demonstrate the feasibility of federated KPI aggregation under local privacy constraints through coordinated granularity selection and agent-based coordination.

translation.title: 具有本地隐私约束与协调 OLAP 上卷的联邦 KPI 聚合
translation.abstract: 跨组织的 KPI 分析可能需要从独立管理的数据仓库获得聚合结果，而无需集中化详细记录。为限制来自小型本地群体的泄露风险，站点可以要求在发布某群体的 KPI 值之前满足最少贡献记录数。如果每个站点独立应用该规则，不同的本地贡献可能被抑制，导致合并后的 KPI 不完整。本文研究是否可以在本地查询结果发布之前协调 OLAP 粒度，使所有站点都满足其本地最小群体规则并在同一分析层级上贡献。所提方法选择每个站点都能接受的最少泛化的公共上卷层级。站点智能体在独立管理的站点之间协调当前能力与已批准的本地执行，隐私检查和聚合计算保持为确定性的本地函数。在一个四站点原型中，协调上卷保留了所有贡献并复现了相应的集中式结果，而独立抑制下仅保留 78.3%。一项能力变更实验表明，使用当前站点智能体状态时，候选检查与回复更少，且没有不受支持的请求。结果证明了通过协调粒度选择和基于智能体的协调，在本地隐私约束下实现联邦 KPI 聚合的可行性。
translation.brief: 提出在本地最小群体隐私约束下，通过站点智能体协调选择公共 OLAP 上卷粒度来实现跨组织联邦 KPI 聚合的方法。

papers.title: Coherence by Construction: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs and the Formal Limits of Coherence Validation
papers.abstract: Synthesizing relational training data such as knowledge graphs with a large language model typically emits structured objects one at a time, which keeps each object valid but leaves the relationships between them ungrounded. We study an alternative paradigm, generation by simulation: rather than describing a relational artifact, we simulate a process that produces it and take the artifact to be its causal record. Language-model agents propose intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model, so a relation is emitted only when the event it represents occurs, making coherence a property of construction. We instantiate the paradigm for cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs in the STIX 2.1 standard with three engines, among them an evolutionary engine applying language-model genetic operators to structured graph genomes, sharing a deterministic compiler that makes malformed and dangling output unrepresentable. We prove referential closure, causal grounding, and identifier stability, an ablation localizes each to the referee and world model rather than the policy, and two independent LLM judges reproduce the rubric's engine ranking. Our central result is cautionary, and we prove it: a validator reading any graph feature set a structure-matched random graph can reproduce is uninformative about coherence for a coherence-by-construction generator. Using Erdős-Rényi controls we realize the theorem four times, as structural separation, embedding transfer, inductive link prediction, and real-data augmentation each reward a triviality rather than coherence; we give the mechanism behind each and the conditions a valid benchmark must meet.

translation.title: 构造即一致：CTI知识图谱的合成与一致性验证的形式化极限
translation.abstract: 用大语言模型合成知识图谱等关系型训练数据时，通常逐个输出结构化对象，这保证了每个对象自身有效，却使对象之间的关系缺乏依据。我们研究另一种范式——通过仿真生成：不是描述一个关系型产物，而是仿真一个产生它的过程，并将该产物视为其因果记录。语言模型智能体提出意图，一个确定性裁判依据显式世界模型裁决结果，因此只有当某关系所代表的事件实际发生时才会输出该关系，使一致性成为构造过程的属性。我们在STIX 2.1标准的网络威胁情报（CTI）知识图谱上实例化该范式，构建了三个引擎，其中包括一个对结构化图基因组应用语言模型遗传算子的进化引擎，三者共享一个使畸形和悬空输出无法表示的确定性编译器。我们证明了引用封闭性、因果接地性和标识符稳定性，消融实验将每项性质定位于裁判与世界模型而非策略，且两个独立的LLM评审复现了评分标准下的引擎排名。我们的核心结果是一个警示性定理并加以证明：任何读取结构匹配随机图可复现的图特征的验证器，对于构造即一致生成器的一致性而言不具信息量。借助Erdős-Rényi对照，我们以四种方式实现该定理：结构分离、嵌入迁移、归纳式链接预测和真实数据增强各自奖励的是平凡性而非一致性；我们给出每种情形背后的机制以及有效基准必须满足的条件。
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM合成知识图谱时关系缺乏依据的问题，提出通过仿真生成范式（语言模型提意图、确定性裁判依世界模型裁决），并证明基于图特征的验证器对此类生成器的一致性验证无效。

papers.title: TOUMAII: A 4.5M-Pair Tool-Calling Preference Dataset and Its Source-Agnostic Generator
papers.abstract: To autonomously execute multi-step tasks, enterprise agents must reliably interact with tools, call APIs, or query databases, making tool-calling a fundamental capability of AI models. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) optimises for producing the correct call, but never contrasts it with a plausible incorrect one. In an environment where even a minor formatting error can invalidate a call and an incorrect decision can derail the interaction, direct preference optimisation (DPO) targets exactly this contrast. DPO, therefore, requires preference pairs rather than plain demonstrations. For tool-calling, such data, especially in realistic multi-turn settings, remains extremely scarce. To address this scarcity, we introduce TOUMAII, a large-scale tool-calling preference dataset containing ~4.5M validated preference pairs, derived from Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M (apache-2.0) conversations. The dataset consists of multi- and single-turn interactions and includes parallel and sequential function calls. Additionally, we release TOUMAII-Gen, a synthetic data generation pipeline that consumes tool-calling SFT datasets and generates a preference dataset with naturally occurring model-generated tool-calling failure modes. To validate the effectiveness of our DPO data, we fine-tune a 3-billion-parameter model, achieving performance parity with other high-quality tool-calling preference datasets. Furthermore, we release a second small preference dataset derived from ToolACE (apache-2.0), showcasing the source-agnostic nature of our pipeline. We release the complete code and datasets: this https URL and this https URL

translation.title: TOUMAII：450万对工具调用偏好数据集及其来源无关的生成器
translation.abstract: 为了自主执行多步任务，企业级智能体必须可靠地与工具交互、调用API或查询数据库，这使工具调用成为AI模型的基础能力。监督微调（SFT）只优化产生正确调用，却从不将其与看似合理的错误调用进行对比。在一个即使微小的格式错误也会使调用失效、错误决策会使交互脱轨的环境中，直接偏好优化（DPO）恰好针对这种对比。因此DPO需要偏好对而非普通示范。对于工具调用，这类数据——尤其是在真实的多轮设置下——仍然极为稀缺。为解决这一稀缺问题，我们提出TOUMAII，一个大规模工具调用偏好数据集，包含约450万条经验证的偏好对，源自Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M（apache-2.0）对话。该数据集由多轮和单轮交互组成，并包含并行和顺序函数调用。此外，我们发布了TOUMAII-Gen，一个合成数据生成流水线，它消费工具调用SFT数据集并生成包含自然出现的模型生成工具调用失败模式的偏好数据集。为验证DPO数据的有效性，我们微调了一个30亿参数的模型，达到了与其他高质量工具调用偏好数据集相当的性能。此外，我们还发布了第二个源自ToolACE（apache-2.0）的小型偏好数据集，展示了该流水线的来源无关性。我们发布了完整代码和数据集：this https URL 和 this https URL
translation.brief: 该论文解决工具调用DPO偏好数据稀缺的问题，构建了450万对的多轮工具调用偏好数据集，并提供可从任意SFT数据集生成偏好数据的来源无关流水线。

papers.title: Exploring Early Vulnerability Analysis via Automatic Identification of Vulnerability-Introducing Commits
papers.abstract: Developing effective vulnerability analysis techniques requires high-quality datasets that capture how vulnerabilities appear and evolve in real software codebase. Existing datasets, however, typically label as vulnerable only the code immediately preceding vulnerability-fixing commits (VFCs), overlooking the earlier versions in which vulnerabilities were first introduced and subsequently evolved. This practice limits both dataset coverage and our understanding of whether current detectors can identify vulnerabilities during their early, latent stages. In this paper, we present three manually annotated datasets of vulnerability-introducing commits (VICs) based on recent CVEs and widely used open-source projects. We further propose D-SZZ, a data state-aware VIC identification framework that analyzes security-fixing patterns and performs vulnerability scope slicing to recover the semantics implied by a fix. Experimental results demonstrate that D-SZZ outperforms existing SZZ and LLM-based baselines in identifying VICs. In addition, we evaluate six representative vulnerability detectors and find that models trained only on pre-VFC code struggle with original vulnerabilities, while incorporating early-stage samples improves detection performance. We also show that D-SZZ improves downstream vulnerable-version identification, and use it to uncover 16 inaccurate affected-version records in the NVD, all of which were officially confirmed and updated.

translation.title: 通过自动识别漏洞引入提交探索早期漏洞分析
translation.abstract: 开发有效的漏洞分析技术需要高质量的数据集，以刻画漏洞在真实软件代码库中如何出现和演化。然而，现有数据集通常仅将漏洞修复提交（VFC）紧邻之前的代码标记为易受攻击，忽略了漏洞最初被引入并随后演化的更早版本。这种做法既限制了数据集的覆盖范围，也限制了我们理解当前检测器能否在漏洞早期潜伏阶段识别漏洞。本文基于近期CVE和广泛使用的开源项目，提出了三个经人工标注的漏洞引入提交（VIC）数据集。我们进一步提出D-SZZ，一个数据状态感知的VIC识别框架，它分析安全修复模式并执行漏洞范围切片，以恢复修复所隐含的语义。实验结果表明，D-SZZ在识别VIC方面优于现有SZZ和基于LLM的基线。此外，我们评估了六个代表性漏洞检测器，发现仅在VFC前代码上训练的模型难以识别原始漏洞，而纳入早期样本可提升检测性能。我们还表明D-SZZ改进了下游的易受攻击版本识别，并用它发现了NVD中16条不准确的受影响版本记录，这些记录均已获官方确认并更新。
translation.brief: 该论文解决漏洞数据集只标注修复前代码、忽略漏洞引入阶段的问题，提出数据状态感知的D-SZZ框架自动识别漏洞引入提交并构建了三个人工标注数据集。

papers.title: A Metamaterial Agentic Swarm: Coordinated Search for Discrete Mechanical Design
papers.abstract: Designing discrete metamaterial assemblies is challenging because local unit-cell choices collectively determine the global elastic response. We present Metamaterial Agentic Swarm, an island-based portfolio of forty specialized numerical search agents for unit-cell selection in a pixel-resolved mechanical cloak. Five cooperating islands each contain eight agents responsible for global sampling, spatial proposals, mutation, learning, recombination, diversity, neighborhood exploration, and polishing. Islands maintain separate parents while exchanging evaluated assignments through an elite archive and recombination. The objective is the relative exterior displacement mismatch on a supplied observation mask. Candidate designs are scored by the mismatch in exterior displacement, computed with a symmetry-reduced finite-element model at full pixel resolution. Starting from random assignments within the supplied candidate libraries, the swarm achieves final displacement losses of 0.100590, 0.139274, and 0.135858 at a retrospectively selected reporting endpoint of 961 charged queries per run. Seed 0 achieved the lowest swarm loss, L=0.100590, which is 8.72% below the comparison threshold of 0.1102; the other two runs did not reach this threshold. While they do not establish comparative efficiency or causal benefits from coordination, the results represent a first step towards using agentic swarms for large discrete assembly problems.

translation.title: 超材料智能体集群：离散机械设计的协同搜索
translation.abstract: 设计离散超材料组件具有挑战性，因为局部单元胞的选择共同决定全局弹性响应。我们提出Metamaterial Agentic Swarm，一个基于岛屿的四十个专门化数值搜索智能体组合，用于像素化机械隐身斗篷中的单元胞选择。五个协作岛屿各含八个智能体，分别负责全局采样、空间提议、变异、学习、重组、多样性、邻域探索和打磨。各岛屿维护各自的父代，同时通过精英档案和重组交换已评估的分配方案。目标是在给定观测掩码上的相对外部位移失配。候选设计由外部位移失配评分，采用对称性约简的有限元模型在全像素分辨率下计算。从给定候选库内的随机分配出发，在回顾性选定的每次运行961次计费查询的报告终点处，集群达到最终位移损失0.100590、0.139274和0.135858。种子0取得最低集群损失L=0.100590，比对比阈值0.1102低8.72%；另外两次运行未达到该阈值。虽然这些结果并未确立协调的相对效率或因果收益，但它们代表了将智能体集群用于大规模离散组件问题的第一步。
translation.brief: 该论文解决离散超材料组件设计中单元胞选择的组合搜索问题，提出由四十个专门化搜索智能体组成的多岛屿协同集群，用有限元评估位移失配进行优化。

papers.title: SkillPrivus: Uncovering PRIVacy of USe Harms in Agentic Skills
papers.abstract: Agent skills extend AI assistants through installable instructions and code that can access users' files, accounts, and data. Even when performing their advertised tasks, skills may infer sensitive attributes, retain unnecessary information, or disclose data to unexpected recipients. We study these potential privacy-of-use harms through SkillPrivus, a static audit framework that analyzes skills before installation without executing them. SkillPrivus extracts data operations from code and natural-language instructions, grounds them in source evidence, and adapts Contextual Integrity to assess their appropriateness. Applied to 726 real skills from public marketplaces, 563 of which handle personal data, SkillPrivus flags at least one potential violation in 307 of these skills (54.5%), and its judgments agree with three blind human annotators on 83.2% of resolvable moves. The flagged behaviors include sensitive inferences, information use beyond the stated task, and disclosures to unexpected recipients, suggesting that privacy harms can arise from ordinary skill functionality.

translation.title: SkillPrivus：揭示智能体技能中的使用隐私危害
translation.abstract: 智能体技能通过可安装的指令和代码扩展AI助手，这些指令和代码可以访问用户的文件、账户和数据。即使在执行其宣称的任务时，技能也可能推断敏感属性、保留不必要的信息，或向意外的接收方披露数据。我们通过SkillPrivus研究这些潜在的使用隐私危害，这是一个静态审计框架，在安装前分析技能而不执行它们。SkillPrivus从代码和自然语言指令中提取数据操作，将其锚定于源证据，并改编情境完整性（Contextual Integrity）来评估其适当性。应用于来自公开市场的726个真实技能（其中563个处理个人数据），SkillPrivus在其中307个技能（54.5%）中标记出至少一个潜在违规，其判断与三位盲评人工标注者在83.2%的可判定动作上一致。被标记的行为包括敏感推断、超出所述任务的信息使用以及向意外接收方的披露，这表明隐私危害可能源于普通的技能功能。
translation.brief: 该论文解决智能体技能在正常功能中可能造成隐私危害的问题，提出安装前静态审计框架SkillPrivus，基于情境完整性评估技能数据操作的适当性。

papers.title: Know Your Context Bank: Repairing Inconsistency and Measuring Generalization in Context-Aware Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems increasingly rely on context banks: curated collections of example queries, metric definitions, and domain knowledge that tell a model how an organization writes its queries. In the enterprise, a bank grows over years as many analysts add entries, checked one at a time for correctness (does the SQL answer its own question?) and rarely for consistency with one another. Yet correctness is often loosely defined: a question seldom fixes how an entity is counted or which table defines it, so two entries can each pass review yet resolve the same decision in opposite ways. We call this condition context bank rot. A second question follows: does a system that uses a bank generalize from it, or only reproduce it? Existing benchmarks cannot tell, as they do not control how far a test question sits from the context. We answer both questions by comparing queries decision by decision, with a fast scorer distilled from human-calibrated LLM judges. Turned inward, the comparison diagnoses and repairs a bank. Fine-tuning on a cleaned BIRD-train bank beats a same-size random subset at every epoch (+2.6 points on average), and 92.4% of our removals had their SQL corrected by an independent expert audit, against 45.6% of audited entries. In-context examples that follow one convention beat those following the opposite one by 13.3 points, while a mix is barely better than none. Turned outward, the comparison generates test questions at a controlled distance from a bank, a pipeline we call CAT (Context-Aware Testing). On CAT-BIRD, for retrieval and fine-tuning alike, the benefit of a bank falls step by step with distance and is largely gone once about three quarters of a question's logic is new, and on CAT-Spider the benefit of retrieval likewise shrinks with distance.

papers.title: What Helps Language-Model Agents Review Violent Video? A Controlled Comparison with a Human Evidence Reference
papers.abstract: Systems that flag violent video for a human operator can now be built from language models without training, by combining perception models and letting a language model decide. We ask how the observations of the perception models should reach the decision, and which evidence matters. On the XD-Violence test set (799 clips) we fix one set of perception agents (video description, object detection, sound tagging, speech recognition and speech tagging) and one reasoning model, and compare three interfaces: messages between agents, a typed evidence graph explored with tools, and flat text read in one pass; and a single audio-visual model given the raw clip. Two annotators provide a human reference that records the decision, the incident segments and whether they relied on sight, sound or speech. Flat text matches the single model (F1 0.967 against 0.968), while the graph agent and message passing are less accurate; a variant of the graph agent developed on a separate set did not close the gap, and both graph summaries and multi-turn tool use lowered accuracy. These results hold with reworded prompts and with a larger reasoning model, except that the larger model weakens message passing enough for the graph agent to beat it. Sound events improve F1 by +0.012 [+0.004, +0.021], in line with the annotators, who used sound or speech on most violent clips. Citations of stored observations are faithful, changing about half of the decisions when removed, but no more so with the graph than with flat text, and the agent pipeline costs about 3 times the GPU time of the single model. We also report two artefacts of vision-language describers that mislead pipelines built on them.

papers.title: ChatAtom: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Molecular Dynamics Simulation and Visualization
papers.abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation resolves atomic-scale motion and predicts the structural, mechanical, and dynamic properties of materials, making it cen- tral to materials design and discovery. Yet an MD study requires an expert-driven workflow: designing the simulation, writing reliable input scripts, executing them, and analyzing the results with separate tools. Here we present ChatAtom, a multi-agent large language model system that translates a natural-language request into a complete MD workflow without the user writing input scripts or analysis code. Each agent has a defined responsibility within the workflow. An orchestrator plans the study; the LAMMPS and OVITO agents each use a generator-reviewer pair to prepare and review simulation and visualization scripts before execution; a high-performance computing agent dispatches jobs to remote resources; and an analysis agent interprets the completed run. The work- flow is accessible through a browser interface that streams thermodynamic data and rendered frames during local execution, allowing users to follow the simu- lation as it progresses. The architecture also supports new capabilities through loadable skills without modifying the agents, enabling autonomous hypothesis generation and testing. We evaluate ChatAtom through script-generation bench- marks, an end-to-end study of crack propagation, and a closed-loop campaign. By bringing script generation, execution, visualization, and analysis into one reviewed and observable pipeline, ChatAtom lowers the barrier to conducting MD studies and broadens access to advanced simulation workflows.

papers.title: Incentive Compatible Mechanisms for Sequential Fair Resource Allocation with Private Demands
papers.abstract: We study a strategic variant of the canonical online fair allocation problem, where a planner must sequentially allocate a divisible resource to agents with privately known demands. At each stage, the planner announces an allocation rule, the agent reports their demand, and the planner allocates resources according to the rule and the reported demand. Unlike the standard model, we allow agents to strategically misreport their needs, as can arise in nonprofit settings where demand is self-reported and monetary transfers are unavailable. We characterize the structure of incentive-compatible (IC) allocation rules in this model, and use this to identify conditions under which the optimal mechanism has a simple cap structure. We then develop an approximation method for the optimal IC mechanism through a careful reduction of the discretized dynamic program to a longest-path problem on a directed acyclic graph. Numerical experiments show that ignoring strategic reporting can be substantially more costly than imposing incentive compatibility.

papers.title: MedicalRSI: Medical Recursive Self-Improving Agents via Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution
papers.abstract: Medical agents built on large language models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly, yet most stay fixed once deployed and do not keep using their experience to improve later attempts. As a result, the same kind of error can recur across patients. To address this, existing self-improvement methods update an agent's weights or its medical harness from its own experience, but their improving strategy stays fixed and never learns which changes actually help, which caps how much the agent can improve. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) instead improves both the agent and its improving strategy. However, achieving RSI for medical agents is challenging, because clinical workflows rarely come with a reference harness, and a change that fixes early errors may not fix the problems the agent meets later. We propose MedicalRSI, an RSI framework built on Clinical Model-Harness Co-Evolution, in which one model plays two roles. The Solver is the medical agent itself, and the Improver is its learnable improving strategy, which writes a medical harness from the agent's failures. Each harness is rewarded by its gain over acting without it, and both roles are trained together, so the Improver keeps adapting to the problems the Solver has not yet solved. On multiple benchmarks and LLM backbones, MedicalRSI outperforms existing context-level and weight-level self-improvement methods and transfers well to unseen workflows, new LLMs and new databases, a step toward medical agents that keep improving.
