papers.title: Specification-Grounded Adaptive Triage and Formal Invariant Exclusion Synthesis for Autonomous Silicon Coverage Closure
papers.abstract: Closing the final 5%-15% of code and functional coverage remains a major schedule bottleneck in silicon tapeouts. Existing LLM-based coverage closure loops feed raw uncovered RTL lines or branches directly into iterative prompts, failing on industrial subsystems due to: (1) token and context explosion from querying thousands of correlated holes independently; (2) illegal stimulus that violates cross-signal invariants and yields dirty coverage; and (3) unsafe exclusion hallucination on structurally unreachable dead code. We present ARGUS (Autonomous Reachability & Guided Unified Stimulus), a specification-grounded, dual-regime coverage closure and formal exclusion synthesis engine. ARGUS mines microarchitectural specs and SystemVerilog Assertions into a formal Block Contract (C), then runs adaptive Macro-Clustering vs. Micro-Surgery triage gated by a per-module hole-density threshold (tau): dense modules collapse correlated holes into root-cause mode, FSM, and backpressure clusters, while sparse modules use AST and loop-domain reachability to separate reachable corners from provably unreachable invariants. Directed tests pair with bit-exact golden scoreboards, and unreachable invariants emit tool-native .el exclusions with formal proofs. Across five core benchmarks -- three open-source LowRISC OpenTitan IPs (uart_core, i2c_core, aes_cipher_core) and two commercial AI accelerator Tensor Layout Converter datapaths (53 SV modules, 376,127 coverage points) -- plus a 2,626-module industrial interconnect subsystem, ARGUS triages 2,626 modules in 0.265 s, cuts token usage by 27.2x to >180x, achieves zero dirty merges via 3-step sanity gating, and reaches 99.32%-100.0% effective coverage with 0 false exclusions across 21,071+ proven exclusions.

translation.title: 面向自主芯片覆盖率收敛的规格约束自适应分诊与形式化不变量排除综合
translation.abstract: 收敛最后5%-15%的代码与功能覆盖率仍是芯片流片的主要进度瓶颈。现有基于LLM的覆盖率收敛流程将原始未覆盖RTL行或分支直接送入迭代提示，在工业子系统中失败，原因在于：(1) 独立查询数千个相关洞导致token与上下文爆炸；(2) 违反跨信号不变量的非法激励产生脏覆盖；(3) 对结构性不可达死代码产生不安全的排除幻觉。我们提出ARGUS（Autonomous Reachability & Guided Unified Stimulus），一个基于规格约束的双模式覆盖率收敛与形式化排除综合引擎。ARGUS从微架构规格和SystemVerilog断言中挖掘出形式化的Block Contract（C），然后运行由每模块洞密度阈值（tau）门控的自适应Macro-Clustering与Micro-Surgery分诊：密集模块将相关洞折叠为根因模式、FSM和反压簇，稀疏模块使用AST和循环域可达性分析将可达角落与可证明不可达的不变量分离。定向测试与位精确的golden记分板配对，不可达不变量则附带形式化证明输出工具原生的.el排除文件。在五个核心基准——三个开源LowRISC OpenTitan IP（uart_core、i2c_core、aes_cipher_core）和两个商用AI加速器Tensor Layout Converter数据通路（53个SV模块、376,127个覆盖点）——以及一个2,626模块的工业互连子系统上，ARGUS在0.265秒内完成2,626个模块的分诊，token用量降低27.2倍至180倍以上，通过3步健全性门控实现零脏合并，在21,071个以上已证明的排除中实现零误排除，有效覆盖率达99.32%-100.0%。
translation.brief: 针对芯片覆盖率收敛中LLM方法的token爆炸、脏覆盖和不安全排除问题，提出基于规格的形式化Block Contract与按洞密度自适应分诊的覆盖率收敛及排除综合引擎ARGUS。

papers.title: Rethinking Full-Weight LoRA with Domain and Task Adapter Scaling for Question Answering over Portuguese Well Drilling Reports
papers.abstract: Adapting large language models (LLMs) to specialized domains remains challenging, particularly for technical documents such as Portuguese well drilling reports, where annotated data are scarce and domain adaptation may compromise instruction-following capabilities. Although Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is widely used for parameter-efficient adaptation, its scaling after training remains insufficiently explored. This study investigates the impact of LoRA adapter scaling on question answering over Portuguese drilling reports using Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B. Domain-adaptive pretraining (DAPT) is performed either directly on instruction-tuned models or on their base counterparts, with subsequent adapter transfer, while task-specific adapters are trained on WellQuest, an open-source question-answering dataset derived from Portuguese drilling reports. The two adapters are also combined using complementary weights. Scaling factors ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 are evaluated across multiple training checkpoints using BERTScore. Results show that fractional scaling consistently improves DAPT performance over full-weight application, increasing F1 from 68.8\% to 71.9\% for Qwen2.5-7B and from 63.2\% to 68.5\% for Llama-3.1-8B. QA adapters perform best at high but fractional weights, while base-to-instruct transfer yields better results than direct DAPT on instruct-tuned models. Adapter merging provides a modest improvement for Llama-3.1-8B. Overall, these findings demonstrate that post-training adapter scaling can improve domain adaptation without additional data or training.

translation.title: 重新思考全权重LoRA：面向葡萄牙语钻井报告问答的领域与任务适配器缩放
translation.abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）适配到专业领域仍然具有挑战性，尤其是葡萄牙语钻井报告等技术文档，其标注数据稀缺且领域适配可能损害指令遵循能力。尽管低秩适配（LoRA）被广泛用于参数高效适配，但其在训练后的缩放仍未被充分探索。本研究使用Qwen2.5-7B和Llama-3.1-8B，考察LoRA适配器缩放对葡萄牙语钻井报告问答的影响。领域自适应预训练（DAPT）或直接在指令微调模型上进行，或在其基座模型上进行后做适配器迁移，同时任务专用适配器在WellQuest——一个源自葡萄牙语钻井报告的开源问答数据集——上训练。两个适配器还通过互补权重进行组合。使用BERTScore在多个训练检查点上评估0.1到1.0的缩放因子。结果表明，分数缩放始终优于全权重应用，使Qwen2.5-7B的F1从68.8%提升到71.9%，Llama-3.1-8B从63.2%提升到68.5%。QA适配器在较高但非满权重时表现最佳，而基座到指令模型的迁移优于直接在指令微调模型上做DAPT。适配器合并对Llama-3.1-8B带来适度提升。总体而言，这些发现表明训练后适配器缩放可以在无需额外数据或训练的情况下改善领域适配。
translation.brief: 研究LoRA适配器训练后缩放对葡萄牙语钻井报告问答的影响，发现分数缩放（而非满权重）能提升领域适配性能。

papers.title: Explain Your Code: AI-Based Examination at Class Scale
papers.abstract: Generative AI has weakened the link between working code and a student's understanding of it. Oral examination, the traditional test of that understanding, does not scale to large courses. We report the full-course deployment of a three-agent AI system that examines students on their own code. The first, the examiner, asks three questions anchored to specific lines of the submission, adapting difficulty to each answer, in a 16-minute text dialogue. The other two grade: a code reviewer that never sees the examination and a grader without direct access to the code. Authorship is assessed separately and is advisory. The system examined 247 students in an operating systems course (three exercises, 546 sittings, two examination languages). The grader's oral score was uncorrelated with the same submission's code quality score (Spearman rho = -0.073, 95% CI [-0.205, 0.063], n = 216) yet tracked degree grade point average (rho = 0.419, [0.294, 0.523], n = 214), while automated test scores sat at the ceiling. The mean of a student's two oral scores correlated with grade point average at 0.468 ([0.353, 0.568], n = 210), within the range of grades in three single-semester courses built on programming assignments. Model spend averaged at most $1.37 per sitting. In surveys, students began skeptical of the AI examination and rated it more favorably after sitting it twice. These results indicate that examining students on their own code is feasible at class scale, and that its score relates to academic standing where the code quality score does not.

translation.title: 解释你的代码：班级规模的AI口试考核
translation.abstract: 生成式AI削弱了可运行代码与学生对其理解之间的联系。口试作为检验这种理解的传统方式，无法扩展到大型课程。我们报告了一个三智能体AI系统在全课程范围的部署，该系统就学生自己的代码对其进行考核。第一个智能体是考官，在16分钟的文本对话中围绕提交代码的具体代码行提出三个问题，并根据每个回答调整难度。另外两个智能体负责评分：一个从不接触考核过程的代码评审员，和一个无法直接访问代码的评分员。作者身份另行评估且仅作参考。该系统在操作系统课程中考核了247名学生（三次练习、546次考核、两种考核语言）。评分员的口试分数与同一提交的代码质量分数不相关（Spearman rho = -0.073，95% CI [-0.205, 0.063]，n = 216），但与学位绩点相关（rho = 0.419，[0.294, 0.523]，n = 214），而自动化测试分数已接近满分。学生两次口试分数的均值与绩点的相关性为0.468（[0.353, 0.568]，n = 210），处于三门以编程作业为基础的单学期课程成绩的相关范围内。每次考核的模型花费平均不超过1.37美元。调查显示，学生起初对AI考核持怀疑态度，在经历两次考核后评价更为正面。这些结果表明，就学生自己的代码进行考核在班级规模上是可行的，且其分数与学业水平相关，而代码质量分数则不然。
translation.brief: 针对生成式AI时代无法大规模口试检验学生代码理解的问题，部署三智能体AI考核系统，就学生自己的代码进行自适应提问与评分。

papers.title: CarrierKV: An Edge LLM Accelerator with Positional Carrier Decomposition for Low-Bit KV Cache
papers.abstract: Long-context decoding on edge devices is limited by DRAM, because every generated token reads the whole, growing KV cache. 4-bit block-scaled formats such as NVFP4 reduce this traffic but degrade accuracy: on Qwen3-4B, NVFP4 lowers 32K RULER (seven tasks) from 92.6 to 79.4, and a Hadamard rotation lowers it further to 57.7. We observe that most of the key energy is a positional carrier, one per-head vector that rotary position embedding (RoPE) rotates with position. In NVFP4, it sets the shared scale of most key blocks and lowers the signal-to-quantization-noise ratio of the content by about 5 dB, nearly one bit, yet it depends only on that vector and the position. We therefore introduce positional carrier decomposition, which removes the carrier before RoPE and stores only the content residual. We design a KV path that rotates and quantizes keys only after this removal and computes each attention score directly on the 4-bit code. We also design a positional phase engine that regenerates the carrier's score term for one key per cycle. At the same cache size as NVFP4, CarrierKV raises 32K RULER on Qwen3-4B from 79.4 to 91.1 and lowers the 32K PG19 perplexity increase of NVFP4 by 1.8 to 5.9 times on four models, outperforming SageAttention and P3-LLM on all four. Its loss also stays nearly flat as the cache grows, while that of NVFP4 rises. In a 22 nm FDSOI process at 600 MHz, CarrierKV's hardware increases the area of the NVFP4 accelerator by 2.9% and the energy of a 20K-token reasoning request on Qwen3-4B by 0.12% at the same decode latency. On Qwen3-4B at 32K, CarrierKV has a better RULER score than FP8 keys (91.1 against 89.3) and uses 13.7% less energy per token. The decomposition also lowers the 32K perplexity increase of 3-bit TurboQuant keys on Qwen3-4B from 69.7 to 0.76.

translation.title: CarrierKV：基于位置载波分解的低比特KV缓存边缘LLM加速器
translation.abstract: 边缘设备上的长上下文解码受DRAM限制，因为每个生成token都要读取整个不断增长的KV缓存。NVFP4等4-bit块缩放格式减少了流量但降低精度：在Qwen3-4B上，NVFP4使32K RULER（七项任务）从92.6降至79.4，Hadamard旋转使其进一步降至57.7。我们观察到大部分key能量是一个位置载波——每个头一个向量，由旋转位置编码（RoPE）随位置旋转。在NVFP4中，它决定了大多数key块的共享缩放因子，使内容的信噪比降低约5 dB（近一个比特），但它仅取决于该向量和位置。因此我们提出位置载波分解，在RoPE之前去除载波，仅存储内容残差。我们设计的KV通路在去除载波之后才对key进行旋转和量化，并直接在4-bit码上计算每个注意力分数。我们还设计了位置相位引擎，每周期为一个key重新生成载波的分数项。在与NVFP4相同缓存大小下，CarrierKV将Qwen3-4B的32K RULER从79.4提升到91.1，并将NVFP4在四个模型上的32K PG19困惑度增加降低1.8至5.9倍，在全部四个模型上优于SageAttention和P3-LLM。其损失随缓存增长几乎保持平稳，而NVFP4的损失则上升。在22 nm FDSOI工艺、600 MHz下，CarrierKV硬件使NVFP4加速器面积增加2.9%，使Qwen3-4B上20K token推理请求的能耗增加0.12%（解码延迟相同）。在Qwen3-4B的32K上下文中，CarrierKV的RULER分数优于FP8 key（91.1对89.3），且每token能耗降低13.7%。该分解还将Qwen3-4B上3-bit TurboQuant key的32K困惑度增加从69.7降至0.76。
translation.brief: 针对边缘设备长上下文解码中低比特KV缓存量化精度下降的问题，提出位置载波分解方法，在RoPE前去除位置载波仅存内容残差，并设计相应硬件加速器CarrierKV。

papers.title: LLMs Memorize Their Own Hallucinations During Post-Training
papers.abstract: Reasoning domains have shaped the post-training recipes of frontier models even though they are trained and deployed in domains beyond math and code. In this paper, we study the consequences of directly adopting reasoning-centric training recipes, e.g., the use of outcome-based rewards for reinforcement learning (RL), injection of "cognitive" behaviors such as proposing and backtracking from hypotheses in reasoning chains, etc., for knowledge tasks. We hypothesize that these decisions, while useful for reasoning, inadvertently encourage models to memorize hallucinations they themselves generate in their long reasoning chains when trained on knowledge tasks. To study this, we train models with standard post-training, extract their self-generated hallucinations during RL, and track memorization throughout the rest of training. Our experiments on six open models across two model families and two architectures confirm our hypothesis. We find that models' recall of hallucinations reinforced during training increases by 4.83% on average, compared to just 0.17% for self-hallucinations that receive no training signal. In fact, models even memorize false facts that they immediately retract in their reasoning; a backtracking template inherited from reasoning-centric training that has no benefit for knowledge recall. Furthermore, we find that memorization is strongest on the hardest training questions, and rewarding a hallucination makes the model less likely to abstain from it later (by 7.23% on average). Overall, our work identifies and systematically studies a previously unexamined pathway through which models learn hallucinations during training.

translation.title: LLM在后训练过程中记忆自己的幻觉
translation.abstract: 推理领域塑造了前沿模型的后训练配方，尽管这些模型在数学和代码之外的领域训练和部署。本文研究直接采用以推理为中心的训练配方（如强化学习（RL）中基于结果的奖励、在推理链中注入提出假设并回溯等"认知"行为）对知识任务的影响。我们假设这些决策虽然有利于推理，但在知识任务训练时会无意中促使模型记忆其在长推理链中自己生成的幻觉。为研究这一点，我们用标准后训练训练模型，在RL期间提取其自生成的幻觉，并在后续训练全程追踪记忆情况。在两个模型家族、两种架构的六个开源模型上的实验证实了我们的假设。我们发现模型对训练中被强化的幻觉的召回率平均提高4.83%，而未获得训练信号的自幻觉仅提高0.17%。事实上，模型甚至会记忆其在推理中立即撤回的错误事实——这是从以推理为中心的训练继承的回溯模板，对知识召回毫无益处。此外，我们发现记忆在最难的训练问题上最强，且奖励一个幻觉会使模型此后更不愿意放弃它（平均降低7.23%）。总体而言，我们的工作识别并系统研究了一条此前未被考察的、模型在训练中习得幻觉的路径。
translation.brief: 研究以推理为中心的后训练配方对知识任务的影响，发现RL中奖励模型自生成的幻觉会使其被记忆，从而揭示一条模型习得幻觉的新路径。

papers.title: Beyond Demographic Discrimination: Benchmarking Normative-Descriptive Calibration in LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, where they must distinguish between normative reasoning (what should happen) and descriptive reasoning (what is likely to happen). Most fairness benchmarks evaluate demographic discrimination under a single reasoning objective, and none we know of tests whether a model treats the same item differently when asked to describe an outcome versus decide one. We introduce normative--descriptive calibration, the extent to which a model's differentiation between matched candidates depends on whether it is asked to predict or to decide, and measure it with the Normative--Descriptive Calibration Benchmark (NDCB): 697 matched-pair scenarios across six domains, each posed under both framings, and three metrics, Normative Engagement Rate (NER), Normative Leakage Rate (NLR), and Normative--Descriptive Separation (NDS). Across six LLMs, NDS separates 13 of 15 model pairs, against 7 for BBQ accuracy and none for BOLD, although these counts also reflect each benchmark's sample size. Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.6 separate the framings most strongly (average NDS $= +0.55$ and $+0.52$, with overlapping confidence intervals), whereas GPT-5.5's average NDS is negative ($-0.14$) under the single-pick instruction and near zero ($+0.02$) without it. In a simplified prompt template, removing single trigger words never changes the sign of a model's average NDS but can shift it by up to 0.46 and reorder models. Reversing candidate order reveals a further effect: when forced to choose between identical candidates, all six models favor whichever is listed first, and once order is averaged out their demographic-aligned lean is toward the marginalized candidate. Describing disparities and prescribing them are separable behaviors that differ across models.

translation.title: 超越人口统计学歧视：对LLM规范-描述校准的基准测试
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署在具有社会影响的场景中，在这些场景中它们必须区分规范推理（应该发生什么）和描述推理（可能发生什么）。大多数公平性基准在单一推理目标下评估人口统计学歧视，而据我们所知，没有任何基准测试模型在被要求描述结果与被要求做出决定时，是否会对同一项目采取不同处理。我们提出了规范-描述校准（normative-descriptive calibration），即模型对匹配候选人的区分程度是否取决于它被要求预测还是决定，并通过规范-描述校准基准（NDCB）进行测量：该基准包含六个领域的697个匹配对场景，每个场景都以两种框架呈现，并配有三个指标：规范参与率（NER）、规范泄漏率（NLR）和规范-描述分离度（NDS）。在六个LLM上，NDS区分了15对模型中的13对，而BBQ准确率只区分了7对，BOLD则没有区分任何一对，尽管这些数字也反映了各基准的样本量差异。Claude Sonnet 4.6和Claude Opus 4.6对两种框架的区分最强（平均NDS分别为+0.55和+0.52，置信区间重叠），而GPT-5.5在单选指令下的平均NDS为负（-0.14），在没有该指令时接近零（+0.02）。在简化的提示模板中，删除单个触发词从不改变模型平均NDS的符号，但可使其偏移多达0.46并改变模型排序。反转候选人顺序揭示了另一个效应：当被迫在完全相同的候选人之间做出选择时，所有六个模型都偏向列表中排在前面的一位；而在平均掉顺序效应后，它们的人口统计学倾向偏向边缘化候选人。描述差异和规定差异是可分离的行为，且在不同模型之间存在差异。
translation.brief: 该论文提出规范-描述校准概念及NDCB基准，用于测量LLM在预测与决策两种框架下对相同候选人处理方式的不一致性。

papers.title: How Long Will My Language Model Run? A Benchmark for Pre-Execution Runtime Prediction
papers.abstract: Researchers submitting deep learning jobs to shared GPU clusters need runtime estimates to request time limits, choose hardware, and budget compute. Large language models (LLMs) offer a tempting shortcut: describe the job and ask. We introduce PreRun, a benchmark for predicting deep learning training and inference runtime from information available before execution. PreRun contains 801 training and 1,884 inference records of language and vision models collected on a GPU cluster, paired with workload configurations and explicitly defined timing targets. It also includes 64 text-generation configurations measured under standardized conditions, each in three separate program launches. We compare three LLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Claude Opus 5.5) with regression baselines and evaluate analytical estimates on a supported forward-pass subset. On 16 held-out generation configurations, the open-weight LLMs underestimate latency by 90-99% on average without examples. Claude's zero-shot mean absolute error is 4.5 times that of a Random Forest fit on 32 configurations. Five labeled examples substantially reduce Claude's generation error, but their benefit varies across timing targets. We will open-source our data and evaluation pipeline upon acceptance.

translation.title: 我的语言模型会运行多久？一个执行前运行时预测基准
translation.abstract: 向共享GPU集群提交深度学习任务的研究人员需要运行时间估计来申请时限、选择硬件和预算计算资源。大语言模型（LLM）提供了一条诱人的捷径：描述任务并直接询问。我们提出了PreRun，一个基于执行前可用信息预测深度学习训练和推理运行时间的基准。PreRun包含在GPU集群上收集的801条训练记录和1,884条推理记录，涵盖语言和视觉模型，并配有工作负载配置和明确定义的计时目标。它还包括在标准化条件下测量的64个文本生成配置，每个配置通过三次独立的程序启动进行测量。我们将三个LLM（Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-OSS-120B和Claude Opus 5.5）与回归基线进行比较，并在支持的前向传播子集上评估解析估计。在16个留出的生成配置上，开源权重LLM在没有示例的情况下平均低估延迟90-99%。Claude的零样本平均绝对误差是在32个配置上拟合的Random Forest的4.5倍。五个标注示例显著降低了Claude的生成误差，但其收益因计时目标而异。我们将在论文被接收后开源数据和评估流程。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了PreRun基准，利用执行前可得的配置信息预测深度学习训练与推理的运行时间，并评估LLM与回归基线的预测能力。

papers.title: Your Judge Inherits Your Prompt: In-Context Label Bias in an LLM-as-Judge Is Directional, Not Symmetric
papers.abstract: LLM-as-judge has become a standard way to score open-ended model outputs, yet the judge is itself a frozen language model steered by a few in-context examples, and such models are known to absorb the label balance of their demonstrations rather than treat them as neutral illustrations. We ask whether this label bias reaches an LLM judge used inside a multimodal (video question answering) evaluation pipeline, and what form it takes. Using a fully frozen generator-judge pipeline, we hold the generated answers fixed and vary only the Yes/No balance of the judge's few-shot examples across four demonstration sets. Each verdict is validated against a two-annotator human consensus on 200 examples per dataset. The judge's acceptance rate stays close to human consensus when its examples are balanced or skewed toward rejection, but jumps sharply (by about 30 points on NExT-QA and 20 on MSVD-QA, with a strongly one-sided error profile) when the examples are skewed toward acceptance; the opposite skew produces no matching drop. The bias is therefore one-directional within the tested range of label ratios. A separate five-draw analysis shows that results from a single example draw are unreliable, varying by up to 18 points, more than any difference between prompting conditions. We conclude that demonstration label bias in an LLM judge is a directional, inflation-only failure mode that can fabricate apparent benchmark gains but not losses, and that it is cheaply avoided by balancing the judge's examples and reporting results averaged over several draws.

translation.title: 你的评审继承了你的提示：LLM-as-Judge中的上下文标签偏差是方向性的而非对称的
translation.abstract: LLM-as-judge已成为对开放式模型输出进行评分的标准方式，然而评审者本身是一个由少量上下文示例引导的冻结语言模型，而此类模型已知会吸收其示例中的标签分布，而非将其视为中性示例。我们探究这种标签偏差是否会传导到多模态（视频问答）评估流程中使用的LLM评审，以及它以何种形式出现。使用完全冻结的生成器-评审流程，我们固定生成的答案，仅改变评审少样本示例中Yes/No的平衡，涵盖四个示例集。每个判定结果均与每数据集200个样本的双标注者人类共识进行验证。当评审示例平衡或偏向拒绝时，其接受率接近人类共识；但当示例偏向接受时，接受率急剧跳升（在NExT-QA上约30个点，在MSVD-QA上约20个点，且呈现强烈单侧的错误分布）；相反方向的偏斜并未产生相应的下降。因此，在测试的标签比例范围内，该偏差是单向的。一项独立的五次抽样分析表明，单次示例抽样的结果不可靠，波动可达18个点，超过任何提示条件之间的差异。我们得出结论：LLM评审中的示例标签偏差是一种方向性的、只会造成虚高的失效模式，可以伪造表面的基准提升但不能伪造下降；通过平衡评审示例并报告多次抽样的平均结果，可以低成本地避免这一问题。
translation.brief: 该论文发现LLM-as-judge的少样本示例标签偏差是单向的、只会虚高评分的失效模式，并建议通过平衡示例和多次抽样平均来规避。

papers.title: ProbeAgent: Principled Diagnosis of Agent Failures in Verifiable Environments
papers.abstract: Improving agents requires discovering where they fail and understanding why. An agent acts over multiple steps in a changing environment, so diagnosing its failures requires more than inspecting the final response of a large language model (LLM). The same unsuccessful outcome can arise from task difficulty or from an error the agent repeats across tasks. We introduce ProbeAgent, an automated framework that discovers agent failures, tests their proposed causes, and identifies shared failure modes. Starting from benchmark tasks, ProbeAgent builds executable tests and validates them using reference solutions, automated checks, and review of the task requirements. For each failed trajectory, it explains the error and constructs new tasks that preserve the suspected cause while changing the surrounding context. Running the agent on these tasks tests whether the same error recurs. ProbeAgent then groups failures with similar causes and generates descriptions that distinguish their errors. This process connects explanations of individual failures to executable tests and descriptions of shared failure modes. We evaluate ProbeAgent across 22 agent configurations using tasks from 10 benchmarks, collecting 1,244 failures and producing 536 failure-mode descriptions. These descriptions distinguish specific errors within broad outcomes such as incomplete work, including planning without acting and stopping before delivering a file. In human evaluation, annotators accept 90.0% of assigned descriptions and correctly reject 83.3% of similar alternatives, supporting the accuracy and specificity of the discovered failure modes.

translation.title: ProbeAgent：在可验证环境中对智能体失败的原则性诊断
translation.abstract: 改进智能体需要发现它们在哪里失败并理解原因。智能体在变化的环境中执行多步操作，因此诊断其失败不仅仅是检查大语言模型（LLM）的最终响应。同样的失败结果可能源于任务难度，也可能源于智能体在多个任务中重复出现的错误。我们提出ProbeAgent，一个自动化框架，用于发现智能体失败、检验其提出的原因并识别共享的失败模式。从基准任务出发，ProbeAgent构建可执行测试，并使用参考解、自动化检查和任务需求审查来验证它们。对于每条失败轨迹，它解释错误并构造保留疑似原因但改变周围上下文的新任务。在这些任务上运行智能体以测试相同错误是否复现。随后，ProbeAgent将具有相似原因的失败分组，并生成区分其错误的描述。这一过程将单个失败的解释与可执行测试和共享失败模式的描述联系起来。我们在10个基准的任务上评估了22个智能体配置，收集了1,244个失败并生成536个失败模式描述。这些描述能够区分宽泛结果中的具体错误，例如未完成工作中的“只规划不行动”和“在交付文件前停止”。在人类评估中，标注者接受了90.0%的分配描述，并正确拒绝了83.3%的相似替代描述，支持了所发现失败模式的准确性和特异性。
translation.brief: 该论文提出ProbeAgent框架，通过构建可执行的对照测试自动发现、验证并归类智能体的共享失败模式。

papers.title: Modeling Attributional Style at Scale: A Dataset and Analysis for Psychological Attribution Assessment and Reframing
papers.abstract: According to the reformulated Learned Helplessness theory, repeated exposure to uncontrollable negative events can foster a depressogenic attributional style, increasing susceptibility to depression yet remaining a tractable target for cognitive therapy. Computational research on attributional cognition, however, is hampered by the lack of large-scale datasets and robust evaluation protocols. In this work, we introduce the Attributional Style Transfer Dataset (ASTD) along with dedicated evaluation metrics, the first benchmark designed to model, assess, and reframe attributional explanations at scale. Constructed via a Prevent-Filter-Validate pipeline that integrates LLM-based generation with specialist validation, ASTD contains 42,000 real-world events paired with psychologically grounded attributions spanning seven styles. Using this dataset, we address two key challenges: (1) scalable assessment of attributional style via both supervised classifiers and zero/few-shot LLMs; and (2) attributional reframing and evaluation, where we propose automatic evaluation metrics to quantify psychological validity. Furthermore, we leverage our proposed metrics to construct a preference dataset, fine-tuning LLMs with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and achieving substantial gains in reframing quality. Together, our dataset, metrics, and methodology offer a new paradigm for understanding and modeling attributional style, with direct implications for scalable and adaptive mental health interventions. Code and data: this https URL

translation.title: 大规模建模归因风格：用于心理归因评估与重构的数据集及分析
translation.abstract: 根据修订后的习得性无助理论，反复暴露于不可控的负面事件会培养致抑郁的归因风格，增加抑郁易感性，但它仍是认知治疗可干预的靶点。然而，归因认知的计算研究受到缺乏大规模数据集和稳健评估协议的制约。在本工作中，我们提出了归因风格迁移数据集（ASTD）及专用评估指标，这是首个旨在大规模建模、评估和重构归因解释的基准。ASTD通过整合LLM生成与专家验证的Prevent-Filter-Validate流程构建，包含42,000个真实世界事件，并配有涵盖七种风格、具有心理学依据的归因。利用该数据集，我们解决了两个关键挑战：（1）通过监督分类器和零/少样本LLM实现归因风格的可扩展评估；（2）归因重构与评估，我们提出自动评估指标来量化心理学有效性。此外，我们利用所提出的指标构建偏好数据集，使用Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）微调LLM，在重构质量上取得了显著提升。我们的数据集、指标和方法共同为理解和建模归因风格提供了新范式，对可扩展和自适应的心理健康干预具有直接意义。代码和数据：this https URL
translation.brief: 该论文构建了首个大规模归因风格数据集ASTD及评估指标，实现归因风格的自动评估与基于DPO的重构优化。

papers.title: Perceive Once, Escalate on Demand: Handing Off Visual KV Memory from Small to Large VLMs
papers.abstract: An embodied agent cannot afford a large vision-language model (VLM) at every step of a long video, so a cascade runs a small VLM continuously and escalates only uncertain decisions to a large one. Each escalation, however, forces the large model to re-encode a history the small model has already perceived, and this dominates its cost. We present Baton, which hands the large model the small model's visual memory, its key-value (KV) cache over the history. Baton rests on one finding: the large model needs a usable memory, not a faithful copy of its own. A map trained to reproduce the large model's cache matches it most closely, yet brings no gain over the small model alone. Baton instead distills a per-layer linear map, without labels, from the large model's own answers, with the large model encoding only the current frame. Interventions on the map trace the gain to one direction, carried by the middle third of the large model's layers. On RoboMME, Baton beats the small model alone, a pruned or shortened re-watch, and a text memory; as the escalation channel of a cascade it matches re-watching to within about one point at 28-47% less compute, and 8x less per escalation at 64 frames. Its gain grows with the large model, from 8B to 32B, tracks the large model's headroom across eight model pairs from four families, and transfers zero-shot to OpenEQA.

translation.title: 一次感知，按需升级：将视觉 KV 记忆从小型 VLM 移交给大型 VLM
translation.abstract: 具身智能体无法在长视频的每一步都负担大型视觉语言模型（VLM），因此级联系统让小型 VLM 持续运行，仅将不确定的决策升级给大型模型。然而每次升级都迫使大模型重新编码小模型已经感知过的历史，这成为其主要开销。我们提出 Baton，将小模型的视觉记忆——即其对历史的键值（KV）缓存——移交给大模型。Baton 基于一个发现：大模型需要的是可用的记忆，而非对自身缓存的忠实复制。训练用于复现大模型缓存的映射与它最接近，却相比单独使用小模型没有增益。Baton 转而从大模型自身的答案中以无标签方式蒸馏出逐层线性映射，大模型只需编码当前帧。对该映射的干预将增益追溯到由大模型中间三分之一层承载的一个方向。在 RoboMME 上，Baton 优于单独使用小模型、剪枝或缩短的重看以及文本记忆；作为级联的升级通道，它在计算量减少 28-47% 的情况下与重看性能相差约一个点以内，在 64 帧时每次升级计算量减少 8 倍。其增益随大模型规模从 8B 到 32B 增长，在来自四个家族的八个模型对上追踪大模型的提升空间，并可零样本迁移到 OpenEQA。
translation.brief: 解决级联系统中大模型升级时重复编码历史的高开销问题，核心方法是将小模型的 KV 缓存通过无标签蒸馏的逐层线性映射移交给大模型复用。

papers.title: Budget-Aware Predict-and-Verify Theorem Proving with Heterogeneous LLM Solvers
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) theorem solvers differ in both proving capability and inference cost. Applying an expensive solver to every subgoal wastes computation when cheaper models are sufficient, while always starting from the cheapest solver wastes attempts on subgoals that require stronger models. We present BudgetPV, an agentic budget-aware predict-and-verify system that allocates computation across unresolved subgoals and heterogeneous LLM solvers. BudgetPV uses a cross-solver predictor to guide solver selection for each subgoal and revises the allocation as verification feedback becomes available. The allocation problem changes as proving progresses. Early decisions mainly determine which solver should handle an untried subgoal, while later decisions determine which previously attempted subgoals should receive additional computation. We train the predictor with two objectives for these two stages. Class-weighted cross-entropy improves assignment to less frequent stronger solvers during the initial stage, while plain cross-entropy provides better calibrated probabilities for later allocation among previously attempted subgoals. We evaluate BudgetPV on Lean Workbook, miniF2F, ProofNet, and PutnamBench using three progressively expanded solver settings: a strong but expensive solver alone, adding a medium-cost solver with intermediate solving capability, and further adding a cheap solver with lower solving capability. BudgetPV requires less LLM generation computation than uniform allocation to solve the same number of subgoals across the evaluated settings. The experiments further show the computation savings obtained as medium- and lower-cost solvers are added.

translation.title: 预算感知的预测-验证定理证明与异构 LLM 求解器
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）定理求解器在证明能力和推理成本上各不相同。对每个子目标都使用昂贵求解器会在便宜模型足够时浪费计算，而总是从最便宜的求解器开始又会在需要更强模型的子目标上浪费尝试。我们提出 BudgetPV，一个智能体式的预算感知预测-验证系统，在未解决子目标和异构 LLM 求解器之间分配计算。BudgetPV 使用跨求解器预测器为每个子目标指导求解器选择，并随验证反馈的可用而修正分配。分配问题随证明进程而变化：早期决策主要决定哪个求解器应处理未尝试的子目标，后期决策则决定哪些先前尝试过的子目标应获得额外计算。我们针对这两个阶段用两个目标训练预测器：类加权交叉熵在初始阶段改善对较少出现的更强求解器的分配，而普通交叉熵为后期在已尝试子目标间的分配提供更好校准的概率。我们在 Lean Workbook、miniF2F、ProofNet 和 PutnamBench 上用三种逐步扩展的求解器设置评估 BudgetPV：仅强而昂贵的求解器、加入中等成本求解器、再加入低成本求解器。在所有评估设置中，BudgetPV 解决相同数量子目标所需的 LLM 生成计算少于均匀分配。实验进一步展示了加入中低成本求解器后获得的计算节省。
translation.brief: 解决多求解器定理证明中计算分配不当的浪费问题，核心方法是用双目标训练的跨求解器预测器在子目标间进行预算感知的求解器选择与动态再分配。

papers.title: AstronautBench: Measuring Agent Self-Improvement Across Episodes Through Knowledge, Evidence, and Progress
papers.abstract: LLM agents are expected to improve themselves from their own experience across episodes, with fixed weights. Self-improvement in an embodied world cannot be read from one measure. Existing benchmarks measure task progress, world-knowledge question answering (QA), and episodic memory, but a correct answer does not show that the agent ever observed the evidence for it, and progress does not show what the agent learned. We introduce AstronautBench, which measures one agent's self-improvement through three views on the same run: what it knows, whether its own evidence supports that knowledge, and how far it gets in the world. It is built on the game Outer Wilds, where each episode is a 22-minute loop after which the world resets, only the agent's knowledge carries over, and progress is gated by knowledge. After every episode, we measure the places reached and ship-log rumor facts revealed, the correctness of answers to 164 questions about the world, and whether each answer is supported by the frames and position the agent cites from its own recorded play. Two LLM judges from different model families check every answer. In eight-episode baselines with GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 4 Argon planners, which act through a learned controller or their own gamepad inputs, the three views do not move together, so any one of them alone gives an incomplete picture of whether the agent is improving. The GPT-6.1 Sol agent's correct answers grow from 14.6% to 26.8% of all questions, but at episode 8 only 59 to 68% of them are supported by its cited evidence. It reveals no new rumor facts after episode 3, while the places it reaches and its memory keep growing. More than half of the answers that become correct after episode 3 cite only evidence from earlier episodes.

translation.title: AstronautBench：通过知识、证据与进展衡量智能体跨回合的自我改进
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体被期望在权重固定的情况下从自身经验中跨回合自我改进。具身世界中的自我改进无法从单一指标读出。现有基准衡量任务进展、世界知识问答（QA）和情景记忆，但正确答案并不能表明智能体曾观察到支持它的证据，进展也不能表明智能体学到了什么。我们提出 AstronautBench，通过同一运行中的三个视角衡量单个智能体的自我改进：它知道什么、其自身证据是否支持该知识、以及它在世界中走了多远。该基准构建于游戏 Outer Wilds 之上，每个回合是一个 22 分钟的循环，之后世界重置，只有智能体的知识得以延续，且进展由知识门控。每个回合结束后，我们衡量到达的地点和揭示的飞船日志传闻事实、对 164 个关于世界的问题回答的正确性，以及每个回答是否得到智能体从其录制游玩中引用的帧和位置的支持。来自不同模型家族的两个 LLM 评判者检查每个回答。在使用 GPT-6.1 Sol 和 Gemini 4 Argon 规划器（通过学习到的控制器或其自身手柄输入行动）的八回合基线中，三个视角并不同步变化，因此任何单一视角都无法完整刻画智能体是否在改进。GPT-6.1 Sol 智能体的正确回答从全部问题的 14.6% 增长到 26.8%，但在第 8 回合只有 59 至 68% 的回答得到其引用证据的支持。它在第 3 回合后未揭示新的传闻事实，而其到达的地点和记忆持续增长。第 3 回合后变为正确的回答中超过一半仅引用了更早回合的证据。
translation.brief: 解决现有基准无法全面衡量 LLM 智能体跨回合自我改进的问题，核心方法是基于 Outer Wilds 游戏构建从知识、证据支持和世界进展三个视角联合评估的基准。

papers.title: InfantConnect: integrating developmental brain atlases and electrophysiological network analysis
papers.abstract: The brains of infants change considerably during the first two years. Hence, developmental neuroimaging requires computational tools that account for age-related anatomy while supporting the analysis of electrophysiological data. For instance, cortical surfaces, electrode montages, tractography atlases, and electroencephalography (EEG) analysis utilities are commonly distributed across separate resources and software environments. Here we propose an open Python framework that brings these components into a shared three-dimensional workspace and supplements interactive visualization with command-line tools for EEG quality control, preprocessing, source-related visualization, and effective-connectivity analysis. The command line version can also be invoked by a model context protocol server to be used by artificial intelligence agents. The tool supports age-indexed cortical surfaces, infant scalp and skull templates, electrode locations, tractography, sensor-level connectomes, and directed estimates based on Granger causality and transfer entropy. We demonstrate the resource using representative anatomical visualizations and evaluate the effective-connectivity workflow on controlled toy networks with explicitly specified nodes and directed interactions. These tests provide targeted evidence about the connectivity workflow rather than a general validation of causal inference from clinical EEG. Performance benchmarks on low resolution electromagnetic tomography and validation of effective connectivity are provided.

translation.title: InfantConnect：整合发育脑图谱与电生理网络分析
translation.abstract: 婴儿大脑在出生后头两年变化显著。因此，发育神经影像学需要既考虑年龄相关解剖结构又支持电生理数据分析的计算工具。例如，皮层表面、电极排布、纤维追踪图谱和脑电图（EEG）分析工具通常分散在独立的资源和软件环境中。我们提出一个开源 Python 框架，将这些组件整合到共享的三维工作空间中，并以命令行工具补充交互式可视化，用于 EEG 质量控制、预处理、源相关可视化和有效连接分析。命令行版本还可由模型上下文协议服务器调用，供人工智能智能体使用。该工具支持按年龄索引的皮层表面、婴儿头皮和颅骨模板、电极位置、纤维追踪、传感器级连接组，以及基于 Granger 因果和传递熵的有向估计。我们用代表性的解剖可视化演示该资源，并在具有明确指定节点和有向交互的受控玩具网络上评估有效连接工作流。这些测试提供的是关于连接工作流的针对性证据，而非对临床 EEG 因果推断的一般性验证。文中还提供了低分辨率电磁断层成像的性能基准和有效连接的验证。
translation.brief: 解决婴儿发育神经影像工具分散、缺乏年龄适配解剖支持的问题，核心方法是构建整合脑图谱与 EEG 分析的开源 Python 框架。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Beyond Human-Crafted Experience for EDA Scripting
papers.abstract: The growing complexity of electronic systems demands efficient design flows, yet EDA scripting remains a bottleneck: proprietary APIs are sparsely documented, and errors often appear as silent failures or cryptic exceptions. Hand-crafted knowledge helps but is difficult to maintain as toolchains evolve. We present ZhuLong-SE (Self-Evolution), an execution-grounded LLM agent that learns reusable knowledge from prior task traces. Building on ZhuLong, it enhances the task-level harness with API retrieval, documentation responses, isolated sandbox execution, and static checking, then adds governed cross-task self-evolution. Beyond solving individual tasks, ZhuLong-SE distills past execution traces into a three-tier memory store governed by ground-truth anchoring, disconfirmation filtering, held-out rollback, and anti-leakage retrieval. On the 158-task EDA-Eval-PyAether benchmark, the full task-level harness, with self-evolution disabled, achieves 92.4% pass@1 and outperforms ZhuLong on all five tested LLM backbones. On a harder instance-disjoint test set, self-evolution from the bare configuration surpasses a human-crafted-experience baseline by 2.5 percentage points (80.0% vs. 77.5% pass@1).

translation.title: 面向 EDA 脚本编写的超越人工经验的自进化
translation.abstract: 电子系统日益复杂，对高效设计流程的需求不断增长，但 EDA 脚本编写仍是瓶颈：专有 API 文档稀少，错误常表现为静默失败或晦涩异常。人工整理的知识有所帮助，但随工具链演进难以维护。我们提出 ZhuLong-SE（自进化），一个以执行为基础、从先前任务轨迹中学习可复用知识的 LLM 智能体。它在 ZhuLong 基础上，通过 API 检索、文档响应、隔离沙箱执行和静态检查增强任务级工具框架，并加入受治理的跨任务自进化。除解决单个任务外，ZhuLong-SE 将过去的执行轨迹提炼为三层记忆库，由真值锚定、反证过滤、留出回滚和防泄漏检索进行治理。在 158 任务的 EDA-Eval-PyAether 基准上，禁用自进化的完整任务级框架达到 92.4% 的 pass@1，并在全部五个测试的 LLM 骨干上优于 ZhuLong。在更难的实例不相交测试集上，从裸配置出发的自进化比人工经验基线高出 2.5 个百分点（80.0% 对 77.5% pass@1）。
translation.brief: 解决 EDA 脚本编写中人工经验难以维护的问题，核心方法是构建以执行为基础的 LLM 智能体，通过治理的多层记忆库从任务轨迹中自进化学习。

papers.title: Multi-Tier Edge Triage: Optimizing Latency for Safe Clinical Agents
papers.abstract: Deploying generative AI agents in enterprise clinical workflows requires enforcing multi-dimensional safety and compliance policies--preventing HIPAA Protected Health Information (PHI) exposure, maintaining clinical scope-of-practice boundaries, ensuring patient-appropriate reading comprehension, and preserving brand integrity--under interactive latency constraints. Synchronous outbound calls to cloud Large Language Model (LLM) judges add substantial network and decoding overhead onto the critical response path. We present Multi-Tier Edge Triage, a safety screening architecture that co-locates a compact Tier-1 sequence classifier on the clinical agent's host server, resolving clear queries in-process without a network round-trip and escalating only ambiguous queries to a Tier-2 cloud LLM judge. To evaluate Tier-1 encoders without length or unigram shortcuts, we construct four length-matched contrastive twin benchmarks seeded from MedSafetyBench, ASQ-PHI, and a synthetic four-mandate clinical assistant policy (Generic HealthCorp). While frozen local encoders match cloud models on structured PHI detection (>= 98.3% accuracy in <= 23.5 ms), they degrade markedly on semantic safety and symmetric-blocklist prompts. However, end-to-end representation fine-tuning closes the multi-policy accuracy gap: a fine-tuned 335M-parameter BGE-Large classifier achieves 98.90% out-of-fold accuracy versus 99.20% for a zero-shot cloud LLM judge (exact McNemar p = 0.648, zero shared errors), 97.8%-98.2% recall, and a 0.0%-0.4% over-refusal rate in 39.0 ms (>14x faster than cloud LLM evaluation on our benchmark host). Per-policy error analysis reveals ceiling local recall on PHI (100.0%), brand (100.0%), and clinical scope (98.7%-99.3%) violations, isolating residual errors to reading-level checks (93.3%-95.3%) and motivating targeted multi-tier escalation.

translation.title: 多层边缘分诊：优化安全临床智能体的延迟
translation.abstract: 在企业的临床工作流中部署生成式 AI 智能体，需要在交互式延迟约束下执行多维度的安全与合规策略——防止 HIPAA 受保护健康信息（PHI）泄露、维持临床执业范围边界、确保适合患者的阅读理解水平，以及维护品牌完整性。对云端大语言模型（LLM）裁判的同步外呼会在关键响应路径上增加大量网络与解码开销。我们提出多层边缘分诊（Multi-Tier Edge Triage），一种安全筛查架构：在临床智能体的宿主服务器上部署一个紧凑的 Tier-1 序列分类器，对明确的查询在进程内直接处理而无需网络往返，仅将模糊查询升级到 Tier-2 云端 LLM 裁判。为了在没有长度或一元词捷径的情况下评估 Tier-1 编码器，我们基于 MedSafetyBench、ASQ-PHI 以及一个合成的四项任务临床助手策略（Generic HealthCorp）构建了四个长度匹配的对比孪生基准。虽然冻结的本地编码器在结构化 PHI 检测上可与云端模型媲美（准确率 ≥ 98.3%，延迟 ≤ 23.5 ms），但它们在语义安全和对称黑名单提示上明显退化。然而，端到端表示微调弥合了多策略准确率差距：一个微调后的 335M 参数 BGE-Large 分类器达到 98.90% 的折外准确率，而零样本云端 LLM 裁判为 99.20%（精确 McNemar p = 0.648，无共同错误），召回率为 97.8%–98.2%，过度拒绝率为 0.0%–0.4%，耗时 39.0 ms（在我们的基准主机上比云端 LLM 评估快 14 倍以上）。逐策略错误分析显示，本地模型在 PHI（100.0%）、品牌（100.0%）和临床执业范围（98.7%–99.3%）违规上达到召回率上限，将残余错误隔离在阅读水平检查上（93.3%–95.3%），从而为有针对性的多层升级提供了依据。
translation.brief: 解决临床AI智能体安全筛查的云端LLM延迟过高问题，采用本地小分类器处理明确查询、仅将模糊查询升级到云端LLM裁判的多层边缘分诊架构。

papers.title: Partially canonical axes in large language model representations
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) develop rich internal representations of language, but whether their individual coordinate axes carry meaning, or whether meaning is encoded only in directions in representation space, is still an open question. A common assumption is that individual axes in LLMs are arbitrary. We here challenge this view: across 12 LLMs from six model families, the native axes are reliably more aligned with other models' representations, with human brain responses to language, and with interpretable linguistic features than randomly rotated axes that preserve the same geometry. The native axes nonetheless fall well short of the best achievable alignment, so LLM coordinates are not fully arbitrary but also not fully canonical: they are partially canonical. A theory of how LLMs represent language must explain both the population geometry they learn and why individual units acquire patterns of response profiles that recur across systems.

translation.title: 大语言模型表示中的部分规范轴
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）发展出丰富的语言内部表示，但其单个坐标轴是否携带意义，还是意义仅编码在表示空间的方向中，仍是一个开放问题。一个常见的假设是 LLM 中的单个轴是任意的。我们在此挑战这一观点：在来自六个模型家族的 12 个 LLM 中，原生轴与随机旋转（保持相同几何结构）的轴相比，更可靠地与其他模型的表示、人类大脑对语言的响应以及可解释的语言特征对齐。然而，原生轴远未达到最佳可实现的对齐，因此 LLM 坐标并非完全任意，也不是完全规范的：它们是部分规范的。关于 LLM 如何表示语言的理论必须同时解释它们学习的群体几何结构，以及为什么单个单元会获得在不同系统中重复出现的响应模式。
translation.brief: 解决LLM单个坐标轴是否携带意义的问题，通过对比原生轴与随机旋转轴在跨模型对齐、脑响应和语言特征上的表现，发现轴是部分规范的。

papers.title: The Illusion of Evaluation: Challenges in Agentic Product Evaluation Practice
papers.abstract: Agentic products introduce risks that extend beyond those of their underlying models, arising from their tools, permissions, data access, safeguards, and operating conditions. Existing evaluation instruments provide useful evidence about model behavior and agents in defined harnesses, but their results do not necessarily transfer to deployed products or cover risks created by product configurations and interactions. Identifying and measuring such risks is especially difficult before deployment, when failure pathways, exposure, and outcome distributions may be poorly understood. This raises a fundamental question: what can evaluation evidence establish about the safety of a particular product, and what decisions can it legitimately support? We call the illusion of evaluation the appearance of safety assurance when producing an evaluation result is treated as sufficient evidence for claims that extend beyond what was measured. Drawing on practitioner experience, prior research, and twelve illustrative product contexts, we identify six methodological challenges spanning product-risk identification, ecological and measurement validity, metric interpretation, outcome verification, evidence transfer, and evidentiary sufficiency. We propose a granular transparency-and-decision-relevance record that makes risks, system configurations, assumptions, uncertainty, and evidentiary limits explicit. The proposal is a reporting and reasoning aid, not proof of safety or a deployment-approval standard. We conclude with open questions on valid product-level measurements, evidence transfer, and decision sufficiency.

translation.title: 评估的幻觉：智能体产品评估实践中的挑战
translation.abstract: 智能体产品带来的风险超出了其底层模型的风险，这些风险源于其工具、权限、数据访问、防护措施和运行条件。现有的评估工具为模型行为和定义好的测试框架中的智能体提供了有用的证据，但其结果不一定能迁移到已部署的产品上，也不一定涵盖由产品配置和交互产生的风险。在部署之前识别和衡量此类风险尤其困难，因为失败路径、暴露程度和结果分布可能都知之甚少。这引出了一个根本问题：评估证据能对特定产品的安全性确立什么，以及它能合法支持哪些决策？我们将评估的幻觉定义为：当把产生评估结果视为足以支持超出所测量范围的主张时，所呈现出的安全保证假象。基于从业者经验、先前研究和十二个示例性产品场景，我们识别出六个方法论挑战，涵盖产品风险识别、生态效度与测量效度、指标解释、结果验证、证据迁移和证据充分性。我们提出一种细粒度的透明度与决策相关性记录，使风险、系统配置、假设、不确定性和证据局限显式化。该提案是一种报告和推理辅助工具，而非安全证明或部署批准标准。最后，我们以关于有效的产品级测量、证据迁移和决策充分性的开放问题作结。
translation.brief: 解决智能体产品评估结果被误当作部署安全保证的问题，通过分析六个方法论挑战并提出透明度与决策相关性记录框架来明确证据的适用边界。

papers.title: Tokenize Moments, Not Frames: Tokenizer-Aware Budget Allocation for Training-Free Video LLM Acceleration
papers.abstract: Video large language models (LLMs) represent each video with thousands of visual tokens, and training-free accelerators that prune or merge these tokens lose accuracy on long videos. Analyzing frame similarity and the vision tokenizers of 16 open models, we trace this loss to a step before token selection. Under a token budget, the frames of a long video are sampled farther apart than the roughly 2 s over which frames remain similar. The two-frame 3D patches of models such as Qwen-VL then blend two unrelated scenes into each visual token, a double exposure that arises before any pruning or merging. Fixed-size tokenizers such as InternVL's avoid this blend but respond differently to the same reduction. We propose ESSENCE, a training-free method that tokenizes moments, segments within which frames remain similar, rather than frames. Before encoding, a closed-form rule uses the sampling interval and the tokenizer class to set the number of token grids and the dimension to reduce; visual tokens are then released from later LLM layers. Against five recent accelerators on Qwen3-VL, Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5, ESSENCE achieves higher accuracy in 58 of 60 comparisons at matched mean time to first token (TTFT). With 80% of the tokens, it matches the average accuracy of the full Qwen models at $1.6\times$ faster TTFT; on GLM-4.1V, it exceeds the full model by up to 3.4 points. Code is available at: this https URL.

translation.title: 对时刻而非帧进行分词：面向免训练视频LLM加速的分词器感知预算分配
translation.abstract: 视频大语言模型（LLM）用数千个视觉 token 表示每个视频，而对这些 token 进行剪枝或合并的免训练加速器在长视频上会损失准确率。通过分析 16 个开源模型的帧相似性和视觉分词器，我们将这一损失追溯到 token 选择之前的一个步骤。在 token 预算下，长视频的帧采样间隔大于帧保持相似的约 2 秒时间。Qwen-VL 等模型的两帧 3D patch 随后将两个不相关的场景混合到每个视觉 token 中——这种双重曝光在任何剪枝或合并之前就已产生。InternVL 等固定尺寸分词器避免了这种混合，但对同样的缩减反应不同。我们提出 ESSENCE，一种免训练方法，对时刻（帧保持相似的片段）而非帧进行分词。在编码之前，一个闭式规则利用采样间隔和分词器类别来设定 token 网格数量和降维维度；随后视觉 token 从后续的 LLM 层中释放。在 Qwen3-VL、Qwen2.5-VL 和 InternVL3.5 上与五个近期加速器对比，在匹配的平均首 token 时间（TTFT）下，ESSENCE 在 60 次比较中的 58 次取得更高准确率。仅用 80% 的 token，它以 1.6 倍更快的 TTFT 匹配完整 Qwen 模型的平均准确率；在 GLM-4.1V 上，它比完整模型高出最多 3.4 分。代码见：this https URL。
translation.brief: 解决视频LLM在token预算下因帧采样过疏导致视觉token混合无关场景而损失准确率的问题，提出按相似帧片段（时刻）而非帧进行分词并据此分配token预算的免训练加速方法ESSENCE。

papers.title: Self-similar Organization of Information in Language
papers.abstract: How much information relevant to predicting the future of a passage (i.e. predictive information) is carried by the preceding text, and how is this information distributed along that history? These questions are fundamental to understanding both the statistical structure of language and what large language models (LLMs) can learn about it. Indeed, LLMs trained to predict the next token in text must exploit this predictive information, so its organization determines how the structure of language becomes available to the model to learn. We develop a theory for the organization of predictive information based on the scaling behavior of a family of information measures, and the theory predicts that if this organization has the same form at all measured length scales -- i.e., it has a self-similar structure -- then the information measures evaluated at different lengths collapse onto a common form. We observe this scaling collapse in long text documents, showing that predictive information is present at every length scale we measure and has a self-similar structure. Self-similarity is a considerably stronger property than showing the existence of long-range dependencies, and it constrains the process generating the text. More broadly, our results give quantitative support to the empirical observation that conditioning on more distant text continues to reveal new structure in language to LLMs.

translation.title: 语言中信息的自相似组织
translation.abstract: 前文携带多少与预测文本未来（即预测信息）相关的信息，以及这些信息如何沿历史分布？这些问题对于理解语言的统计结构以及大语言模型（LLM）能从中学到什么都至关重要。事实上，训练用于预测文本下一个 token 的 LLM 必须利用这种预测信息，因此其组织方式决定了语言结构如何变得可供模型学习。我们基于一族信息度量的标度行为，发展了预测信息组织的理论，该理论预测：如果这种组织在所有测量的长度尺度上具有相同形式——即具有自相似结构——那么在不同长度上评估的信息度量将坍缩到一个共同形式上。我们在长文本文档中观察到这种标度坍缩，表明预测信息存在于我们测量的每个长度尺度上，并具有自相似结构。自相似性是比长程依赖的存在性强得多的性质，它约束了生成文本的过程。更广泛地说，我们的结果为以下经验观察提供了定量支持：以更远的文本为条件会持续向 LLM 揭示语言中的新结构。
translation.brief: 研究语言中预测信息如何沿文本历史分布的问题，通过信息度量的标度坍缩分析发现预测信息在所有长度尺度上具有自相似结构。

papers.title: SecretAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Privacy Protection against Vision Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can infer private information from shared images, including locations, personally identifiable information (PII), and personal attributes such as age and sex, even from medical images. Adversarial perturbations can protect such information against black-box VLMs, but existing methods overlook image quality and introduce visible artifacts into the images they protect. We present SecretAgent, the first general multi-agent framework that protects image privacy against VLMs while preserving visual fidelity. LLM agents iteratively locate the visual evidence that reveals private information and adapt an invisible perturbation to the target VLM's answers and to an appearance reviewer agent, which rejects any candidate with visible artifacts. We instantiate SecretAgent with two complementary variants: SecretAgent-Gradient optimizes the perturbation through six surrogate encoders for cross-model transferability, and the gradient-free SecretAgent-Tool composes procedural noise and achieves the best perceptual fidelity on three of the five datasets. Experiments on four privacy applications (geolocation, PII, facial, and medical) across five datasets and six VLMs show that SecretAgent preserves image quality substantially better than existing methods while achieving state-of-the-art privacy protection in every application, and that its protection transfers to other VLMs.

translation.title: SecretAgent：一种抵御视觉语言模型的隐私保护多智能体框架
translation.abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够从共享图像中推断隐私信息，包括位置、个人可识别信息（PII），以及年龄、性别等个人属性，甚至可以从医学图像中获取。对抗性扰动可以保护此类信息免受黑盒 VLM 的侵害，但现有方法忽略了图像质量，并在所保护的图像中引入可见的伪影。我们提出 SecretAgent，这是首个在保护图像隐私免受 VLM 侵害的同时保持视觉保真度的通用多智能体框架。LLM 智能体迭代地定位揭示隐私信息的视觉证据，并根据目标 VLM 的回答以及一个外观审查智能体（该智能体会拒绝任何带有可见伪影的候选方案）来调整不可见的扰动。我们用两个互补的变体实例化了 SecretAgent：SecretAgent-Gradient 通过六个代理编码器优化扰动以实现跨模型迁移性，而无梯度的 SecretAgent-Tool 组合程序化噪声，并在五个数据集中的三个上实现了最佳感知保真度。在五个数据集和六个 VLM 上针对四种隐私应用（地理定位、PII、面部和医疗）的实验表明，SecretAgent 在图像质量保持方面显著优于现有方法，同时在每个应用中都实现了最先进的隐私保护，并且其保护能力可迁移到其他 VLM。
translation.brief: 针对VLM从图像推断隐私信息的问题，提出多智能体框架SecretAgent，通过LLM智能体迭代定位隐私证据并生成兼顾隐私保护与视觉保真度的不可见扰动。

papers.title: Looking Right Is Not Being Right: Evaluating the Geometry of Agent-Built 3D Scenes
papers.abstract: Vision-language agents can reconstruct rooms from video as editable 3D scenes, but convincing renders do not establish geometric accuracy. We introduce a scan-referenced evaluation and use controlled experiments to study reconstruction accuracy, the role of geometric inputs, and agents' ability to verify and correct their scenes. Our geometric score measures surface, depth, and furniture placement agreement with laser scans of 30 real rooms on a 0-100 scale. The strongest tested agent, GPT-6 Astra, scores 51.4 from video alone, while a dense reconstruction from the same video scores 75.9. Given the point cloud used for that reconstruction, Astra produces an editable scene that scores within three points of it. Agents also inherit input errors: rescaling the supplied geometry changes scene scale almost proportionally. During revision, viewing renders improves appearance more consistently than geometry. Logs of their tool calls show that agents repeatedly measure their inputs but rarely compare them with the scenes they build. To provide this missing check, we introduce a geometric error report that compares each saved scene with the agent's input points and lists the largest discrepancies. Without new geometric evidence, the report raises the revision gains of GPT-6.1 Terra and Sol by 3.9 and 5.5 points over concurrent controls.

translation.title: 看得对不等于做得对：评估智能体构建的3D场景的几何精度
translation.abstract: 视觉语言智能体可以将视频重建为可编辑的 3D 场景，但令人信服的渲染效果并不能证明几何精度。我们引入了一种基于扫描参照的评估方法，并通过受控实验来研究重建精度、几何输入的作用，以及智能体验证和修正其场景的能力。我们的几何评分在 0-100 的量表上衡量表面、深度和家具摆放与 30 个真实房间激光扫描的一致性。测试中最强的智能体 GPT-6 Astra 仅凭视频得分为 51.4，而基于同一视频的稠密重建得分为 75.9。在给定用于该重建的点云时，Astra 生成的可编辑场景得分与其相差不到三分。智能体还会继承输入误差：对提供的几何进行缩放几乎会成比例地改变场景尺度。在修订过程中，查看渲染效果对外观的改善比对几何的改善更为一致。其工具调用日志显示，智能体反复测量其输入，但很少将其与所构建的场景进行比较。为了提供这一缺失的检查，我们引入了一种几何误差报告，将每个保存的场景与智能体的输入点进行比较，并列出最大的差异。在没有新的几何证据的情况下，该报告使 GPT-6.1 Terra 和 Sol 的修订收益比并发对照组分别提高了 3.9 和 5.5 分。
translation.brief: 针对视觉语言智能体重建3D场景缺乏几何精度评估的问题，提出基于激光扫描参照的几何评分与几何误差报告来量化和改进场景重建。

papers.title: Extracting Next Generation Access Control Policies from Natural Language Using LLMs: An Intermediate-Representation Approach with Back-Translation Verification
papers.abstract: Organizations write access-control rules in natural language, but NIST's Next Generation Access Control (NGAC) needs them as a formal policy graph. Large language models (LLMs) can automate this translation, but their output can break the format, add rules the text does not state, or drop conditions. We present NGAC-IR, which follows model-driven engineering (MDE). First, the LLM fills in an intermediate representation (IR), a JSON template that records who may, must or must not do what, on which resource and under which condition; a grammar keeps the output within this template. Second, a compiler that uses no LLM converts the IR into an NGAC policy graph and links each rule to its source sentence. Third, a back-translation check writes each rule in English and asks an LLM whether the source sentence states it. On four public datasets, all outputs could be compiled, compared with 95.5% without the grammar, and 95.7% were faithful to their sentence. NGAC-IR outperforms two published methods on all four datasets: the LLM-based Code4Policy in exact match and faithfulness, and the rule-based extractor of Abdelgawad et al. in rule type. The back-translation check sent 10.5% of sentences to human review and found 26 of the 31 errors. To test enforcement, we deployed the compiled policies in NIST's Policy Machine: they gave the expected decision for all 390 access requests, and the tested obligations were carried out. On one local server with open-weight models, all 714 sentences take about 20 minutes and 0.35 kWh, at zero API cost.

translation.title: 使用LLM从自然语言中提取下一代访问控制策略：一种带回译验证的中间表示方法
translation.abstract: 组织机构用自然语言编写访问控制规则，但 NIST 的下一代访问控制（NGAC）需要将其表示为形式化的策略图。大型语言模型（LLM）可以自动化这一转换，但其输出可能破坏格式、添加文本中未提及的规则，或遗漏条件。我们提出了遵循模型驱动工程（MDE）的 NGAC-IR。首先，LLM 填写一个中间表示（IR），即一个 JSON 模板，记录谁可以、必须或不得做什么，针对哪些资源以及在何种条件下；语法约束使输出保持在该模板内。其次，一个不使用 LLM 的编译器将 IR 转换为 NGAC 策略图，并将每条规则链接到其源句子。第三，回译检查将每条规则用英文写出，并询问 LLM 源句子是否表达了该规则。在四个公开数据集上，所有输出均可编译（相比之下，不使用语法时为 95.5%），且 95.7% 忠实于其句子。NGAC-IR 在所有四个数据集上均优于两种已发表的方法：在精确匹配和忠实度上优于基于 LLM 的 Code4Policy，在规则类型上优于 Abdelgawad 等人的基于规则的提取器。回译检查将 10.5% 的句子送交人工审查，并发现了 31 个错误中的 26 个。为测试执行效果，我们将编译后的策略部署在 NIST 的 Policy Machine 中：它们对全部 390 个访问请求给出了预期决策，且所测试的义务均被执行。在一台使用开放权重模型的本地服务器上，全部 714 个句子耗时约 20 分钟、耗电 0.35 kWh，API 成本为零。
translation.brief: 针对自然语言访问控制规则难以转换为NGAC形式化策略图的问题，提出NGAC-IR方法，通过LLM填充JSON中间表示、无LLM编译器转换及回译验证保证格式正确与忠实性。

papers.title: CodeReviewBench: An Automated Benchmark for Evaluating the Software Factory
papers.abstract: As AI agents ship more code with minimal human oversight, code review becomes the critical quality-control checkpoint -- but one without a reliable, objective verifier: review quality is nuanced and ultimately a judgment call by the PR author. Existing benchmarks are structurally misaligned with this: annotators are third-party reviewers, like the bots they evaluate, not the PR authors who actually decide what to fix. They also rely on small, static issue sets that require full re-evaluation as tools update, limiting how frequently progress can be tracked. We introduce CodeReviewBench, built on a fundamentally different signal: revealed developer preferences -- if a developer acts on a bot's suggestion, we treat it as useful; if they ignore it, we do not. This signal is mined daily from the public GitHub event stream, yielding 500K+ judged PRs across 18 tools, and refreshes continuously as tools evolve. We validate the developer preference against an independent offline benchmark: the two agree on precision rankings and independently detect the same product updates within days of vendor releases. Together, these form the benchmark.

translation.title: CodeReviewBench：用于评估软件工厂的自动化基准
translation.abstract: 随着 AI 智能体在极少人工监督下交付更多代码，代码审查成为关键的质量控制关卡——但这一关卡缺乏可靠、客观的验证者：审查质量是微妙的，最终取决于 PR 作者的判断。现有基准在结构上与此不匹配：标注者是第三方审查者，与他们所评估的机器人类似，而非真正决定修复什么的 PR 作者。它们还依赖于小型、静态的问题集，随着工具更新需要完全重新评估，限制了跟踪进展的频率。我们引入了 CodeReviewBench，它建立在一种根本不同的信号之上：显现的开发者偏好——如果开发者采纳了机器人的建议，我们认为它是有用的；如果他们忽略了它，则认为无用。这一信号每天从公开的 GitHub 事件流中挖掘，涵盖 18 个工具的 50 万个以上经过评判的 PR，并随着工具的演进持续刷新。我们对照一个独立的离线基准验证了开发者偏好：两者在精确率排名上一致，并在厂商发布后的几天内独立检测到相同的产品更新。这些共同构成了该基准。
translation.brief: 针对代码审查质量缺乏客观评估基准的问题，提出CodeReviewBench，通过从GitHub事件流挖掘开发者是否采纳建议的显现偏好信号来持续评估代码审查工具。

papers.title: Learning Video Foresight Reasoning from Unlabeled Videos via On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: Video foresight reasoning requires vision-language models to anticipate future events or next actions from currently observed videos. Existing methods fit future captions, rationales, or full visual states, but face two limitations. First, they rely on annotations or external large models for supervision, limiting scalability. We address this with an on-policy self-distillation framework that turns past-future video pairs into a natural self-supervised signal without extra annotations or LLM supervision. Second, they treat the whole future clip as equally valuable, although most of it is irrelevant context information. We address this by defining a foresight score, from which we obtain a contrastive privilege advantage that drives the model to learn the most valuable future information. Since the score is intractable, we optimize a tractable lower-bound surrogate that interpolates this advantage, computed between the true and a random reference future, with a teacher-student distillation advantage; together, they amplify decision-relevant content information and suppress irrelevant context information. We call the resulting framework Future-OPSD. On open-ended prediction and closed-ended planning, Future-OPSD improves base models by up to 14.2 and 15.9 points without compromising general video understanding. Code will be available at this https URL

translation.title: 通过在线策略自蒸馏从无标注视频学习视频前瞻推理
translation.abstract: 视频前瞻推理要求视觉语言模型从当前观察到的视频预测未来事件或下一步动作。现有方法拟合未来的字幕、推理依据或完整视觉状态，但面临两个局限。首先，它们依赖标注或外部大模型进行监督，限制了可扩展性。我们通过一个在线策略自蒸馏框架解决这一问题，该框架将过去-未来视频对转化为自然的自监督信号，无需额外标注或 LLM 监督。其次，它们将整个未来片段视为同等重要，尽管其中大部分是不相关的上下文信息。我们通过定义一个前瞻分数来解决这一问题，由此得到一个对比特权优势，驱动模型学习最有价值的未来信息。由于该分数难以直接计算，我们优化一个可计算的代理下界，该下界在真实未来与随机参考未来之间计算的这一优势与师生蒸馏优势之间进行插值；二者共同放大与决策相关的内容信息并抑制不相关的上下文信息。我们将所得框架称为 Future-OPSD。在开放式预测和封闭式规划任务上，Future-OPSD 在不损害通用视频理解能力的前提下，将基础模型分别提升多达 14.2 和 15.9 分。代码将发布于此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对视频前瞻推理依赖标注监督且未来片段中无关信息过多的问题，提出Future-OPSD在线策略自蒸馏框架，利用前瞻分数构造对比特权优势来学习最有价值的未来信息。

papers.title: Tracking and Limiting Unsupported Claim Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Provenance-Aware Framework
papers.abstract: This research examines how unsupported claims change as they move through multi-agent pipelines. It also examines whether preserving provenance can reduce these changes. We test both homogeneous and heterogeneous pipelines. Homogeneous pipelines use the same model across agents, while heterogeneous pipelines use different models. We compare the baseline with a provenance-aware framework. The framework passes each claim with its support status, source, evidence and transmission history. No new evidence is introduced during transmission. We measure changes in claim meaning, unsupported detail accretion, semantic drift, and provenance preservation. These metrics show whether the framework limits unsupported changes as claims pass between agents.

translation.title: 追踪与限制多智能体LLM系统中无支撑主张的传播：一个溯源感知框架
translation.abstract: 本研究考察无支撑主张在多智能体流水线中传播时如何变化，以及保留溯源信息能否减少这些变化。我们测试了同构与异构流水线：同构流水线在各智能体间使用相同模型，异构流水线使用不同模型。我们将基线与溯源感知框架进行对比。该框架在传递每条主张时附带其支持状态、来源、证据和传输历史。传输过程中不引入新证据。我们测量主张含义的变化、无支撑细节的累积、语义漂移以及溯源保留情况。这些指标显示该框架能否在主张于智能体间传递时限制无支撑的变化。
translation.brief: 研究无支撑主张在多智能体LLM流水线中的传播失真问题，提出在传递主张时附带支持状态、来源、证据与传输历史的溯源感知框架来限制无支撑变化。

papers.title: Beyond Prompt Heuristics: Assessing Child Safety Alignment in LLMs
papers.abstract: Child-safety taxonomies typically characterize safety risks through a predefined set of harm categories, and existing evaluations largely operationalize these categories using prompts that explicitly invoke them. However, child-safety considerations can also arise in seemingly benign requests that lack recognizable harm-category cues. We therefore investigate how child-safety alignment generalizes to such settings. Across six models, we find considerably higher misalignment rates on requests without recognizable harm-category cues than on those containing such cues (80.0, 54.0, and 48.4 percentage-point gaps for Qwen3.5-27B, GPT-5.4-mini, and Claude-Haiku-4.5, respectively). Through controlled behavioral and mechanistic analyses, we find that introducing a single harm-associated word reduces misalignment across most models, with mechanistic evidence suggesting that child-safety reasoning may rely in part on lexical and semantic associations with words in the prompt. Our findings motivate evaluations that treat child safety as context-dependent, and not reducible to a fixed set of harm categories.

translation.title: 超越提示启发式：评估LLM的儿童安全对齐
translation.abstract: 儿童安全分类体系通常通过预定义的伤害类别来刻画安全风险，现有评估大多通过显式调用这些类别的提示来实现。然而，儿童安全考量也可能出现在缺乏可识别伤害类别线索的看似无害的请求中。因此，我们研究儿童安全对齐如何泛化到这类场景。在六个模型上，我们发现对不含可识别伤害类别线索的请求，失准率显著高于含此类线索的请求（Qwen3.5-27B、GPT-5.4-mini和Claude-Haiku-4.5的差距分别为80.0、54.0和48.4个百分点）。通过受控的行为与机制分析，我们发现引入单个伤害相关词汇即可降低大多数模型的失准率，机制层面的证据表明儿童安全推理可能部分依赖于与提示中词汇的词汇和语义关联。我们的发现促使评估将儿童安全视为依赖上下文的，而非可归结为固定伤害类别集合的问题。
translation.brief: 发现LLM儿童安全对齐在缺乏显式伤害类别线索的请求上大幅失效，通过行为与机制分析揭示其依赖与提示词汇的语义关联。

papers.title: Keep the Process, Change the Supplier: Runtime Governance for Tool-Using AI Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-using AI agents propose actions whose authorization and external effects cannot be inferred from generated text alone. We study an execution boundary that separates agent proposals from business-controlled authority, context disclosure, and supplier selection. The Open Process Control Plane (OPCP) mediates capability calls and records uncertain outcomes when a supplier may have acted without returning an acceptable reply. We evaluate this runtime with scripted requests and synthetic suppliers: 2,400 fault episodes across four policies, 60 process-termination/restart episodes, 19,000 timed calls across 19 configurations, five targeted mutations over 43 fixtures, and 160 substitution records. No language model or autonomous agent is evaluated. OPCP and a conservative composition agree on all measured fault outcomes. Both recover after definite refusal without cross-supplier duplication; retry-all duplicates effects in every tested lost-reply-after-commit case. Persistent runtime state prevents cross-supplier replay in the restart experiments, while same-supplier duplicate prevention also requires supplier idempotency. At 128 suppliers, best-score routing has a median latency of 1.411 ms versus 0.261 ms for pinned routing. All five selected mutations are detected, and record enumeration exposes acceptance of an empty regression set. These results characterize an execution mechanism relevant to agent governance, including its costs and assumption boundaries. They do not establish improved agent task success, prompt-injection resistance, or real-vendor model portability.

translation.title: 保留流程，更换供应商：面向工具使用型AI智能体的运行时治理
translation.abstract: 工具使用型AI智能体提出的动作，其授权与外部效果无法仅从生成文本推断。我们研究一种执行边界，将智能体提案与业务控制的授权、上下文披露和供应商选择分离。开放流程控制平面（OPCP）中介能力调用，并在供应商可能已执行但未返回可接受回复时记录不确定结果。我们用脚本化请求和合成供应商评估该运行时：四种策略下2,400个故障事件、60个流程终止/重启事件、19种配置下19,000次计时调用、43个测试装置上的五次定向变异，以及160条替换记录。未评估任何语言模型或自主智能体。OPCP与保守组合在所有测得的故障结果上一致。两者在明确拒绝后均能恢复且不产生跨供应商重复；在所有测试的提交后丢失回复场景中，全部重试策略都会造成效果重复。在重启实验中，持久化运行时状态阻止了跨供应商重放，而同供应商重复防止还需供应商幂等性。在128个供应商时，最优评分路由的中位延迟为1.411毫秒，而固定路由为0.261毫秒。所有五次选定变异均被检测到，记录枚举暴露了对空回归集的接受。这些结果刻画了一种与智能体治理相关的执行机制，包括其成本和假设边界。它们并未证明能提升智能体任务成功率、抗提示注入能力或真实供应商间的模型可移植性。
translation.brief: 针对工具使用型智能体的授权与外部效果治理问题，提出将智能体提案与业务控制分离的开放流程控制平面（OPCP）执行边界机制。

papers.title: Right Numbers, Wrong Story: When LLMs Narrate Financial Changes Beyond Their Inputs
papers.abstract: A financial report drafted by an LLM can state every number correctly but still go beyond its input, adding judgments and causes that no one supplied. We call these additions unsupported framing and find them far more often in LLM drafts than in reports written by proInput facts Revenue +3% Higher prices 10-K filings Revenue increased 3% on higher prices. 10-K writer Revenue surged 3% on higher prices, due to strong demand. LLM Fits the size? Surged: Unusual for 3% In the input? In the input? Strong demand: Not in input Higher prices: Kept fessionals, and attempts to fix them by prompting with how each word is used instead make such judgments more frequent. We therefore propose FrameCheck, a plug-in that sits beFrameCheck Revenue increased 3% on higher prices. No extra model call Judgment word Unsupported cause Supported cause tween the LLM and human review to keep each draft within its input. Specifically, FrameCheck 1) guides the draft with professional examples that report a change of similar magnitude, 2) flags judgments that professionals would not use and causes the input does not give, and 3) removes them by rule, without a model call. In experiments on 17 open LLMs and 3M drafts, FrameCheck removes almost all unsupported framing from drafts and brings the judgment rate close to that of the writers of 10-K filings, the annual reports that US firms file with regulators. Code is available at this http URL.

translation.title: 数字正确，叙事失实：当LLM在输入之外叙述财务变化时
translation.abstract: 由LLM起草的财务报告可能每个数字都正确，却仍然超出其输入，添加无人提供的判断和原因。我们将这些添加称为无支撑框架，发现它们在LLM草稿中远比专业人士撰写的报告常见，而试图通过提示每个词的用法来修复反而使此类判断更频繁。因此我们提出FrameCheck，一个位于LLM与人工审核之间的插件，使每份草稿不超出其输入。具体而言，FrameCheck 1）用报告相似幅度变化的专业示例引导草稿，2）标记专业人士不会使用的判断以及输入未给出的原因，3）通过规则将其移除，无需模型调用。在17个开源LLM和300万份草稿的实验中，FrameCheck几乎移除了草稿中所有无支撑框架，并将判断率降至接近美国公司向监管机构提交的年度报告（10-K）撰写者的水平。代码见此 http URL。
translation.brief: 针对LLM财务报告草稿中添加输入之外判断与原因的无支撑框架问题，提出FrameCheck插件，通过专业示例引导与规则移除使草稿不超出输入。

papers.title: Run One, Get Two: Near-Free Streaming Safety Checks for Local LLMs
papers.abstract: Local LLM assistants decode for one user at a time, so decoding is bound by memory bandwidth and leaves compute idle. Streaming safety checks today trade accuracy against cost. A dedicated guard model is accurate but nearly doubles the latency per token, while a hidden-state probe is cheap but less accurate. We present ToRA, an adapter that runs a second model as an extra row in the generator's decode step, sharing its weights and KV cache. Dual-row kernels read each weight once for both rows. On Qwen3-0.6B, ToRA matches or beats a dedicated streaming guard, with higher F1 on 12 of 17 benchmarks. It detects 11.8 points more unsafe responses than the probe at a similar cost, under 4% added latency per token.

translation.title: 跑一次得两个：面向本地LLM的近零成本流式安全检查
translation.abstract: 本地LLM助手一次只为一个用户解码，因此解码受内存带宽限制，计算资源闲置。当前的流式安全检查在准确性与成本之间权衡：专用守卫模型准确但几乎使每token延迟翻倍，而隐状态探针便宜但准确性较低。我们提出ToRA，一种适配器，将第二个模型作为生成器解码步骤中的额外一行运行，共享其权重和KV缓存。双行内核对两行只读取每个权重一次。在Qwen3-0.6B上，ToRA达到或超过专用流式守卫，在17个基准中的12个上F1更高。它以相似成本比探针多检测出11.8个百分点的不安全响应，每token增加延迟低于4%。
translation.brief: 针对本地LLM流式安全检查在准确性与成本间的权衡问题，提出ToRA适配器，将守卫模型作为解码步骤的额外一行与生成器共享权重和KV缓存，实现近零成本的安全检查。

papers.title: MixFold: Sub-4-Bit Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Output-Channel Grouping on Mobile NPUs
papers.abstract: Sub-4-bit quantization allows mobile devices to run larger LLMs, but its memory savings do not always translate into faster decoding on mobile NPUs. Their matrix units support only a few native integer datatypes, and converting unsupported weight formats on the vector unit can erase the gains from fewer bits. Mixed precision faces an additional constraint: each matrix-unit tile uses one datatype. MixFold executes 3-bit and perfectly symmetric 2-bit weights using native integer operations without expanding the weights to wider datatypes during decoding. MixFold then assigns datatypes to output-channel groups aligned with the matrix-unit tiles, enabling finer-than-layer assignment without disrupting matrix-unit execution. We compare MixFold with this http URL Hexagon backend on the Qualcomm Hexagon NPU of a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5. Across the Qwen3 model family, MixFold achieves comparable or higher accuracy than this http URL's sub-4-bit formats at matched bits per weight, while decoding 1.16-1.41 times faster and generating 1.5-4.3 times more tokens per joule.

translation.title: MixFold：基于输出通道分组的移动端 NPU 亚4比特混合精度 LLM 推理
translation.abstract: 亚4比特量化使移动设备能够运行更大的 LLM，但其内存节省并不总能转化为移动 NPU 上更快的解码速度。移动 NPU 的矩阵单元仅支持少数原生整数数据类型，在向量单元上转换不支持的权重格式可能会抵消更少比特带来的收益。混合精度还面临额外约束：每个矩阵单元 tile 只能使用一种数据类型。MixFold 使用原生整数运算执行 3 比特和完全对称的 2 比特权重，而无需在解码过程中将权重扩展到更宽的数据类型。随后，MixFold 将数据类型分配给与矩阵单元 tile 对齐的输出通道组，从而实现比层粒度更细的分配，同时不干扰矩阵单元的执行。我们在 Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 的 Qualcomm Hexagon NPU 上将 MixFold 与该 http URL Hexagon 后端进行比较。在 Qwen3 模型系列上，在相同每权重比特数下，MixFold 达到与该 http URL 亚4比特格式相当或更高的准确率，同时解码速度提升 1.16-1.41 倍，每焦耳生成的 token 数提升 1.5-4.3 倍。
translation.brief: 解决移动 NPU 上亚4比特量化内存节省无法转化为解码加速的问题，核心方法是用原生整数运算执行 3/2 比特权重并按矩阵单元 tile 对齐的输出通道组分配数据类型。

papers.title: Contexture: Runtime Context Eviction for High-Throughput Agent Serving
papers.abstract: LLM agents such as Hermes, OpenClaw, and Codex repeatedly resend growing execution histories, increasing shared GPU key-value (KV) cache demand in high-bandwidth memory (HBM). We show that shared KV capacity limits agent-serving throughput. Existing context-reduction methods lack global cache-state visibility, while runtime KV managers lack tool-execution information. Tracing tokens to their originating tool operations reveals that later operations supersede earlier outputs and associated turns, identifying 64% of recorded final-history tokens as removal candidates. We present Contexture, a harness- and model-agnostic architecture for runtime context eviction. Contexture separates the harness's full conversation history from the model's execution context, reducing subsequent requests' KV demand without modifying harness logic or model execution. It combines tool-execution information with global visibility into shared KV pressure and prefix residency: supersession identifies removal candidates, while runtime state determines when removal justifies sacrificing cached computation. This coordination reduces memory demand and decode KV traffic while limiting re-prefill interference with concurrent decoding, without additional model calls or training. Across two models, two harnesses, and two benchmarks, Contexture improves throughput under SLO by 20-73% over the best of no eviction, harness compaction, AgentDiet, and Continuum, and by 7-63% over observation masking in five of eight configurations, and reduces GPU energy per completed session by up to 11%. It also raises throughput under SLO by 23% over LMCache alone on H100. Live-agent experiments show a mean accuracy improvement of 1.4 percentage points over unloaded no eviction, with a worst-case loss of 3.7 points, while observation masking loses 3-28 points.

translation.title: Contexture：面向高吞吐 Agent 服务的运行时上下文驱逐
translation.abstract: Hermes、OpenClaw 和 Codex 等 LLM agent 会反复重发不断增长的执行历史，增加高带宽内存（HBM）中共享 GPU 键值（KV）缓存的需求。我们证明共享 KV 容量限制了 agent 服务的吞吐量。现有上下文缩减方法缺乏全局缓存状态可见性，而运行时 KV 管理器缺乏工具执行信息。将 token 追溯到其来源的工具操作可以发现，后续操作会取代（supersede）先前的输出及相关轮次，从而将记录的最终历史中 64% 的 token 识别为可移除候选。我们提出 Contexture，一种与 harness 和模型无关的运行时上下文驱逐架构。Contexture 将 harness 的完整对话历史与模型的执行上下文分离，在不修改 harness 逻辑或模型执行的情况下降低后续请求的 KV 需求。它将工具执行信息与对共享 KV 压力和前缀驻留的全局可见性相结合：supersession 识别移除候选，而运行时状态决定何时移除值得牺牲已缓存的计算。这种协调降低了内存需求和解码 KV 流量，同时限制了对并发解码的重新 prefill 干扰，且无需额外的模型调用或训练。在两个模型、两个 harness 和两个基准上，Contexture 相比不驱逐、harness 压缩、AgentDiet 和 Continuum 中的最优者，将 SLO 下的吞吐量提升 20-73%，在八个配置中的五个里相比观察掩码提升 7-63%，并将每个完成会话的 GPU 能耗最多降低 11%。在 H100 上，它相比仅使用 LMCache 将 SLO 下吞吐量提升 23%。真实 agent 实验显示，相比无负载不驱逐，平均准确率提升 1.4 个百分点，最坏情况损失 3.7 个百分点，而观察掩码损失 3-28 个百分点。
translation.brief: 解决共享 KV 缓存容量限制 agent 服务吞吐量的问题，核心方法是将 harness 对话历史与模型执行上下文分离，结合工具执行的 supersession 信息与全局 KV 状态进行运行时上下文驱逐。

papers.title: Privacy Protection in Self-Evolving Personal Agents: Persistent Memory and Cross-Carrier Transfer
papers.abstract: Personal agents carry private experience into later decisions through persistent memory. This thematic survey compares memory admission, maintenance, release, and withdrawal by protected change, observer, and validation setting. Direct evidence in the screened corpus comes from controlled memory workflows. Three worked scenarios follow one private fact through booking, feedback-driven learning, and withdrawal. We show when prompt revision and memory reads compose, when skills inherit a private head's bound, and why reader non-use does not establish cleanup of learned state. Diagnostic experiments measure the utility costs of wider label protection and broad memory deletion, and test how missing lineage obscures descendants.

translation.title: 自进化个人 Agent 中的隐私保护：持久记忆与跨载体转移
translation.abstract: 个人 agent 通过持久记忆将私人经验带入后续决策。本主题综述按受保护的变更、观察者和验证设置，比较记忆的准入、维护、释放和撤回。筛选语料中的直接证据来自受控的记忆工作流。三个具体场景追踪一个私人事实经历预订、反馈驱动学习和撤回的全过程。我们展示了提示词修订与记忆读取何时会组合、技能何时继承私人头部的绑定，以及为什么读取器未使用并不能证明已学习状态的清理。诊断实验测量了更宽标签保护和广泛记忆删除的效用代价，并测试缺失的谱系（lineage）如何掩盖派生数据。
translation.brief: 研究个人 agent 持久记忆中私人信息的准入、维护与撤回等隐私问题，核心方法是通过受控记忆工作流和诊断实验系统比较不同保护设置下的隐私风险与效用代价。

papers.title: From Letter-of-Credit Requirements to Executable Specifications: Evaluating Verification Accuracy and Completeness
papers.abstract: In letter-of-credit (LC) document examination, a correct final decision does not show that every requirement was examined. We therefore evaluate examination requirement by requirement and make each requirement executable. A language model converts the bill of lading (BL) and commercial invoice (IV) requirements of a credit into atomic conditions and logical structures, and a deterministic verifier retrieves the named evidence and computes each outcome, so every check can be compared with a gold encoding and traced to logged evidence. Because LC records are confidential, our on-premises 9B parser is fine-tuned only on synthetic pairs built from templates and human-reviewed public document values. On 345 real LC cases, final-decision accuracy proves misleading: a constant PASS rule has the highest raw accuracy while examining nothing. Although it never sees a real record during training, the fine-tuned parser detects 93% of the atomic requirements its ontology covers and reconstructs 86% of the covered requirements exactly. It verifies 82% of the evaluable requirements correctly, against 54% for a tool-using agent, and leads the agent on both satisfied requirements and discrepancies. It also completely examines 1.8 times as many cases as few-shot prompting of the same model, while direct prediction and the agent complete none. Executing the gold encodings with the same verifier shows that some of the remaining errors, missed discrepancies included, come from the operators and normalization, which a better parser alone cannot fix. Every rejection comes with a trace of the units and evidence behind it, which suits examiner-in-the-loop review.

translation.title: 从信用证要求到可执行规范：评估验证的准确性与完整性
translation.abstract: 在信用证（LC）单据审核中，正确的最终决定并不能表明每项要求都经过了审核。因此我们逐项评估审核要求，并使每项要求可执行。语言模型将信用证中的提单（BL）和商业发票（IV）要求转换为原子条件和逻辑结构，确定性验证器检索指定的证据并计算每项结果，使每项检查都能与金标准编码比较并追溯到记录的证据。由于 LC 记录是保密的，我们的本地部署 9B 解析器仅在由模板和人工审核的公开单据值构建的合成对上微调。在 345 个真实 LC 案例上，最终决定准确率具有误导性：恒定 PASS 规则具有最高的原始准确率，却什么都没审核。尽管训练中从未见过真实记录，微调后的解析器检测到其本体覆盖的 93% 的原子要求，并精确重构了 86% 的覆盖要求。它正确验证了 82% 的可评估要求，而使用工具的 agent 仅为 54%，并在满足的要求和差异（discrepancy）两方面均领先于该 agent。它还完整审核的案例数量是同一模型 few-shot 提示的 1.8 倍，而直接预测和 agent 均无法完成任何完整审核。用同一验证器执行金标准编码表明，部分剩余错误（包括漏检的差异）来自算子和归一化，仅靠更好的解析器无法解决。每个拒绝都附带其背后的单元和证据的追踪，适合审核员在环（examiner-in-the-loop）审查。
translation.brief: 解决信用证单据审核中最终决定正确但无法证明逐项要求均被检查的问题，核心方法是用语言模型将要求转为可执行的原子条件与逻辑结构，并用确定性验证器逐项计算和追踪结果。

papers.title: Reward Integrity in Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for LLM Guardrail Red-Teaming
papers.abstract: We study reward fidelity in an adversarial reinforcement-learning loop for red-teaming financial-services language-model guardrails. Apparent wins can arise when an attack omits prescribed personally identifiable information (PII), or when a reward judge credits a response that did not break the targeted policy. On attacker-generated and public benchmark examples, TypeSafe Jev checks whether the prescribed PII is present. For outcome scoring, we compare the decision models TypeSafe Jev, Laya (pretrained and post-trained), and pretrained CLM-8B with logged Opus 4.8 judgements from a replay corpus. Post-training markedly improves Laya's agreement with the judge. A separate author-reviewed off-target set establishes that Opus can award false wins. The findings motivate specialised decision-model judges for checking prescribed PII in attack inputs and scoring target responses against the intended policy.

translation.title: 面向 LLM 护栏红队的对抗性强化学习中的奖励完整性
translation.abstract: 我们研究针对金融服务语言模型护栏红队的对抗性强化学习回路中的奖励保真度。当攻击省略了规定的个人身份信息（PII），或奖励裁判认可了并未突破目标策略的响应时，可能出现表面上的胜利。在攻击者生成和公开基准样本上，TypeSafe Jev 检查规定的 PII 是否存在。对于结果评分，我们将决策模型 TypeSafe Jev、Laya（预训练和后训练）和预训练 CLM-8B 与来自回放语料库的 Opus 4.8 记录判断进行比较。后训练显著提高了 Laya 与裁判的一致性。一个单独的、由作者审核的 off-target 集合证实 Opus 可能给出虚假胜利。这些发现促使人们使用专门的决策模型裁判来检查攻击输入中规定的 PII，并根据预期策略对目标响应进行评分。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 护栏红队对抗强化学习中奖励不忠实（虚假胜利）的问题，核心方法是分析攻击输入 PII 检查与结果评分裁判的可靠性，并主张使用专门的决策模型裁判。

papers.title: ReactDrive: Self-Reactive Driving World Model
papers.abstract: The world evolves through the dynamics of its constituent entities and their interactions, with changes in one entity influencing the behavior of others. To simulate this evolution under different actions, interactive world models need to capture the resulting agent responses as part of the world's own dynamics. In autonomous driving, errors in modeling these responses can misrepresent maneuver safety and undermine the reliability of generated videos used for policy evaluation and learning. To formalize this intrinsic requirement for driving world model, we define self-reactivity as the capability to model agent responses from observed history and a specified ego action, and generate visual futures that reflect those responses without prescribed future agent trajectories. To realize this capability, we introduce ReactDrive, a driving world model that jointly learns agent dynamics and visual generation through a shared agent state representation. Within this framework, dynamics supervision grounds a reactive dynamics prior in observed agent states, while the video objective jointly optimizes the self-reactivity and visual realism. Experiments show improved agent responses, ego controllability, and video quality, a 96.0% preference for agent reactivity in human comparisons across five baselines, and better downstream planning through augmentation with generated videos. We hope this work encourages the community to recognize self-reactivityas a foundational capability for developing and evaluating interactive world models. Project page: this https URL .
