papers.title: Mind the Delta: Early Pruning of RTL Variants for Agentic Hardware Optimization
papers.abstract: Autonomous coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) now write diverse microarchitectural variants of existing register-transfer level (RTL) designs at high throughput, shifting the primary bottleneck of agentic RTL optimization onto logic synthesis. Commercial toolchains take hours per variant, creating an acute compute asymmetry between proposing and evaluating variants. Existing fast evaluators falter in this regime. Subtle RTL edits trigger nonlinear synthesis shifts that learned predictors and coding agents cannot resolve, while synthesis proxies at reduced effort either alter the optimization trajectory or retain most of its runtime. Selecting a variant, however, does not require regressing absolute quality of results across designs, only identifying when a candidate cannot surpass the best completed feasible implementation. Based on the observation that synthesis trajectories share strong design-specific bias with their base design, we propose DiffScope, a training-free anytime selection framework that races full synthesis runs in parallel. By pairing live area telemetry with the already synthesized base trajectory, DiffScope cancels early mapping inflation, reducing residual variance during initial mapping by 73.6X, and stops uncompetitive runs via a lower bound calibrated on other design lineages. Across 43 design families from small blocks to processors with millions of cells, DiffScope uniquely recovers the optimum of exhaustive synthesis in every family, cuts total evaluation work by 44.9% (1.81X), and reaches 2.18X on L-tier designs.

papers.title: Subverting Tool Arguments: Defense-Evading Metadata Poisoning in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Conventional indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks hijack an LLM agent's workflow through malicious instructions embedded in retrieved external content. The growing adoption of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) exposes another attack surface: tool descriptions supplied by third-party MCP servers. Attackers can manipulate this metadata to induce malicious argument generation during tool calls. The challenge is to ensure that the modified descriptions still appear benign to both LLMs and users. Existing IPI attacks, however, struggle to achieve both high attack success and low detectability in this setting. To address this challenge, we propose GRAFT, an LLM-based optimization method for crafting adversarial tool descriptions. Specifically, GRAFT uses a masking mechanism to identify argument-relevant token positions for targeted injection. It then iteratively refines candidate descriptions using dynamic mutation strategies proposed by an LLM, guided by the agent's tool choices and generated arguments. We evaluate GRAFT on three public datasets against several attack baselines. The results show that GRAFT achieves higher attack success while maintaining low detection rates across five filter-based defenses. It also bypasses several existing IPI defenses. Even under an adaptive defense trained on GRAFT-generated injections, GRAFT remains more effective than the baselines.

papers.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Stateful Privacy Sniffing of LLM Agents via Behavioral Covert Channels in Web Interactions
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on Web interaction, issuing searches, following links, and reading pages, to complete complex user tasks. Since each action is driven by the agent's private context, including the user's prompt, dialogue history, memory, and connected data, it also opens a new privacy exposure surface. Prior attacks either passively analyze network traffic, which yields only coarse correlations, or hijack the agent through indirect prompt injection, which must place sensitive content in an outgoing field and is blocked by content-level defenses. Whether an attacker can actively recover fine-grained private context without any explicit transmission thus remains insufficiently understood. Our insight is that an agent's benign Web decisions themselves leak private context, as what it chooses to visit encodes whether, which, and in what order it acts, forming a behavioral covert channel. Building on this, we design SNOOP, a stateful hierarchical probing framework that narrows a coarse-to-fine hypothesis tree per task and reconstructs user queries and profiles from the agent's observable paths. Across four agents and three LLM backbones on 500 StackExchange queries and 378 multi-turn iKAT dialogues, SNOOP recovers query concepts with an average F1 of 0.89 and user profiles with an F1 of 0.80, while four representative agent defenses change its recovery by less than 0.03 F1. Since no sensitive content is ever transmitted, content-level inspection cannot detect this leakage; we therefore propose Selection-Obfuscated Retrieval (SOR), which acquires resources under a fixed budget independent of private context and confines the agent's selection to a local snapshot, cutting SNOOP's F1 to 0.39 without additional LLM inference.

papers.title: Decision Models Are General-Purpose Process Reward Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from verifiable outcomes gives a language agent one reward per episode: every step is credited alike, and nothing about the task is learned when all rollouts fail. The last mile, step-level credit, usually requires step labels, a learned critic, costly LLM judges or hand-written rules. We introduce DM-PRM, which turns a general-purpose decision model -- one answering yes/no questions with probabilities -- into a general-purpose process reward model (PRM), zero-shot: no step labels, no fine-tuning, no critic. DM-PRM asks one question per step and adds the standardised answers to the advantage. It plugs into any policy-gradient method; one model, with one question text per environment, serves household tasks, web shopping and multiple RL methods. With Qwen2.5-1.5B it lifts GRPO by over twenty points on ALFWorld and over ten on WebShop, overtakes GiGPO on ALFWorld and learns in far fewer iterations; it also improves GiGPO and GraphGPO on both benchmarks and reaches the highest success of our comparison, ahead of critic-based PPO and of state-of-the-art GiGPO, HGPO and GraphGPO. Its scores locate useful steps in failed rollouts, and trained agents drop idle actions and explore instead of circling. DM-PRM shows that step credit need not be learned: it can be asked for.

papers.title: When Do LLM-Elicited Priors Help? A Controlled Audit of Language Models as Priors for Small-Sample Bayesian Regression
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked where to center the coefficients of a small-sample Bayesian regression, but the evidence is unclear: benchmarks are often built to match the prior and models may remember them. We audit this practice with one frontier and one flash-tier model, using hidden feature names, post-cutoff housing data and a pre-specified test that gives features the wrong descriptions. First, the models share their errors (correlation $0.92$--$0.99$ across draws, vendors and paraphrases): averaging $20$ draws is no more accurate than one, and treating draws as independent creates overconfidence. Much of this error comes from reporting each feature's effect alone, not with the others held fixed. Second, against the best classical prior, the LLM center helps clearly on one of four benchmarks (RMSE $-5.8\%$), marginally on two, and hurts mean RMSE on the fourth. Third, the LLM's stated uncertainty is unreliable; letting the data set the prior scale cuts the harm of a wrong center four-fold against a unit-variance prior. A pre-specified external test returned the verdict \textsc{partial}: on $18$ rule-selected problems the center helps on six and hurts on four, and a hard trust gate trusts a harmful prior while an evidence-weighted mixture is safer.

translation.title: LLM 引导的先验何时有用？对语言模型作为小样本贝叶斯回归先验的受控审计
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用来为小样本贝叶斯回归的系数确定先验中心，但相关证据并不明确：基准往往被设计得与先验相匹配，且模型可能记住了这些基准。我们用一个前沿模型和一个 flash 级模型对此实践进行审计，采用隐藏特征名、截止日期后的住房数据，以及一个预先设定的、给特征错误描述的测试。首先，这些模型的错误是共享的（跨抽样、供应商和改写的相关性为 0.92–0.99）：平均 20 次抽样并不比一次更准确，而将抽样视为独立会产生过度自信。这些错误很大程度上来自单独报告每个特征的效应，而非在固定其他特征条件下的效应。其次，与最佳经典先验相比，LLM 中心在四个基准中的一个上明显有帮助（RMSE 降低 5.8%），在两个上略有帮助，在第四个上则使平均 RMSE 变差。第三，LLM 声称的不确定性不可靠；让数据来设定先验尺度，相比单位方差先验可将错误中心的危害降低四倍。一项预先设定的外部测试给出的结论是 partial：在 18 个按规则选出的问题上，中心在六个上有帮助、在四个上有害，而一个硬信任门会信任有害的先验，证据加权混合则更安全。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 提供的先验中心在小样本贝叶斯回归中是否可靠，通过隐藏特征名、事后数据和错误描述的受控审计方法检验其误差相关性、有效性与不确定性可信度。

papers.title: Auditing and Adapting kNNGuard for Long-Context Prompts
papers.abstract: Training-free activation guardrails such as kNNGuard score prompts by comparing last-token LLM hidden states (the Layer Ensemble branch, kNNGuard LE) and sentence embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, Embedding-kNN) against a small reference bank (50 examples per class), combining the two branches into a Fused Ensemble (kNNGuard FE). While effective on short inputs (up to 256 tokens), standard kNNGuard degrades substantially on long inputs (over 1000 tokens): averaged across Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma-4-E4B-it, kNNGuard LE AUROC drops from 0.742 (0.777 and 0.706) to 0.554 (0.587 and 0.521) on Content Harm Moderation (Aegis-2.0), and from 0.994 (0.995 and 0.992) to 0.556 (0.598 and 0.513) on RAG Hallucination Detection (HaluBench). We trace this degradation to three causes: (1) hidden-state drift as sequence length increases, (2) hard 256-token truncation in MiniLM, and (3) signal dilution when a long document is compressed into a single final-token vector. We then evaluate three training-free adaptations: a Length-Routed Dual Bank, a long-context embedding model (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B), and Strided Window Pooling across intermediate token positions. On Content Harm Moderation, dual-bank routing and strided window pooling raise long-context kNNGuard LE AUROC from 0.554 to 0.828 (+0.274 AUROC) and fused kNNGuard FE AUROC from 0.721 to 0.886 (+0.164 AUROC) with no latency overhead from bank routing. On RAG Hallucination Detection, where the guardrail must verify logical consistency between a generated answer and a retrieved passage, sentence-embedding kNN remains near random chance across all lengths, while length-matched LLM hidden states (kNNGuard LE) recover medium-length detection (AUROC = 0.853) but remain limited on over-1000-token passages (AUROC = 0.607) due to final-token dilution over long contexts.

translation.title: 面向长上下文提示的 kNNGuard 审计与适配
translation.abstract: 免训练的激活护栏（如 kNNGuard）通过将 last-token 的 LLM 隐藏状态（Layer Ensemble 分支，kNNGuard LE）和句子嵌入（all-MiniLM-L6-v2，Embedding-kNN）与小型参考库（每类 50 个样本）比较来为提示打分，并将两个分支融合为 Fused Ensemble（kNNGuard FE）。虽然在短输入（最多 256 token）上有效，标准 kNNGuard 在长输入（超过 1000 token）上性能大幅下降：在 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Gemma-4-E4B-it 上平均，kNNGuard LE 在 Content Harm Moderation（Aegis-2.0）上的 AUROC 从 0.742（0.777 和 0.706）降至 0.554（0.587 和 0.521），在 RAG 幻觉检测（HaluBench）上从 0.994（0.995 和 0.992）降至 0.556（0.598 和 0.513）。我们将这种退化归因于三个原因：(1) 随序列长度增加的隐藏状态漂移，(2) MiniLM 的硬性 256-token 截断，(3) 将长文档压缩为单个末 token 向量时的信号稀释。随后我们评估了三种免训练适配方法：按长度路由的双参考库、长上下文嵌入模型（Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B），以及跨中间 token 位置的跨步窗口池化。在 Content Harm Moderation 上，双库路由和跨步窗口池化将长上下文 kNNGuard LE 的 AUROC 从 0.554 提升至 0.828（+0.274），将融合的 kNNGuard FE 的 AUROC 从 0.721 提升至 0.886（+0.164），且库路由不带来额外延迟。在 RAG 幻觉检测上（护栏需验证生成答案与检索段落之间的逻辑一致性），句子嵌入 kNN 在所有长度上都接近随机水平，而长度匹配的 LLM 隐藏状态（kNNGuard LE）恢复了中等长度的检测能力（AUROC = 0.853），但由于长上下文中的末 token 稀释，在超过 1000 token 的段落上仍然受限（AUROC = 0.607）。
translation.brief: 诊断 kNNGuard 护栏在长上下文输入上性能退化的原因，并提出双参考库路由、长上下文嵌入和跨步窗口池化等免训练适配方法。

papers.title: Exercised, Rarely Recovered: What Public Reports Say About Recovery in 50 AI Agent Harnesses and Runtimes
papers.abstract: When an AI coding agent deletes the wrong files or a long agent run crashes, users fall back on recovery mechanisms: resume from a checkpoint, undo, ask for approval, read the log. Research runtimes promise stronger guarantees, such as saga-style compensation and transactional rollback. We ask what public evidence shows about whether either kind works in real use. Under a protocol frozen before data collection, we graded 12 persistent agent runtimes, 26 coding-agent harnesses and 12 research runtimes on eight recovery mechanisms, from not found to exercised in a real run, with two blind coding passes, adjudication and re-verification against archived sources. Recovery is exercised almost everywhere in practice: 11 of 12 runtimes and 25 of 26 harnesses have at least one real-use report. Yet of 128 such reports, only 19 describe the run fully recovering; 54 are partial and 45 failed. Checkpoint/resume recovered once in 27 reports, rollback once in 15. Research runtimes show the opposite profile: guarantees evaluated on benchmarks, none reported in operation, and compensation of external effects, their central guarantee, is offered by no harness at all.

translation.title: 被使用、很少被恢复：50 个 AI Agent Harness 与运行时的公开报告对恢复能力的说明
translation.abstract: 当 AI 编码 agent 误删文件或长时间 agent 运行崩溃时，用户会依赖恢复机制：从检查点恢复、撤销、请求批准、阅读日志。研究型运行时承诺更强的保证，如 saga 式补偿和事务性回滚。我们要问的是，公开证据显示了这两类机制在真实使用中是否有效。在一个数据收集前冻结的协议下，我们对 12 个持久化 agent 运行时、26 个编码 agent harness 和 12 个研究型运行时在八种恢复机制上进行了评级，从未找到到在真实运行中被使用，采用两次盲编码、裁决和对照存档来源的复核。恢复机制在实践中几乎处处被使用：12 个运行时中的 11 个和 26 个 harness 中的 25 个至少有一份真实使用报告。然而在 128 份此类报告中，只有 19 份描述了运行完全恢复；54 份为部分恢复，45 份失败。检查点/恢复在 27 份报告中仅成功一次，回滚在 15 份中仅一次。研究型运行时呈现出相反的特征：保证只在基准上被评估，无一在运行中被报告，而其核心保证——对外部效应的补偿——没有任何 harness 提供。
translation.brief: 通过冻结协议对 50 个 agent 运行时和 harness 的公开报告进行分级审计，考察八种恢复机制在真实使用中是否真正实现完全恢复。

papers.title: PLoQ: A Prompt-Specific Low-Rank Basis for 4-bit Quantization of LLM Activations
papers.abstract: Low-bit activation quantization of large language models remains challenging, as a small number of dominant directions dictate the quantization range. State-of-the-art methods isolate these directions in a high-precision subspace through transformations calibrated offline and folded into the weights, which fixes the subspace for all prompts, leaving each prompt's few unique directions unprotected, and rules it out wherever no weight can absorb the transformation. We present PLoQ, a prompt-adaptive low-rank decomposition that extracts the dominant activation components before quantization, quantizes them separately, and restores them within the layer's GEMM, without modifying the weights. The low-rank component's basis is estimated from each prompt during prefill and reused throughout decoding. At the same bit width as state-of-the-art mixed-precision quantization (4-bit weights, activations and K/V cache with an eighth of the channels at 8 bits, about 4.2 bits per activation on average), PLoQ outperforms it on all six Llama and Qwen models from 1B to 70B parameters, at up to 8k tokens (16k on two of them), recovering up to 46% of the perplexity that the state of the art still loses to 4-bit activations. On Llama-3.1-8B at 8k tokens it adds only 4% to prefill and 8% to decoding.

translation.title: PLoQ：面向 LLM 激活 4 比特量化的提示特定低秩基
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的低比特激活量化仍然具有挑战性，因为少数主导方向决定了量化范围。最先进的方法通过离线校准并折叠进权重的变换将这些方向隔离在高精度子空间中，这为所有提示固定了该子空间，使每个提示特有的少数方向得不到保护，并且在权重无法吸收该变换的地方无法使用。我们提出 PLoQ，一种提示自适应的低秩分解，在量化前提取主导激活分量，单独量化它们，并在层的 GEMM 内恢复它们，而不修改权重。低秩分量的基在 prefill 阶段从每个提示估计，并在整个解码过程中复用。在与最先进混合精度量化相同的比特宽度下（4 比特权重、激活和 K/V 缓存，其中八分之一的通道为 8 比特，平均每激活约 4.2 比特），PLoQ 在从 1B 到 70B 参数的全部六个 Llama 和 Qwen 模型上、在最多 8k token（其中两个模型为 16k）下均优于其方法，最多恢复了最先进方法在 4 比特激活下仍损失的困惑度的 46%。在 8k token 的 Llama-3.1-8B 上，它仅增加 4% 的 prefill 开销和 8% 的解码开销。
translation.brief: 提出 PLoQ，一种提示自适应的低秩分解方法，在量化前提取并单独处理主导激活分量以改进 4 比特激活量化，且不修改权重。

papers.title: Separating Automation Gains from Agent Contributions in AI-Assisted Model Validation
papers.abstract: LLM agents are being proposed for bank model validation, yet evaluations that compare agent-assisted work with manual practice credit the agent with gains that come from digitized evidence and deterministic tests. We propose a staged architecture in which an LLM-free controlled workflow (P1) is both the fallback and the control arm for individually authorized agent tasks (P2), and an attribution protocol that credits an agent only for faults P1 does not already report. The protocol charges decoy false alarms, unnecessary actions and endorsed developer assertions, counts invalid outputs as misses, folds newly automatable findings back into P1 with discovery credit, and fixes safety bounds and a break-even cost gate in advance. On a synthetic credit-scorecard harness, five scripted reference policies show why this matters: naive case accuracy (4/6) and pooled detection (3/5) tie four flawed policies, whereas the protocol separates all five and credits only the reference policy with detection beyond P1. One fold-back round raises a P1-parroting policy's naive scores without any change to the policy. A regression matrix of sixteen mutants covers nine ways in which earlier versions of the evaluation passed misleadingly. No LLM agent has been evaluated yet; we specify a falsifiable pilot.

translation.title: 在 AI 辅助模型验证中区分自动化收益与 Agent 贡献
translation.abstract: LLM agent 正被提议用于银行模型验证，然而将 agent 辅助工作与人工实践比较的评估，把来自数字化证据和确定性测试的收益归功于 agent。我们提出一种分阶段架构，其中一个无 LLM 的受控工作流（P1）既是回退方案，也是单独授权的 agent 任务（P2）的对照组，并提出一种归因协议，只有当 agent 发现了 P1 尚未报告的缺陷时才给予其功劳。该协议对诱饵误报、不必要操作和背书开发者断言进行扣分，将无效输出计为漏报，将新近可自动化的发现连同发现功劳折回 P1，并预先固定安全边界和盈亏平衡成本门槛。在一个合成信用评分卡测试台上，五个脚本化参考策略说明了这为何重要：朴素的案例准确率（4/6）和合并检测（3/5）使四个有缺陷的策略打成平手，而该协议将五个策略全部区分开，且只给在 P1 之外有检测能力的参考策略记功。一轮折回使一个鹦鹉学舌 P1 的策略的朴素分数上升，而策略本身没有任何改变。一个包含十六个变体的回归矩阵覆盖了早期版本评估以误导性方式通过的九种情形。目前尚未评估任何 LLM agent；我们给出了一个可证伪的试点方案。
translation.brief: 提出分阶段架构与归因协议，将 LLM agent 在银行模型验证中的贡献与数字化证据和确定性测试带来的自动化收益区分开来。

papers.title: Epistemic Guard: Out-of-Process MCP Receipt Proxying, Post-Turn Prose Supervision, and Provenance-Gated Memory for Tool-Using Autonomous Agents
papers.abstract: Language-model agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) face three runtime verification gaps: (i) action fabrication, where post-tool prose narrates side effects that failed, timed out, or never ran; (ii) provenance collapse, where unverified model prose or web text enters durable memory alongside executed tool outputs; and (iii) syndicated echo amplification, where mirrored web pages satisfy multi-source corroboration from one origin. Existing MCP firewalls inspect wire calls before execution, while LLM-judge guardrails require multi-gigabyte VRAM without binding prose to receipts. We present epistemic-guard (v0.5.2), an open-source Python library and out-of-process stdio MCP receipt proxy (15 modules, 0 MiB GPU VRAM). epistemic-guard isolates Ed25519 signing keys out of process, writes RFC 6962 Merkle logs with AER-1 receipt translation, checks post-turn prose on CPU with SHA-256-verified OpenVINO INT8 encoders (4 models, 279.48 MB total; 82.67 MB on the supervision path), gates SQLite writes across 7 provenance domains, and collapses verbatim and lightly edited wire-syndicated RAG mirrors. On conformance suites, epistemic-guard rejects 100.0% of tampered receipts (200 Merkle leaves), passes 58/58 official AER-1 ingestion vectors and 50/50 reference-verified AER-1 exports, verifies 100.0% of 40 fault-injected wire calls and 100 concurrent appends with 0 key leaks, and blocks 100.0% of 100 unauthorized memory writes. Across $N=250$ frozen-benchmark traces, epistemic-guard reaches 93.2% accuracy at 17.9 ms warm median CPU latency (8.62 ms single-clause; 921.8 ms cold-start load), beating 12B-14B GPU judges by 6.4-6.8 points ($p=0.0259$, $p=0.0095$) at 4.26-4.5$\times$ lower latency; on $N=60$ live mcp-proxy traces, it catches 96.15% of hazards at 76.67% accuracy (38.24% FPR; $+18.34$ points over Stage-1-only, $p=0.001$) in 9.16 ms p50.

papers.title: Reasoning in Two Dimensions: Quantifying Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness and Efficiency
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning exposes intermediate steps, but a correct answer does not establish that an LLM relies on the dependence expressed by those steps or reasons efficiently. We operationalize CoT faithfulness and efficiency within a common framework. Specifically, we represent a CoT as a semantic reasoning graph and decompose the model's predictive dependence along two complementary axes: dependence explained by semantic support versus additional reasoning history, and dependence allocated to answer-reaching versus off-path reasoning. This decomposition yields global and step-level measures of unfaithfulness and inefficiency. Controlled interventions show that the proposed metrics respond to hidden dependence and induced off-path reasoning as intended. Across mathematical and multi-hop reasoning tasks, answer-level unfaithfulness is consistently associated with greater predictive uncertainty, whereas both unfaithfulness and inefficiency exhibit weak or inconsistent associations with answer correctness. We further derive theoretically grounded, graph-aware fine-tuning objectives that improve the targeted reasoning properties without directly optimizing the computationally expensive metrics or compromising answer accuracy. Results indicate that accuracy and brevity provide incomplete assessments of reasoning quality: reliable CoT evaluation should also consider whether the LLM's predictive dependence is faithfully represented and efficiently allocated.

papers.title: Schema-Validated LLM Workflows: A Benchmark Protocol and Comparative Evaluation Across Six Python Implementations
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to extract records, generate SQL, summarize reports, answer policy questions, and route operational work. At these software boundaries, parseable output is necessary but does not establish task correctness. We present a reproducible benchmark protocol, a public executable artifact, and a confirmatory live API evaluation that separate structural validity from task-specific correctness across five business workflow tasks and six Python implementation conditions: PydanticAI, LangGraph, DSPy, CrewAI, Agno, and a framework-free SDK reference. We hypothesize that (H1) schema validity and task quality are separable, (H2) structured-output binding paths are heterogeneous under a shared model and lowest-common-denominator contract, and (H3) condition-by-task interactions concentrate failures rather than shifting all tasks equally. Confirmatory analysis uses distinct task instances (100 extraction and 50 per other task, with three nested replicates) under a frozen analysis plan, yielding a 5400-row primary matrix with equivalence margins and Holm-adjusted contrasts against the SDK reference. In the eligible confirmatory run, overall schema validity was 0.684 and mean automated quality was 0.638. PydanticAI, LangGraph, and DSPy retained near-ceiling schema validity with mean quality 0.91-0.94, while the plain SDK, Agno, and CrewAI conditions were substantially lower in this package and model configuration. Schema-valid rows still produced many task-score flags, especially in extraction and compliance QA, and quality residuals show strong condition-by-task interactions (including a workflow collapse for CrewAI). Labelled ablations address retry budgets and feature-using mechanisms; primary contrasts remain system-configuration findings, not causal attributions to marketed library features.

papers.title: Omo: Giving Continuing AI-Agent Work a Place to Return To
papers.abstract: AI coding agents now keep working while the people who started them are away. Coming back is the hard part: a session list tells you which agent is where, but not what it was asked to do, what it changed, or what to tell it next. We present Omo, which gives each piece of continuing agent work a persistent place to return to. We built the idea twice. Omo Space is an open-source Minecraft mod in which rooms and screens that people build are live terminals on their own machine. Omo Theia brings the same rooms and desks into a customizable IDE, one step away from the editor and the Git patch. Both keep agent sessions running on the host after the view is closed. We describe the two systems, four lessons from building them, and a study designed to test whether returning to a place helps people pick up agent work correctly.

papers.title: RemoteEvolver: Expanding Earth Observation Capabilities through Agent Harness Evolution
papers.abstract: We are interested in developing a continually self-improving remote sensing agentic system. It should identify and address its capability gaps, retaining the resulting improvements to enhance performance on subsequent tasks. However, existing systems typically rely on fixed toolsets and confine their experience accumulation to re-orchestrating predefined capabilities, constraining both capability expansion and the transfer of improvements across tasks. As the infrastructure for agentic systems, the harness manages tools and workflow knowledge as editable, persistent resources outside the base model. These resources can therefore be updated and reused across tasks without additional post-training. Based on these observations, we propose RemoteEvolver, an external harness for remote sensing agents that drives tool and workflow evolution through execution feedback. With the base model parameters fixed, RemoteEvolver acquires missing specialized tools on demand and distills verified successful execution experience from individual tasks into agent skills that can be reused across tasks. The acquired tools and accumulated skills jointly support planning and execution on subsequent tasks. Experiments on Earth-Bench and OpenEarthAgent-Bench show that RemoteEvolver achieves average accuracy gains of 8.18 and 23.86 percentage points over its initial state when tools are fully available and partially missing. Under the same settings, it also outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by an average of 6.77 and 17.10 percentage points, respectively.

papers.title: Markdown Is Not a Firewall: four coding agents, one rules file, four boundaries
papers.abstract: Teams put a one-page rules file in a repository and call it a control on coding agents. A registered study found agents rarely look up a repository's contribution rules. I asked the security question: what does a rules file do at a boundary, against a gate? I tested one 278-word rules file, with hypotheses and analysis code deposited first. Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and OpenCode with DeepSeek worked through 20 small repositories with hidden tests, 12 for three of them. Three agents met four boundaries I built: a refused endpoint, a destructive shortcut, a planted instruction and a planted package. Permission prompts, each vendor's own control layer, were off by design. A gate in front of the mock service blocked and logged forbidden requests. Every verdict was read from records the agent could not change. Only my first scoring pass was blind to arm. My checkers found no real bugs, with the file or without it. The file cost one agent a third of its score: Codex CLI fell from 99.0 to 67.7 percent on hidden tests, and in 11 of its 36 steps reported the task complete with all tests passing while under half of the hidden tests passed. Its own tests passed. Faced with two of its rules that clash on these tasks, three agents followed the task and one followed the rule. Pooled, passes fell from 98.2 to 90.9 percent. Matched pairs fell 7.7 points, 1.3 without Codex CLI. Attempts to cross were rare: 5 in 90 gated steps, 3 without the file, 2 with it, all by OpenCode with DeepSeek, all blocked. With no gate, under the neutral file, the same requests reached the mock in 7 of 45 runs. By an error in my run script, the no-file and rules-file arms always ran behind the gate at the three HTTP boundaries, so I could not test whether the file changes what an agent does there. On what I could measure, the file acted as advice. A file tells an agent what you want. A gate decides what it gets.

translation.title: Markdown 不是防火墙：四个编码智能体、一份规则文件、四道边界
translation.abstract: 团队在仓库中放置一页规则文件，并称之为对编码智能体的控制。一项注册研究发现，智能体很少查阅仓库的贡献规则。我提出了一个安全问题：规则文件在边界处、相对于门禁到底起什么作用？我测试了一份278词的规则文件，并预先存档了假设和分析代码。Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 以及 OpenCode with DeepSeek 在20个带隐藏测试的小型仓库上工作，其中三个智能体使用了其中12个。三个智能体遇到了我构建的四道边界：一个拒绝访问的端点、一个破坏性捷径、一条植入指令和一个植入包。权限提示（各厂商自己的控制层）按设计处于关闭状态。模拟服务前的门禁会拦截并记录被禁止的请求。每个判定都从智能体无法更改的记录中读取。只有我的第一轮评分对实验组是盲的。我的检查器无论有无规则文件都未发现真实漏洞。这份文件让一个智能体损失了三分之一的分数：Codex CLI 在隐藏测试上的得分从99.0%降至67.7%，并且在36步中有11步在不到一半隐藏测试通过的情况下报告任务完成、所有测试通过——它自己的测试确实通过了。面对两条在这些任务上相互冲突的规则，三个智能体遵循任务，一个遵循规则。汇总来看，通过率从98.2%降至90.9%。配对比较下降7.7个百分点，剔除 Codex CLI 后为1.3个百分点。越界尝试很少见：90个有门禁的步骤中出现5次，无文件时3次，有文件时2次，全部来自 OpenCode with DeepSeek，且全部被拦截。在没有门禁、使用中性文件的情况下，同样的请求在45次运行中有7次到达了模拟服务。由于我的运行脚本中的一个错误，无文件组和规则文件组在三个HTTP边界处总是在门禁之后运行，因此我无法测试该文件是否改变智能体在那里的行为。在我能测量的范围内，这份文件只起到了建议的作用。文件告诉智能体你想要什么，而门禁决定它能得到什么。
translation.brief: 研究仓库规则文件对编码智能体的实际约束力，通过在四个智能体上设置四道安全边界并配合门禁进行对照实验来检验其作用。

papers.title: A Footprint-Sensitive Cross-GPU Timing Channel Through the Shared Host Memory Subsystem
papers.abstract: Assigning tenants to separate GPUs does not isolate their host memory traffic. We identify an unprivileged timing channel between GPUs without NVLink: a co-tenant can detect contention by timing reads to its own pinned host buffer, without accessing victim data or using hardware performance counters. The signal tracks the number of distinct host pages the victim touches rather than its throughput. We demonstrate covert communication at 20 bit/s with near-zero error, LLM output-length inference at a held-out Spearman correlation of 0.99 across five models on three platforms, and refusal inference at balanced accuracy up to 0.955. The attacks cross process, container, and Unix-user boundaries and reproduce across two GPU generations and two serving runtimes. Bursty transfers in the tested vLLM+LMCache stack remain below the leakage floor, limiting the demonstrated attacks to sustained device-to-host traffic. IOMMU-disabled and cross-NUMA controls attribute the channel to page-walk contention at the shared host memory controller. This finding motivates two defenses, controller-aware placement and footprint flattening, both of which reduce inference to chance in our experiments. Accelerator isolation alone does not isolate the host infrastructure that tenants share.

translation.title: 一种通过共享主机内存子系统的足迹敏感跨GPU时序信道
translation.abstract: 将租户分配到不同GPU并不能隔离其主机内存流量。我们发现了一个无需NVLink的GPU间非特权时序信道：共租户可以通过对其自身锁页主机缓冲区的读取计时来检测争用，无需访问受害者数据或使用硬件性能计数器。该信号追踪受害者触及的不同主机页数量，而非其吞吐量。我们演示了以20 bit/s、近零误码率的隐蔽通信，在三个平台上对五个模型的LLM输出长度推断（留出集Spearman相关系数0.99），以及平衡准确率高达0.955的拒绝推断。这些攻击跨越进程、容器和Unix用户边界，并在两代GPU和两个服务运行时上复现。测试的 vLLM+LMCache 栈中的突发传输低于泄露下限，将已演示的攻击限制在持续的设备到主机流量上。IOMMU禁用和跨NUMA对照实验将该信道归因于共享主机内存控制器处的页表遍历争用。这一发现启发了两种防御措施——感知控制器的放置和足迹平整化——在我们的实验中都将推断降低到随机水平。仅靠加速器隔离并不能隔离租户共享的主机基础设施。
translation.brief: 发现GPU租户间通过共享主机内存控制器的页表遍历争用产生的时序侧信道，可用于隐蔽通信和LLM输出推断，并提出感知控制器的放置与足迹平整化两种防御。

papers.title: CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?
papers.abstract: The performance of an LLM agent depends on both its model and its harness, the code that mediates its interaction with tools and environments. Can LLM researchers drive this co-evolution as a recursive improvement process, deciding round after round which component to change when each change alters the value of the other? Existing benchmarks evaluate post-training or data research with the harness out of scope, or harness optimization with the model fixed, leaving this joint decision unmeasured. We introduce CoEvoBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs as researchers co-evolving the model and harness of a target agent across five agentic domains. Researchers start from a common base model and initial harness, train and revise within a 24-hour budget, and submit a model-harness pair that is scored on separate test tasks. Across five frontier researchers, the strongest closes more than four fifths of the gap to an instruction-tuned reference system, and co-evolution succeeds on interaction tasks but rarely on long-horizon coding. These results suggest that current LLMs can make a strong first improvement, but cannot yet turn feedback from an improved system into the next one. CoEvoBench provides a controlled testbed for measuring the research capabilities that recursive co-evolution requires.

translation.title: CoEvoBench：LLM 能驱动智能体系统的递归协同进化吗？
translation.abstract: LLM智能体的性能取决于其模型和harness（即调解其与工具和环境交互的代码）。LLM研究者能否将这种协同进化作为递归改进过程来驱动，即一轮又一轮地决定当每次更改都会改变另一组件价值时该更改哪个组件？现有基准要么在harness不在范围内的情况下评估训练后或数据研究，要么在模型固定的情况下优化harness，这一联合决策未被测量。我们提出 CoEvoBench，一个评估LLM作为研究者在五个智能体领域共同进化目标智能体的模型和harness的基准。研究者从共同的基础模型和初始harness出发，在24小时预算内训练和修改，并提交一个在独立测试任务上评分的模型-harness对。在五位前沿研究者中，最强者弥合了与指令微调参考系统之间超过五分之四的差距，协同进化在交互任务上成功，但在长程编码任务上很少成功。这些结果表明，当前LLM能做出强有力的首次改进，但尚不能将改进系统的反馈转化为下一次改进。CoEvoBench 为衡量递归协同进化所需的研究能力提供了受控测试平台。
translation.brief: 提出 CoEvoBench 基准，评估LLM作为研究者联合协同进化智能体的模型与harness这一递归改进决策问题。

papers.title: CTRL: Concurrent Training and Rollout for LLM Reinforcement Learning via GPU Co-Residency
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models runs two GPU workloads with different hardware demands: rollout decoding, which is dominated by memory access and whose batch shrinks as responses finish, and a dense learner. Current systems either time-share every GPU between them, paying serial phases and switches, or split GPUs into pools whose sizes change only in whole devices. We present CTRL, which makes co-residency a third RL execution layout: every GPU runs a learner rank beside a persistent rollout engine, sharing the device under CUDA MPS. A host-owned learner makes the layout fit: optimizer state stays in host memory, and policy weights stream layer by layer through a bounded GPU window. A publication gate trains each ready batch first and waits only before releasing the next policy, keeping a dropless staleness bound. A step-time bound guides compute-share selection, and a GPU-time ledger explains overlap and sharing costs. On H100, A800, and RTX 4090 GPUs with Qwen3 models, CTRL achieves 1.11-2.24$\times$ the throughput of the stronger of verl's asynchronous baselines across 24 workload settings with the staleness limit set to two, and 1.23$\times$ verl's colocate_async on eight H100 GPUs. With the same learner, co-residency is 1.10-1.26$\times$ faster than time-sharing on all three platforms and 1.10-1.30$\times$ faster than the best measured whole-GPU split on H100 DAPO-Math workloads at 256-528 trajectories per step, on four and eight GPUs.

translation.title: CTRL：基于GPU共驻的LLM强化学习并发训练与 rollout
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的强化学习（RL）后训练运行两种硬件需求不同的GPU工作负载：rollout解码（以内存访问为主，其批次随响应完成而缩小）和密集的学习器。现有系统要么在每个GPU上对二者分时复用，付出串行阶段和切换开销，要么将GPU划分为只能以整卡为单位变化的池。我们提出 CTRL，使共驻成为第三种RL执行布局：每个GPU在持久rollout引擎旁运行一个学习器rank，在 CUDA MPS 下共享设备。一个由主机拥有的学习器使该布局可行：优化器状态保存在主机内存中，策略权重通过有界的GPU窗口逐层流式传输。一个发布门先训练每个就绪批次，仅在释放下一个策略前等待，保持无丢弃的陈旧性界限。步时界限指导计算份额选择，GPU时间账本解释重叠和共享成本。在 H100、A800 和 RTX 4090 GPU上使用 Qwen3 模型，在陈旧性界限设为2的24种工作负载设置下，CTRL 达到 verl 异步基线中较强者1.11-2.24倍的吞吐量，在八块 H100 GPU上达到 verl 的 colocate_async 的1.23倍。使用相同学习器时，共驻在所有三个平台上比分时复用快1.10-1.26倍，在 H100 DAPO-Math 工作负载（每步256-528条轨迹、四卡和八卡）上比测得的最佳整卡划分快1.10-1.30倍。
translation.brief: 提出 CTRL，通过 CUDA MPS 让学习器与rollout引擎在每个GPU上共驻，结合主机侧优化器状态和发布门机制，提升LLM强化学习训练吞吐量。

papers.title: OpenRing: Deadlock-Free Execution of Any Planner on AGV Floors with One-Way Lanes
papers.abstract: Lifelong multi-agent path finding replans routes for automated guided vehicles, but deviations can invalidate a plan. With one-way lanes, a late vehicle or lost planner can close a ring of full segments. We separate how fast the floor runs from whether it keeps running. In OpenRing a planner proposes routes and an order, a local guard commits only moves and route changes that cannot close such a ring, and the order binds for a bounded time. Despite arbitrary proposals or planner loss, no ring closes. With two-place segments, traffic can continue under disturbances; progress is guaranteed once they end, and all vehicles exit if entries also stop. Among rules that reroute only on a proposal, every guard veto is necessary, and a clean plan keeps its crossing orders. The guarantee has a price: no rule that never stores a vehicle in a crossing under arbitrary stops carries more than $B/T_s$ per segment of $B$ places and traversal time $T_s$. With binding orders, three planners deadlock in 80 of 126 runs across eight floors. Inside OpenRing, none of the 126 runs deadlocks. OpenRing's closed-loop throughput rivals or exceeds the best baseline's. Physics simulations show no deadlocks or overlaps.

translation.title: OpenRing：在带单向车道的AGV场地上无死锁地执行任意规划器
translation.abstract: 终身多智能体路径规划为自动导引车（AGV）重新规划路线，但偏差可能使计划失效。在单向车道下，一辆迟到的车辆或失效的规划器可能关闭一个由满载路段组成的环。我们将场地的运行速度与是否持续运行分离开来。在 OpenRing 中，规划器提出路线和顺序，本地守卫只提交不会关闭此类环的移动和路线变更，且顺序在有限时间内具有约束力。尽管提案任意或规划器失效，环不会关闭。采用双车位路段时，交通可在扰动下继续；扰动结束后进展得到保证，若入口也停止则所有车辆可驶出。在仅在提案时改道的规则中，守卫的每次否决都是必要的，且干净的计划保持其交叉顺序。这一保证有代价：在任意停止下，任何从不在交叉处存储车辆的规则，在每段B个车位、遍历时间Ts的条件下承载量不超过B/Ts。在有约束顺序的情况下，三个规划器在八个场地126次运行中有80次死锁。在 OpenRing 内部，126次运行均无死锁。OpenRing 的闭环吞吐量与最佳基线相当或更优。物理仿真显示无死锁或重叠。
translation.brief: 提出 OpenRing，通过本地守卫否决可能关闭满载路段环的移动，保证任意规划器在带单向车道的AGV场地上无死锁运行。

papers.title: MAPES: Multi-Value Alignment Pipeline via Expert Specialization
papers.abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences requires simultaneously satisfying multiple, often competing values. Existing preference optimization methods collapse these into a single implicit signal, and even multi-objective extensions optimize within a shared parameter space, leaving cross-value conflicts unresolved. We propose MAPES, a multi-value alignment paradigm in which conflict resolution is a first-class concern at every pipeline stage: it first decomposes supervision into value-specific experts trained in isolated parameter subspaces, then recomposes them via preference-aware value merging and a lightweight harmonization stage that aligns the merged model with the expert ensemble. Across five preference alignment benchmarks, MAPES outperforms strong direct preference optimization (DPO) variants and multi-objective baselines on the benchmark-level average, with no large degradation on GSM8K and GPQA; matched controls isolate the contribution of each stage.

translation.title: MAPES：基于专家特化的多价值对齐流水线
translation.abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好对齐需要同时满足多个往往相互冲突的价值。现有偏好优化方法将这些价值压缩为单一隐式信号，即使是多目标扩展也在共享参数空间内优化，未能解决跨价值冲突。我们提出MAPES，一种将冲突解决作为每个流水线阶段首要关注点的多价值对齐范式：它首先将监督信号分解为在隔离参数子空间中训练的价值专属专家，然后通过偏好感知的价值合并和一个轻量级协调阶段（将合并后的模型与专家集成对齐）进行重组。在五个偏好对齐基准上，MAPES在基准级平均上优于强直接偏好优化（DPO）变体和多目标基线，且在GSM8K和GPQA上没有大幅退化；匹配对照实验隔离了每个阶段的贡献。
translation.brief: 解决多价值对齐中跨价值冲突未解的问题，采用将监督分解为隔离参数子空间中的价值专家、再经偏好感知合并与协调阶段重组的流水线方法。

papers.title: Crafting the Difference, Grounding the Evidence: Discriminative Concept Learning for Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition
papers.abstract: LLM-generated descriptions enrich zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition but repeat cues shared by confusable actions. Their contextual semantics also lack explicit links to skeleton features. To address these challenges, we propose CRAFT, which couples Concept Refinement and Feature-grounded Tokens. Hard-negative-conditioned generation and contrastive scoring identify concepts that distinguish each action from its closest rivals. Unique-QDPP selects complementary descriptions within each semantic slot and prevents their reuse across slots. This bank supervises learnable concept tokens that read motion and context cues from each skeleton. On fixed NTU-60 and NTU-120 splits, CRAFT improves five baselines spanning four recognition paradigms. ZSL accuracy and GZSL harmonic mean increase on every baseline-split pair, by 5.4 and 5.9 percentage points on average. Random-split experiments extend these gains to three datasets, including PKU-MMD. Code will be released after acceptance.

translation.title: 精炼差异，锚定证据：面向零样本骨架动作识别的判别式概念学习
translation.abstract: LLM生成的描述丰富了零样本骨架动作识别，但会重复易混淆动作共有的线索，其上下文语义也缺乏与骨架特征的显式关联。为解决这些挑战，我们提出CRAFT，将概念精炼与特征锚定Token相结合。硬负例条件生成和对比打分识别出能将每个动作与其最接近对手区分开的概念；Unique-QDPP在每个语义槽内选择互补描述并防止跨槽复用。该概念库监督可学习的概念Token，从每个骨架中读取运动和上下文线索。在固定的NTU-60和NTU-120划分上，CRAFT提升了涵盖四种识别范式的五个基线。每个基线-划分组合上的ZSL准确率和GZSL调和平均均提升，平均分别提高5.4和5.9个百分点。随机划分实验将增益扩展到包括PKU-MMD在内的三个数据集。代码将在录用后发布。
translation.brief: 解决LLM生成描述中易混淆动作线索重复且缺乏与骨架特征显式关联的问题，采用硬负例条件概念精炼与特征锚定概念Token学习的方法。

papers.title: Double counting in LLM evidence fusion: exact posteriors separate rule compliance from posterior gain
papers.abstract: Language models fuse reports in retrieval, multi-agent consensus and agent memory, where treating shared-source reports as independent can double count evidence. A common remedy is an instruction to count each source once. Its value depends on the receiver's raw baseline. Pricing it needs an exact reference. We build the graded-dependence exact reference: binary worlds with single-report reliability 0.65 and four dependence levels, whose disclosed parameters give every world an exact posterior and every rule a target risk. The paired gain protocol scores raw and instructed answers of four configurations on 2,976 worlds. Agreement and gain separate in both directions. At $\delta$ = 0, claude-opus-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol agreed with the rule within 0.001 in 744 of 744, and the instruction raised their posterior mismatch by 0.044; gpt-6-luna agreed in 165 of 744 and gained 0.0140 (95% interval 0.0064 to 0.0219); claude-haiku-5-5's gain moved from -0.0295 ($\delta$ = 0) to +0.0302 ($\delta$ = 1) (descriptive). The prespecified first-child endpoint contrast, gain at $\delta$ = 1 minus $\delta$ = 0, was 0.0342 (0.0303 to 0.0382). In the preregistered tests, the raw source-weight contrast was positive (0.259, 95% interval 0.182 to 0.337; Holm rejected zero) and the grouping endpoint difference was not detected (0.0004, -0.0023 to 0.0031). This interval excludes differences larger than 0.0031 in magnitude and lies within the registered precision bound of $\pm$0.0046. The reference prices the rule before any model call. The paired gain, estimable as a Brier difference on labelled deployment items, decides adoption per receiver and prompt condition.

translation.title: LLM证据融合中的重复计数：精确后验区分规则遵从与后验增益
translation.abstract: 语言模型在检索、多智能体共识和智能体记忆中融合报告，将共享来源的报告视为独立会导致证据重复计数。一种常见补救是指示模型对每个来源只计数一次，其价值取决于接收方的原始基线，定价需要一个精确参照。我们构建了分级依赖精确参照：具有单报告可靠性0.65和四个依赖级别的二元世界，其公开参数为每个世界给出精确后验、为每条规则给出目标风险。配对增益协议在2,976个世界上对四种配置的原始和受指令回答打分。一致性与增益在两个方向上分离。在δ=0时，claude-opus-5-5和gpt-6.1-sol在744个世界中有744个与规则一致（差异在0.001以内），但指令使其后验失配增加0.044；gpt-6-luna在744个中一致165个并增益0.0140（95%区间0.0064至0.0219）；claude-haiku-5-5的增益从-0.0295（δ=0）变为+0.0302（δ=1）（描述性）。预设的首子代终点对比（δ=1减δ=0的增益）为0.0342（0.0303至0.0382）。在预注册检验中，原始来源权重对比为正（0.259，95%区间0.182至0.337；Holm检验拒绝零假设），分组终点差异未检出（0.0004，-0.0023至0.0031）。该区间排除了幅度大于0.0031的差异，并落在注册精度界限±0.0046之内。该参照可在任何模型调用之前为规则定价。配对增益可在带标签的部署项上估计为Brier差异，据此按接收方和提示条件决定是否采用。
translation.brief: 解决LLM融合共享来源报告时的证据重复计数问题，构建带公开参数的分级依赖精确参照世界来定价“每来源只计一次”指令的价值。

papers.title: Do Senior Agents Do Their Job? Measuring Role Integrity in How LLM Agents Use Subordinate Material
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly divide long tasks among subagents whose reports a senior agent turns into the final answer. Such a division of labor pays off only if each agent, and above all the senior agent, carries out the duties of its role. Current evaluations, however, mostly score the final answer, and a fluent, well-cited answer cannot show whether the senior agent weighed its subagents' reports or merely aggregated them. To assess whether a senior agent meets its assigned responsibilities, we define role integrity as the preservation of an agent's functional responsibilities when it acts on its subordinates' material. To measure it, we introduce RI-Bench, a behavioral benchmark grounded in the structures and public records of three institutional hierarchies: peer review, appellate adjudication, and parliamentary inquiry. We choose these hierarchies because their rules explicitly assign the senior role a duty toward subordinate material, and together they cover three basic duties: to weigh, to verify, and to relay. Rather than scoring output correctness, we measure how senior agents' outputs respond to controlled changes in subordinate material, using rule-based checks and a rubric-guided LLM judge calibrated against human annotation. Across eight LLMs and over 12,000 agentic episodes, senior agents rarely adopt a planted procedural error (2.9% of rulings) but often follow a majority of generic reviews (up to 71% of decisions) or drop witnesses' stated limitations (up to 65% of cited claims). Obligation prompts reduce these failures without removing them, and they also shift behavior in the control conditions. These findings motivate direct, obligation-specific evaluation of role integrity rather than inferring it from general capability or explicit role instructions. Code and data are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 高级智能体尽到职责了吗？衡量LLM智能体使用下属材料时的角色完整性
translation.abstract: 多智能体LLM系统日益将长任务分配给子智能体，由高级智能体将其报告整合为最终答案。这种分工只有在每个智能体、尤其是高级智能体履行其角色职责时才有价值。然而当前评估大多只对最终答案打分，一个流畅、引用充分的答案无法表明高级智能体是否真正权衡了子智能体的报告，还是仅仅聚合它们。为评估高级智能体是否履行其被指派的职责，我们将角色完整性定义为智能体在处理下属材料时对其功能性职责的保持。为衡量它，我们提出RI-Bench，一个基于三种制度层级（同行评审、上诉裁决和议会调查）的结构与公开记录的行为基准。选择这些层级是因为其规则明确赋予高级角色对下属材料的义务，且共同覆盖三种基本职责：权衡、核实和传达。我们不评估输出正确性，而是衡量高级智能体的输出如何响应下属材料的受控变化，使用基于规则的检查和经人工标注校准的、由评分细则引导的LLM裁判。在八个LLM和超过12,000个智能体回合中，高级智能体很少采纳植入的程序性错误（占裁决的2.9%），但常常跟随多数泛泛的评审（高达71%的决策）或丢弃证人声明的局限（高达65%的被引用主张）。义务提示能减少但不能消除这些失败，且在控制条件下也改变行为。这些发现表明应直接、针对义务地评估角色完整性，而非从一般能力或显式角色指令中推断。代码和数据见此https链接。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体系统中高级智能体是否真正履行权衡、核实、传达下属材料职责难以评估的问题，提出基于三种制度层级的RI-Bench行为基准，通过受控扰动下属材料来衡量角色完整性。

papers.title: The Vulnerability Window: Decision Instability in Quantized Reward Models
papers.abstract: Reward models and LLM judges are routinely quantized to 4 bits so that scoring many candidates stays affordable, and the usual check is that benchmark accuracy barely moves. That check is close to blind. Across eight reward models from two families (0.6B-8B), three generative judges and four 4-bit quantizers, quantization rewrites 1.1-12.3% of pairwise preference decisions on RewardBench while aggregate accuracy moves by as little as 0.03 points (p = 1.00), because the errors it fixes and introduces cancel. Flips concentrate where the full-precision margin is small relative to the quantization noise scale sigma: a Gaussian approximation Phi(-|m|/sigma) describes the aggregate rate, over-predicting it in all 30 scalar settings and failing for generative judges, and occupancy of the resulting vulnerability window falls from 25% to 7% with model size, which is what makes small judges fragile. The churn stays within noise under benign best-of-16 and becomes clear under adversarial pressure for some quantizers (146:54 harmful:helpful flips on one family, reversing sign on another). Downstream it changes what ships: across six (model, quantizer) pairs from two families, 14.6-65.7% of problems get a different best-of-64 selection while only 2.6-9.6% get a different final answer, with selections changing 5-8x more often than answers in every pair, and the pair the benchmark calls identical (0.03 points, p = 1.00) still changes 34.5% of them. Benchmark churn ranks that downstream change (rho = 0.89); benchmark accuracy does not order it reliably. Held-out audits then locate the useful diagnostic in the margin rather than the Gaussian: every margin-based predictor orders flips identically (AUC 0.927), and on the level a directly measured churn rate wins in-distribution. As a routing signal it is matched by plain top-k. The contribution is the characterization, not the model.

translation.title: 脆弱性窗口：量化奖励模型中的决策不稳定性
translation.abstract: 奖励模型和LLM裁判通常被量化到4比特以使大量候选打分保持可负担，通常的检查是基准准确率几乎不变。这种检查近乎失明。在来自两个家族（0.6B-8B）的八个奖励模型、三个生成式裁判和四种4比特量化器上，量化在RewardBench上改写了1.1-12.3%的成对偏好决策，而总体准确率变化可低至0.03分（p=1.00），因为它修复和引入的错误相互抵消。翻转集中在全精度边际相对量化噪声尺度sigma较小的位置：高斯近似Phi(-|m|/sigma)描述了总体翻转率，在全部30个标量设置中高估该率，且对生成式裁判失效；由此产生的脆弱性窗口的占用率随模型规模从25%降至7%，这正是小裁判脆弱的原因。在良性best-of-16下扰动保持在噪声范围内，而在对抗压力下某些量化器的翻转变得明显（一个家族146:54的有害:有益翻转，另一个家族符号反转）。在下游，它改变实际交付的结果：在来自两个家族的六个（模型，量化器）对上，14.6-65.7%的问题得到不同的best-of-64选择，而只有2.6-9.6%得到不同的最终答案，且每个对中选择的改变频率是答案的5-8倍；基准判定为相同的对（0.03分，p=1.00）仍改变了34.5%的选择。基准扰动率能对该下游变化排序（rho=0.89），而基准准确率不能可靠排序。留出审计表明有用的诊断在于边际而非高斯：每个基于边际的预测器对翻转的排序完全一致（AUC 0.927），且在分布内直接测量的扰动率最优。作为路由信号，它与简单的top-k相当。贡献在于刻画本身，而非模型。
translation.brief: 解决4比特量化奖励模型在基准准确率几乎不变时仍大量改写偏好决策的问题，通过边际相对量化噪声的高斯刻画识别并系统表征“脆弱性窗口”。

papers.title: Co-Evolving Behavioral Agents and Detectors for Adaptive Information Operations
papers.abstract: Detectors of state-sponsored information operations (IOs) are trained on campaigns that platforms have already taken down. They lose much of their accuracy on an actor they have not seen, even though no operator in the archived data is trying to avoid them. A real operator wants two things, to reach an audience and to avoid being caught. We present IO-AI, a framework that gives simulated agents these two capabilities, engagement and evasion, and tests what each one does to detection. The agents are built from the posting behavior of real campaigns and choose the emotion, type, and timing of each post. An agent and a detector then train against each other in turn. We rank the trained agents by how hard they are to detect and train one detector on them from easiest to hardest. On 20 Twitter IO campaigns, this detector reduces missed detections of adaptive agents by 65% relative to a detector trained only on the archived campaigns, at a similar false-alarm rate. On actors it has never seen it reaches an F1 of 0.81, against 0.62. We find that an agent trained to seek engagement becomes easier to catch, because it learns the fast, emotional retweeting that archived campaigns were caught producing. An agent that was trained for engagement before the game keeps its engagement lead after it learns to evade. We also introduce a behavioral distance metric that compares two groups of accounts using only their unlabeled posting histories. The larger the distance between two groups, the worse a detector trained on one does on the other (Spearman rho = -0.58), so the metric can be used to choose which new groups to test first.

translation.title: 协同演化行为智能体与检测器以实现自适应信息作战
translation.abstract: 针对国家支持的信息作战（IO）的检测器是在平台已下架的战役数据上训练的，即使存档数据中的操作者并未刻意规避检测，这些检测器在面对未见过的操作者时准确率也会大幅下降。而真实的操作者有两个目标：触达受众并避免被抓。我们提出IO-AI框架，赋予模拟智能体这两种能力——互动性（engagement）与规避性（evasion），并测试每种能力对检测的影响。智能体基于真实战役的发帖行为构建，可选择每条帖子的情绪、类型和发布时机。随后智能体与检测器交替对抗训练。我们按检测难度对训练后的智能体排序，并按从易到难的顺序训练一个检测器。在20个Twitter信息作战战役上，该检测器将自适应智能体的漏检率相对仅用存档战役训练的检测器降低了65%，误报率相近；在从未见过的操作者上F1达到0.81，而基线为0.62。我们发现，以追求互动为目标的智能体反而更容易被抓，因为它学会了存档战役中被抓时表现出的快速、情绪化转发行为；而在对抗博弈前已训练出互动能力的智能体，在学会规避后仍保持其互动优势。我们还提出一种行为距离度量，仅用无标签的发帖历史比较两组账号。两组间距离越大，用其中一组训练的检测器在另一组上表现越差（Spearman rho = -0.58），因此该度量可用于优先选择需要测试的新群体。
translation.brief: 针对信息作战检测器难以应对会规避检测的自适应操作者的问题，提出IO-AI框架，让基于真实战役行为构建的智能体与检测器交替对抗训练以提升检测能力。

papers.title: From Acting to Learning: Experience Selection toward Continually Learning Agents
papers.abstract: Successful agent interactions provide training data, but success alone does not determine which records a student should learn from. We examine experience selection for a 4B language agent as a component of continual agent learning. Nine selectors are compared across two fixed experience pools, eight initialization seeds, and two sampling seeds, yielding 288 trained students. Each student is evaluated on 128 development task groups with a common executor. With equal global selection freedom, 256 distinct contents, and 768 training presentations, optimizer-aware gradient selection reaches 81.45\% and 73.19\% success in the two pools. Its gains over global random selection are 8.25 and 5.96 percentage points; gains over global high-NLL selection are 4.10 and 4.05 points. All eight initialization-level contrasts are positive against both baselines in each pool. Relaxing coverage constraints improves gradient selection but reduces random-selection performance, showing that the ranking rule and selection space must be considered together. A separately frozen replication on 128 reserved task groups is complete; its equal-source gradient-minus-random and gradient-minus-high-NLL differences are +7.03 and +5.03 points, respectively.

translation.title: 从行动到学习：面向持续学习智能体的经验选择
translation.abstract: 成功的智能体交互可以提供训练数据，但仅凭成功并不能决定学生应从哪些记录中学习。我们将经验选择作为4B语言智能体持续学习的一个组成部分进行研究。在两个固定经验池、八个初始化种子和两个采样种子下比较九种选择器，共训练288个学生。每个学生在128个开发任务组上用统一执行器评估。在全局选择自由度相同、256条不同内容、768次训练呈现的条件下，优化器感知的梯度选择在两个经验池中分别达到81.45%和73.19%的成功率，相对全局随机选择的提升为8.25和5.96个百分点，相对全局高NLL选择的提升为4.10和4.05个百分点。在两个经验池中，全部八个初始化层级的对比均优于两个基线。放宽覆盖约束可提升梯度选择的表现，但会降低随机选择的表现，说明排序规则与选择空间必须一并考虑。在128个保留任务组上完成了独立冻结的复现实验，其同源梯度减随机、梯度减高NLL的差异分别为+7.03和+5.03个百分点。
translation.brief: 研究持续学习智能体中应从哪些成功交互记录中学习的问题，提出优化器感知的梯度经验选择方法并系统比较九种选择器。

papers.title: Mem-X: A Memory-Dependent Cross-Episode Benchmark for Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Long-term memory enables embodied agents to reuse past observations across tasks. However, existing cross-episode vision-and-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks often leave it unclear whether successful navigation relies on historical memory or current exploration. We introduce Mem-X, a benchmark designed to evaluate memory-dependent cross-episode VLN. Mem-X organizes episodes into sessions in which subsequent instructions refer to objects or routes encountered in earlier episodes. Its three levels evaluate historical-object recall, in-memory localization and episodic indexing, and off-memory relocalization and historical-route reproduction. For the latter two levels, agents receive episode-local poses but no transformations between episode frames, requiring them to establish spatial correspondence with historical memory. Mem-X comprises 2,071 episodes across 710 sessions in 34 scenes, including 1,204 memory-dependent episodes. We also provide MemBridge, a modular baseline that combines semantic scene memory, cross-episode localization, and coarse-to-fine retrieval to support existing VLN agents. Experiments with state-of-the-art VLN methods demonstrate the benefits of MemBridge while revealing substantial room for improvement on memory-dependent navigation. The benchmark and baseline code are available at this https URL.

translation.title: Mem-X：面向视觉语言导航的记忆依赖跨回合基准
translation.abstract: 长期记忆使具身智能体能够跨任务复用过去的观察。然而，现有的跨回合视觉语言导航（VLN）基准往往无法明确成功导航究竟依赖历史记忆还是当前探索。我们提出Mem-X，一个用于评估记忆依赖跨回合VLN的基准。Mem-X将回合组织成会话，其中后续指令会引用先前回合中遇到的物体或路线。其三个层级分别评估历史物体回忆、记忆内定位与情景索引，以及脱离记忆的重定位与历史路线复现。对于后两个层级，智能体只能获得回合内的局部位姿而没有回合坐标系间的变换，需要其与历史记忆建立空间对应关系。Mem-X包含34个场景中710个会话的2,071个回合，其中1,204个为记忆依赖回合。我们还提供MemBridge，一个结合语义场景记忆、跨回合定位和由粗到细检索的模块化基线，以支持现有VLN智能体。用最先进VLN方法进行的实验展示了MemBridge的收益，同时揭示了记忆依赖导航仍有巨大改进空间。基准和基线代码见此URL。
translation.brief: 针对现有VLN基准无法区分导航成功是靠历史记忆还是当前探索的问题，构建记忆依赖的跨回合基准Mem-X及模块化基线MemBridge。

papers.title: Learning Adaptive Defense Strategies: Fine-Tuned LLMs for Network Security Games under Network Mobility
papers.abstract: Large language models(LLM) show promise for strategic reasoning, yet their ability to compute game-theoretic equilibria under dynamic conditions remains largely unexplored. This work investigates whether fine-tuned LLMs can serve as solver-free surrogates for online equilibrium computation in honeypot allocation, a setting in which network mobility continuously reshapes the underlying attack graph and forces repeated re-solving of a two-player zero-sum game. We construct a dataset of 270 security games on networks of 8--25 nodes with solver-grounded equilibrium labels, and evaluate four classes of predictor over 1{,}524 held-out mobility events: non-learned baselines, six open-weight architectures evaluated zero-shot, the same six after LoRA fine-tuning, and four proprietary models as an external reference point. Predictions are scored without post-hoc repair against exact game-theoretic criteria: exploitability against an optimal attacker best-response, equilibrium support accuracy, and distributional distance. Fine-tuning reduces exploitability across every architecture, and fine-tuned open-weight models of modest size outperform every zero-shot predictor, including proprietary ones; no zero-shot model at any tier reaches the floor set by uniform allocation. Stratifying by mobility type exposes a qualitative shift that aggregate metrics conceal: zero-shot models do not condition on whether a departing node lies on an attack path, while fine-tuned models recover this distinction. We further find that validation loss is negatively rank-correlated with task performance, and that output validity, rather than predictive accuracy, is the binding constraint on further progress.

translation.title: 学习自适应防御策略：网络移动性下网络安全博弈的微调LLM
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在策略推理方面展现出潜力，但其在动态条件下计算博弈论均衡的能力在很大程度上尚未被探索。本工作研究微调后的LLM能否作为无求解器的在线均衡计算替代方案，应用于蜜罐分配场景——该场景中网络移动性持续重塑底层攻击图，迫使其反复重新求解一个双人零和博弈。我们构建了包含270个安全博弈的数据集，网络规模为8至25个节点，并带有基于求解器的均衡标签；在1,524个留出的移动性事件上评估四类预测器：非学习基线、六个开源权重架构的零样本评估、经LoRA微调后的同样六个架构，以及四个专有模型作为外部参照。预测结果不做事后修复，直接按精确的博弈论标准评分：相对最优攻击者最佳响应的可利用性、均衡支撑集准确率和分布距离。微调降低了所有架构的可利用性，且中等规模的开源微调模型优于所有零样本预测器，包括专有模型；任何层级的零样本模型都未达到均匀分配设定的下限。按移动性类型分层分析揭示了总体指标掩盖的质变：零样本模型不区分离开节点是否位于攻击路径上，而微调模型能恢复这一区分。我们进一步发现验证损失与任务性能呈负秩相关，且输出有效性而非预测准确性是进一步进展的约束瓶颈。
translation.brief: 研究LLM能否在网络移动性下动态变化的蜜罐分配零和博弈中充当无求解器的均衡计算替代，通过LoRA微调开源模型并按博弈论指标评估。

papers.title: What Does Matching a Human Intervention Effect Establish? Benchmark Checks for LLM Simulations
papers.abstract: LLM simulations are validated by equivalence with human effects, yet a zero reference passes whenever the human 90 percent interval lies inside the margin, as the human benchmark shows before simulation. When the zero reference fails, planned precision gives independent simulations the margin up to which passing is a 5 percent test of response. In an exploratory 70-experiment reanalysis, 72 percent of GPT-4's $\pm$0.20 SD passes were zero-reference passes; GPT-4 passed 16 contrasts the zero reference failed (1.58 expected without response). In a preregistered audit, Claude Sonnet 5.5 passed three intention targets, all zero-reference passes, and the registered belief-gradient control; norm beliefs changed 0.065 SD against humans' 0.351 (zero-reference check added after unblinding; norm beliefs emphasized after inspection). Registered tests detected no overestimation; average-effect intervals excluded overestimation above 0.08 SD. A group audit's precision floor is 1.33 facts against a 2.9-fact effect. Report the zero-reference threshold beside every equivalence decision.

translation.title: 匹配人类干预效应的验证能确立什么？LLM模拟的基准检验
translation.abstract: LLM模拟通过与人类效应的等价性来验证，然而当人类90%置信区间落在容差范围内时，零参照检验总会通过，正如人类基准在模拟之前就已显示的那样。当零参照检验失败时，按计划的精度，独立模拟获得的容差使得通过检验成为对响应的5%显著性检验。在一项探索性的70个实验再分析中，GPT-4的±0.20 SD通过中有72%是零参照通过；GPT-4通过了16个零参照检验失败的对比（若无响应预期为1.58个）。在一项预注册审计中，Claude Sonnet 5.5通过了三个意向目标，全部为零参照通过，并通过了注册的信念梯度对照；规范信念变化为0.065 SD，而人类为0.351（零参照检验在揭盲后加入；规范信念在检查后予以强调）。注册检验未发现高估；平均效应区间排除了超过0.08 SD的高估。群体审计的精度下限为1.33个事实，而效应为2.9个事实。应在每个等价性判定旁报告零参照阈值。
translation.brief: 研究LLM模拟与人类效应的等价性验证中零参照检验的失效问题，提出应将零参照阈值作为基准检验纳入等价性判定。

papers.title: EDAGoat: An EDA-Aware Agent for Project-Level GPU Optimization
papers.abstract: GPU acceleration has transformed electronic design automation (EDA), yet further improving expert-engineered GPU tools still demands substantial manual effort. Automating this work calls for coding agents that can trace bottlenecks across host and device code while preserving correctness and design quality. We introduce EDAGoat, to our knowledge the first EDA-aware GPU optimization agent for this task. Its optimization enhancement (OE) mode guides edits with four cross-project GPU optimization patterns. Its mandatory validation (MV) mode requires the agent to test the edited program against the EDA constraints its changes could affect. Our benchmark covers five GPU EDA projects across four task families and 55 circuit inputs, measuring complete-solve runtime and verifying the resulting designs. Each configuration runs three independent searches per project. A search qualifies only if its solver passes correctness and design-quality checks on all public and hidden inputs. With DeepSeek, generic prompting qualifies in 7 of 15 searches and OE in 6 of 15, despite a higher best speedup on four projects. Adding MV raises this to 13 of 15 and, on every project, exceeds both generic baselines in mean and best speedup and OE in mean speedup; the geometric mean of per-project mean speedups rises from 1.11x (1.36x with OE) to 1.53x. With GPT-6 Astra, EDAGoat qualifies in all 15 searches and improves both speedup metrics over generic prompting on every project, lifting the same geometric mean from 1.26x to 1.57x. These results show that agents can use EDA knowledge to find further speedups in expert-tuned tools while preserving design correctness and quality, establishing EDA-aware GPU optimization as a new direction for agent research.

papers.title: Improved Accuracy Scaling with Problem Complexity in LLM Arithmetic Reasoning Using Executable Symbolic Representations
papers.abstract: High accuracy on mathematical benchmarks does not establish whether reasoning remains reliable as problem complexity increases. We examine how executable symbolic representations change accuracy scaling in large language models compared with natural-language reasoning. To address this limitation, we introduce the GSM Arithmetic Benchmark (GSM-AB), a controlled benchmark that independently varies operand digit length and operation count to probe numerical scale and compositional complexity. We find that executable representations can improve accuracy and slow its decline as complexity increases. Lean reduces average sensitivity to operand digit length at every tested model size. By contrast, slower degradation with increasing operation count emerges at the larger model sizes. A Python program-of-thought (Python-PoT) control shows a similar operation-axis pattern, suggesting that this finding is not specific to Lean. These findings show that reasoning representation shapes arithmetic accuracy scaling and support executable symbolic representations for more reliable reasoning on complex arithmetic tasks.

papers.title: Explicit Style Extraction for Personalized Long-Form Text Generation
papers.abstract: Personalized long-form generation asks a language model to write new text the way a specific user would. The standard recipe, retrieval-augmented generation, places a few of the user's past texts in the prompt but leaves the model to decide what to take from them. We introduce StylePrism, a taxonomy of 28 stylistic aspects in seven categories, and SP-Refine, an inference-time method that makes style extraction an explicit step: the model first fills StylePrism with the user's patterns, quoted evidence, and habits to avoid, then drafts from the user's samples and revises the draft twice against this profile, guided by its own style scores. On the three long-form tasks of LongLaMP with three LLMs, SP-Refine outperforms LongLaMP's retrieval-augmented baseline in 25 of 27 ROUGE and METEOR comparisons, by 10.2% on average and by up to 35.8%. Annotating users' own texts with the extracted profiles shows that StylePrism captures concrete, checkable habits, from the order of rhetorical moves to a reviewer's sign-off. Ablations show that the profile helps as revision guidance, not as a replacement for the samples: writing from the profile alone is worse in all 27 comparisons, while a single implicit-inference call is a cheaper alternative that comes close. Oracle variants that let the reviser see the reference, together with reference-free controls, show that larger refinement gains require information unavailable at inference time.

papers.title: Correct Precedents Induce Policy Violations in On-Device LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Local-cloud agent systems pair a cloud model with a small on-device agent that acts on private data, often as the last check before an irreversible action. We identify, for the first time, a failure in which such an agent is led into a violation by its own correct decisions within a session. After it correctly releases an item whose restriction was lifted, it becomes more likely to release the next item that is still restricted. Because the trigger is a correct decision, a history with no faulty step can still end in a violation. We call this failure correct-precedent generalization and find it in 13 open-weight models from nine developers. A single correct precedent can cut the safe rate of the most affected agent roughly in half, and the risk compounds when a refused request is simply sent again in a new session. Interventions on the agent's history indicate that it carries its decision on the released item over to the restricted one instead of checking that item's status. Building on this finding, we propose Paired Decision Distillation (PDD), which distills the decisions of a weakly affected teacher into a LoRA adapter. PDD restores the safe rate to nearly 100% in every distilled model, without extra prompt text or model calls.

papers.title: MSRyzen: An Agentic Platform for Unified Proteomics Analysis and Evidence-Centric Visualization
papers.abstract: Mass spectrometry (MS)-based proteomics is essential for comprehensive protein characterization, yet it relies on multistep computational workflows that typically demand tedious manual parameter tuning and complex software integration. Here, we present MSRyzen, an agent-driven framework that provides automated parameter optimization and extensible tool integration across bottom-up and top-down proteomics workflows. MSRyzen translates natural-language prompts into directed acyclic workflow graphs, optimizes analytical parameters guided by quantitative metrics and user-defined objectives, and incorporates new third-party software through standardized callable interfaces. Across four public top-down datasets, automated parameter optimization increased proteoform identifications by 3.6% to 15.8% compared to default settings at a 1% false discovery rate. To ensure transparent data interpretation, an interactive visualization interface coordinates identification metrics with peak-level spectral evidence and sequence coverage. Integrating adaptive tuning with multi-tiered spectral inspection, MSRyzen delivers an end-to-end, fully automated framework, dramatically reducing the operational barrier to modern mass spectrometry data analysis.

papers.title: Suspected Until Inspected: Neuro-Symbolic Detection of Broken Access Control in Server-Side Web Applications
papers.abstract: Broken access control (BAC) has topped the OWASP Top 10 since 2021. Unfortunately, a decade of detectors still leaves a gap on every front. Static analyzers are tied to one language or framework, dynamic testers cover only the endpoints they manage to exercise, and LLM-based auditors leave the final verdict to an error-prone model. In this paper, we design and implement FLINT, a neuro-symbolic framework that detects BAC in server-side web applications without language- or framework-specific rules. Our key insight is to separate the proposal from the verdict -- an LLM may flag any data access as needing a guard, but only a symbolically verified check can clear it. The neural component enumerates every endpoint and distills each, via demand-driven code slicing, into an authorization certificate whose claims are all grounded in cited code. The symbolic component verifies each claimed check through origin tracing and a lattice-based interprocedural dataflow analysis, so that no access is cleared on the model's word. When applied to popular real-world open-source applications, including Gitea, Grafana, and Strapi, FLINT detected 112 zero-day, exploitable BAC vulnerabilities, 30 of them in projects with over 20,000 GitHub stars. We have responsibly disclosed all of them to the developers. Mattermost, for example, has already confirmed our report and is assigning a CVE identifier.

papers.title: Do Companies Deliver on Their IPO Claims?
papers.abstract: Initial public offering (IPO) filings describe what a company does and what it intends to become. Yet whether individual forward-looking claims are subsequently realized is difficult to assess. We introduce Vision Follow-Through (VFT), a benchmark and agentic pipeline that separates claim extraction, category assignment, verifiability, and evidence-grounded follow-through assessment. \vftclaims{} contains 5,066 human-annotated claim spans from 50 IPO filings, while \vftverify{} adds verifiability tiers, follow-through outcomes, and cited later evidence for 1,000 claims. Across language models, classifying human-annotated claims is substantially easier than extracting claims from full filings. Extraction coverage also varies sharply by category, with Organizational/Culture claims recovered far less often than Market Opportunity claims. Follow-through assessment poses a separate challenge: model judgments diverge from human assessments in different ways rather than exhibiting a single consistent bias. These results show that reliable assessment of corporate follow-through requires both finding the relevant claims and grounding subsequent judgments in later evidence.

papers.title: SIR-Agent: Skill-Augmented Image Restoration Agent with Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Agents for Image Restoration (IR) aim to leverage Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to autonomously perceive image degradation and invoke IR tools. However, existing IR agents typically rely on fine-tuning MLLM parameters to adapt to new IR tasks, leading to catastrophic forgetting of IR knowledge. To address this limitation, we propose a skill-augmented IR agent, dubbed SIR-Agent, that maintains IR knowledge in a scalable skill library and uses Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) to facilitate efficient skill-library evolution. Specifically, we design a Chain Feedback-driven Skill Revision (CFSR) to evolve the skill library. The CFSR analyzes restoration chains to identify and revise weak operations in existing skills. The compatibility of a revised skill with known tasks decides if it replaces the original skill or is appended independently. Furthermore, to advance CFSR's skill-library evolution, we present an RSI-driven skill meta-learning mechanism, which identifies CFSR's inefficient operations and autonomously refines its revision strategy. Extensive experiments across 14 IR benchmarks, covering 6 single-degradation and 8 mixed-degradation scenarios, demonstrate SIR-Agent's superior IR performance. Further evaluation on 7 unseen tasks validates SIR-Agent's generalization to new IR tasks.

papers.title: Belief-State Management Meets Rubric Rewards for Agentic Forecasting
papers.abstract: Current large language model (LLM) agents still struggle to forecast real-world events. This stems from two primary limitations: i) standard ReAct harness accumulates reasoning and evidence within one growing context, and ii) outcome-based rewards in forecasting lead to a slow and noisy signal that cannot distinguish sound reasoning from lucky guesses. To address these, we introduce a forecasting training framework including harness design and post-training. For the harness side, we propose Proactive Belief-State Management (PBM), equipping agents with a fold tool to compress lengthy context into compact belief states and reset the context for subsequent exploration. For the training side, we develop SEIPH, a five-dimensional, outcome-blind rubric, providing process-quality rewards. Using the rubric-based reward, we post-train a 35B model with PPO and GRPO, yielding DeepForecaster-PPO and DeepForecaster-GRPO. Theoretically, we prove that idealized fold-based stopping converges and calibrated local rewards reduce segment-level gradient variance. Empirically, DeepForecaster-PPO (35B) achieves the best Brier score on both ForecastBench and Polymarket-Sim, outperforming frontier agents based on DeepSeek-V4-Pro (1.6T), Kimi-K2.6 (1T), and GPT-5.5. DeepForecaster-GRPO ranks second on both FutureX metrics. Ablations reveal that PBM also improves the untrained base model without any training. Calibration analysis shows that DeepForecaster-PPO makes more accurate high-confidence predictions than Qwen3.6 and GPT-5.5. Trajectory analysis further shows that forecasts generally improve from the first to the final belief state as agents gather evidence and revise their judgments.

papers.title: HookEvo: A Framework for Coordinated Plugin Evolution on Hook-Enabled Agent Runtimes
papers.abstract: Repairing failures in tool-using agents can require coordinated changes to how the harness interprets tool receipts, assembles context, and checks actions. We introduce HookEvo, a framework that uses an existing agent runtime's lifecycle hooks to evolve task-specific harnesses. We instantiate HookEvo on DeepSeek Harness. In each round, a separate improver diagnoses failures from execution traces and proposes a candidate. HookEvo evaluates the candidate against the current harness on matched tasks and carries the retained version into the next round. A single candidate can jointly edit executable plugin handlers and the state they share within a task, allowing a tool receipt to inform context and control a later action. Using a frozen Qwen3-4B executor, the selected harnesses lead the reported Qwen3-4B comparisons, achieving 95.41% on ALFWorld, 70.56% on DBBench, 48.17% on WebShop, and 41.67% on OSBench. Across three improvers and three edit scopes, from skill text to single-component and coordinated executable edits, GPT-6.1 Sol shows the largest average gain from the broadest scope. Our code is available at this https URL.
