papers.title: Do Language Models Know Which Words Steer Their Reasoning?
papers.abstract: While chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits intermediate reasoning steps from language models, it is unclear which words in the context actually steer the CoT. We identify Phantom Context Influence (PCI): language models are disproportionately steered by semantically irrelevant context words, even as the same models deny those words' relevance when asked. To localize PCI, we introduce Leave-One-Out Word JSD analysis, which removes one context word at a time from the otherwise intact context to isolate its marginal effect on the next-token distribution; words whose removal flips the prediction (pivot words) are passed to the same LLM to self-judge whether it recognizes this predictive dependence. Across four models and three benchmarks, language models largely do not know which words steer their reasoning, a mismatch we call the Generation-Judgment Contradiction. Inspired by this phenomenon, we propose Online KV Suppression: it scores every prompt word's influence over the whole chain of thought in a single pass, then zeroes the KV-cache entries of the highest-influence word the model itself judges inert and redecodes. This single-word intervention improves CoT accuracy across four models and five reasoning benchmarks, by up to 8.9 percentage points on math reasoning benchmark.

translation.title: 语言模型知道哪些词在引导其推理吗？
translation.abstract: 尽管思维链（CoT）提示能让语言模型产生中间推理步骤，但上下文中哪些词真正引导了CoT仍不清楚。我们识别出幻影上下文影响（PCI）：语言模型会被语义无关的上下文词不成比例地引导，即使这些模型在被问及时否认这些词的相关性。为了定位PCI，我们提出留一词JSD分析（Leave-One-Out Word JSD），即从完整上下文中每次移除一个词，以隔离其对下一词分布的边际效应；将移除后会翻转预测的词（枢轴词）交给同一个LLM自我判断是否认识到这种预测依赖关系。在四个模型和三个基准上，语言模型在很大程度上不知道哪些词在引导其推理，我们将这种不匹配称为生成-判断矛盾。受此现象启发，我们提出在线KV抑制（Online KV Suppression）：它通过一次前向传播对每个提示词在整个思维链上的影响进行评分，然后将模型自身判定为惰性的最高影响词的KV-cache条目置零并重新解码。这种单词干预在四个模型和五个推理基准上提升了CoT准确率，在数学推理基准上最高提升8.9个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对语言模型被语义无关上下文词误导推理的问题，提出留一词JSD分析定位枢轴词，并通过在线KV抑制对最高影响词的KV-cache置零来提升CoT准确率。

papers.title: Cruella: A Unified Microscaling and Floating-Point Dot-Product Unit for LLM Inference on FPGAs
papers.abstract: The number formats that accelerators execute natively are fixed at fabrication, yet large language model (LLM) checkpoints are released with MXFP4 weights in the Microscaling (MX) formats standardized in 2023. FPGAs adopt new formats through bitstreams. However, to the best of our knowledge, no deployed FPGA LLM accelerator executes MXFP4 weights alongside BF16 products. We characterize the decoding of MXFP4 checkpoints, whose layers alternate between MXFP4$\times$BF16 products and BF16$\times$BF16 products of attention and BF16 layers. With a BF16 KV cache, BF16$\times$BF16 products take 56%-77% of the datapath time, during which a separate MXFP4 unit idles. We present Cruella, whose unified dot-product unit (UDPU) executes both product types on one DSP array and reduction pipeline. First, per-group pre-alignment keeps this pipeline at the BF16 width and changes perplexity by at most 0.7%. Second, pre-adder packing places two signed MXFP4$\times$BF16 products in one DSP48E2 multiplier with an exact correction. On an Alveo U55C, the UDPU needs 23% fewer DSP slices and 36% fewer LUTs than separate MXFP4 and BF16 units of equal throughput. On this board, MXFP4 weights speed up decoding by 1.15$\times$-1.87$\times$ over BF16 weights, and an NVIDIA A40 GPU decodes faster but spends 0.92$\times$-2.01$\times$ the board's energy per token.

translation.title: Cruella：面向FPGA上LLM推理的统一Microscaling与浮点点积单元
translation.abstract: 加速器原生执行的数字格式在制造时即已固定，然而大语言模型（LLM）检查点却以2023年标准化的Microscaling（MX）格式的MXFP4权重发布。FPGA可通过比特流采用新格式。然而，据我们所知，尚无已部署的FPGA LLM加速器能同时执行MXFP4权重与BF16乘积。我们刻画了MXFP4检查点的解码过程，其各层在MXFP4×BF16乘积与注意力及BF16层的BF16×BF16乘积之间交替。使用BF16 KV cache时，BF16×BF16乘积占数据通路时间的56%-77%，期间独立的MXFP4单元处于空闲。我们提出Cruella，其统一点积单元（UDPU）在一个DSP阵列和归约流水线上执行两种乘积类型。首先，逐组预对齐使该流水线保持BF16宽度，困惑度变化至多0.7%。其次，预加法器打包将两个有符号MXFP4×BF16乘积放入一个DSP48E2乘法器并带精确校正。在Alveo U55C上，UDPU比同等吞吐量的独立MXFP4和BF16单元少用23%的DSP切片和36%的LUT。在该板上，MXFP4权重使解码速度较BF16权重提升1.15×-1.87×，而NVIDIA A40 GPU解码更快但每token能耗为该板的0.92×-2.01×。
translation.brief: 针对FPGA上MXFP4与BF16乘积交替导致专用单元空闲的问题，设计统一点积单元UDPU在单一DSP阵列上执行两种乘积类型以提升LLM推理效率。

papers.title: Reasoning in Fewer Tokens: Concept-Normalized Multilingual Scratchpads and Reversible Model-Adaptive Reasoning Codes
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought prompting significantly improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) but incurs high inference costs due to lengthy autoregressive decoding. While previous efficiency approaches reduce costs by discarding tokens or utilizing continuous latent representations, these lossy methods fundamentally sacrifice interpretability and auditability. In this work, we introduce a novel compression framework for intermediate reasoning. We apply Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) to reasoning corpora to learn a compressed vocabulary of Private Use Area (PUA) tokens, each representing frequent semantic spans. After expanding the LLM's vocabulary, we fine-tune the model via strictly 1:1, our method is lossless. We evaluate our approach on Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-14B, and Qwen2.5-32B across four diverse benchmarks. Our method reduces total generated tokens by 14.7% on average with reasoning trace lengths dropping by up to 27.1%, while incurring a negligible average accuracy cost of 1.6 percentage points. Crucially, this approach is orthogonal to existing lossy methods, allowing practitioners to stack lossless and irreversible compression techniques. We demonstrate that a compressed intermediate language provides a highly efficient computational resource that accelerates inference while fully preserving the transparency of LLM reasoning.

translation.title: 用更少token推理：概念归一化的多语言草稿板与可逆的模型自适应推理编码
translation.abstract: 思维链提示显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但由于冗长的自回归解码而带来高昂的推理成本。以往的效率方法通过丢弃token或使用连续潜在表示来降低成本，这些有损方法从根本上牺牲了可解释性和可审计性。在本工作中，我们提出一种新颖的中间推理压缩框架。我们对推理语料应用字节对编码（BPE）来学习由私有使用区（PUA）token组成的压缩词表，每个token代表频繁的语义片段。在扩展LLM词表后，我们通过严格1:1的方式微调模型，因此本方法是无损的。我们在Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-14B和Qwen2.5-32B上于四个多样化基准上评估该方法。我们的方法平均减少14.7%的总生成token，推理轨迹长度最多下降27.1%，而平均准确率损失仅1.6个百分点，可忽略不计。至关重要的是，该方法与现有有损方法正交，使从业者可以叠加无损与有损压缩技术。我们证明压缩的中间语言提供了一种高效的计算资源，能在完全保留LLM推理透明性的同时加速推理。
translation.brief: 针对CoT推理token开销大的问题，用BPE学习PUA压缩词表并1:1微调模型，实现无损的推理token压缩。

papers.title: Zing-1.0: A Playable World System Built on Controllable Rendering
papers.abstract: We present Zing-1.0, a Playable World System built on Controllable Rendering. An executable engine resolves player actions under the world's rules and produces proxy video from the updated state. A streaming video model synthesizes the player's view from this proxy, and the runtime delivers it to inform subsequent actions. (1) Principle and system. We formulate Controllable Rendering and define the interfaces among world construction, world execution, observation synthesis, and the interaction runtime. To our knowledge, this is the first implementation-independent specification of a Playable World System. (2) AI-native engine. WorldKit provides structured authoring tools and reusable character, camera, and control components for coding agents to construct executable proxy worlds. It supports extensible interactions and precise geometric motion control while separating executable behavior from final visual appearance. (3) Streaming renderer. We adapt MiniMax-H3 for block-causal autoregressive generation and incremental decoding. Proxy video constrains structure and motion, while text and separate scene and subject references specify appearance. We train the generator on diverse tasks and distill it to generate each block in a few denoising steps. The renderer leads the compared streaming editors on OpenVE (3.90) and LongV2VBench (3.44). On StreamEval, Zing-1.0 scores 57.86 on instruction editing and 54.06 on reference editing, exceeding the published baselines on both tracks. (4) Interaction infrastructure. We build an Interaction Runtime that routes player actions to WorldKit while supporting in-play prompt and reference updates. Cross-block joint execution and sparse attention with compressed K/V reduce inference overhead. With the DiT on a single H200 and encoding and decoding on one H100 each, the serving system achieves a steady-state throughput of 23.82 FPS at $832\times480$.

translation.title: Zing-1.0：基于可控渲染的可玩世界系统
translation.abstract: 我们提出Zing-1.0，一个基于可控渲染（Controllable Rendering）的可玩世界系统（Playable World System）。可执行引擎在世界规则下解析玩家动作，并根据更新后的状态生成代理视频。流式视频模型根据该代理合成玩家视角，运行时将其交付以指导后续动作。（1）原理与系统。我们形式化可控渲染，并定义世界构建、世界执行、观测合成与交互运行时之间的接口。据我们所知，这是首个与实现无关的可玩世界系统规范。（2）AI原生引擎。WorldKit为编码智能体提供结构化创作工具以及可复用的角色、相机和控制组件，用于构建可执行的代理世界。它支持可扩展的交互和精确的几何运动控制，同时将可执行行为与最终视觉外观分离。（3）流式渲染器。我们改造MiniMax-H3以支持块因果自回归生成和增量解码。代理视频约束结构与运动，而文本以及独立的场景和主体参考指定外观。我们在多样化任务上训练生成器，并将其蒸馏为每个块仅需少量去噪步骤。该渲染器在OpenVE（3.90）和LongV2VBench（3.44）上领先于所比较的流式编辑器。在StreamEval上，Zing-1.0在指令编辑上得57.86分、参考编辑上得54.06分，均超过已发布的基线。（4）交互基础设施。我们构建了交互运行时（Interaction Runtime），将玩家动作路由到WorldKit，同时支持游玩中的提示和参考更新。跨块联合执行和带压缩K/V的稀疏注意力降低了推理开销。DiT部署在单个H200上，编码和解码各用一个H100，服务系统在832×480分辨率下达到23.82 FPS的稳态吞吐量。
translation.brief: 针对可玩世界系统缺乏统一规范的问题，提出可控渲染框架，结合WorldKit引擎与流式视频渲染器实现可交互的实时世界生成。

papers.title: Dual-Agent DRL based Cooperative Beamforming and Trajectory Optimization for UAV-ISAC Networks
papers.abstract: This paper considers a low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) network, where multiple ground base stations (BSs) provide integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) services for multiple communication UAVs (C-UAVs) and sensing UAVs (S-UAVs). With the objective of maximizing the average sum rate of C-UAVs over the entire flight episode, we jointly optimize the multi-BS multi-UAV ISAC beamforming and trajectory design, subject to the BS transmit power budget and the sensing signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) constraints of S-UAVs, as well as the flight mission and collision avoidance constraints of C-UAVs and S-UAVs. Based on the multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) technique, we develop a dual-agent scheme, termed DeepDA-OPT, to solve the resulting constrained Markov decision process (MDP). In the proposed DeepDA-OPT scheme, two agents, i.e., Agent-B and Agent-T, are specifically deployed for learning the multi-BS ISAC transmit beamformers and the C-UAV/S-UAV trajectories, respectively, where the optimal BS receive beamformers for the sensing echo signals of S-UAVs are obtained in closed form by leveraging the generalized Rayleigh quotient theorem. To mitigate the overestimation of value functions, both Agent-B and Agent-T are trained based on the twin-delayed deep deterministic (TD3) policy-gradient algorithm. In addition, a constraint-aware noise exploration policy is employed, and the reward function is designed to incorporate a sensing penalty and a flight urgency penalty, thereby guiding the training of Agent-B and Agent-T. Numerical results show that, compared with the baseline schemes, the proposed DeepDA-OPT scheme achieves a higher average sum rate of C-UAVs, while the sensing SINR constraints are empirically well satisfied and no collision violation is observed under the evaluated settings.

translation.title: 基于双智能体DRL的UAV-ISAC网络协作波束赋形与轨迹优化
translation.abstract: 本文考虑一个低空无人机（UAV）网络，其中多个地面基站（BS）为多个通信无人机（C-UAV）和感知无人机（S-UAV）提供通感一体化（ISAC）服务。以最大化整个飞行周期内C-UAV的平均和速率为目标，我们联合优化多BS多UAV的ISAC波束赋形与轨迹设计，约束条件包括BS发射功率预算、S-UAV的感知信干噪比（SINR）约束，以及C-UAV和S-UAV的飞行任务与避碰约束。基于多智能体深度强化学习（MADRL）技术，我们提出一种双智能体方案DeepDA-OPT来求解由此产生的约束马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。在所提出的DeepDA-OPT方案中，两个智能体即Agent-B和Agent-T分别用于学习多BS的ISAC发射波束赋形器和C-UAV/S-UAV的轨迹，其中S-UAV感知回波信号的最优BS接收波束赋形器通过广义瑞利商定理以闭式获得。为缓解价值函数的过估计，Agent-B和Agent-T均基于双延迟深度确定性（TD3）策略梯度算法训练。此外，采用约束感知的噪声探索策略，并将感知惩罚和飞行紧急惩罚纳入奖励函数设计，从而引导Agent-B和Agent-T的训练。数值结果表明，与基线方案相比，所提出的DeepDA-OPT方案实现了更高的C-UAV平均和速率，同时感知SINR约束在经验上得到良好满足，且在所评估的设置下未观察到碰撞违规。
translation.brief: 针对UAV-ISAC网络中多BS波束赋形与多UAV轨迹联合优化问题，提出基于TD3的双智能体MADRL方案DeepDA-OPT进行求解。

papers.title: Breaking the Long Horizon: Short-Horizon Process Supervision for Long-Form Generation in LLMs
papers.abstract: Long-form generation is increasingly important for agentic LLM systems, yet current reinforcement learning methods typically optimize an entire document with a single outcome-level reward. This delayed and coarse-grained supervision makes it difficult to localize errors and assign credit across semantically distinct parts of the output. To address this, we propose a short-horizon framework that reformulates long-form generation through semantic decomposition into segment-level decisions. Each segment is generated with prefix-conditioned context, allowing cross-segment coherence to be preserved while keeping supervision local. The generated segments are then scored with rubric-based rewards for adherence, coherence, and relevance, enabling explicit local supervision at the segment level. These local rewards are used to compute step-wise advantages, yielding localized policy updates. To isolate the effect of supervision granularity, we instantiate both outcome-level supervision and our short-horizon process reward method (SH-PRM) under the same GRPO framework. Across multiple LLMs and two long-form generation benchmarks, SH-PRM consistently outperforms outcome-level supervision and strong inference-time baselines under the same optimizer and comparable budgets. Further analyses suggest that these gains primarily arise from improved credit assignment. Overall, our results suggest that aligning supervision granularity with the semantic structure of long-form generation is an effective design principle for long-form LLM training.

translation.title: 突破长时程：面向LLM长文本生成的短时程过程监督
translation.abstract: 长文本生成对智能体化LLM系统日益重要，但当前的强化学习方法通常用单一结果级奖励优化整篇文档。这种延迟且粗粒度的监督使得难以定位错误并在输出中语义不同的部分之间分配功劳。为此，我们提出一个短时程框架，通过语义分解将长文本生成重新表述为段级决策。每个段在以前缀条件化上下文的情况下生成，从而在保持监督局部化的同时保留跨段连贯性。随后使用基于评分准则的奖励对生成的段进行评分，涵盖遵循性、连贯性和相关性，实现段级的显式局部监督。这些局部奖励用于计算逐步优势，产生局部化的策略更新。为隔离监督粒度的影响，我们在相同的GRPO框架下同时实例化结果级监督和我们的短时程过程奖励方法（SH-PRM）。在多个LLM和两个长文本生成基准上，在相同优化器和可比预算下，SH-PRM始终优于结果级监督和强大的推理时基线。进一步分析表明，这些提升主要来自改进的功劳分配。总体而言，我们的结果表明，使监督粒度与长文本生成的语义结构对齐是长文本LLM训练的有效设计原则。
translation.brief: 针对长文本生成中结果级奖励监督粗粒度、难以分配功劳的问题，提出将生成语义分解为段级决策并用基于评分准则的局部过程奖励（SH-PRM）进行段级监督的方法。

papers.title: EcomWriteBench: A Real-World Benchmark for E-commerce Writing Tasks
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used throughout e-commerce workflows to generate content that informs purchasing decisions and supports customer interactions. Evaluating these systems requires accounting for user needs, product evidence, structural constraints, and business requirements that are not fully captured by general-purpose writing benchmarks. We introduce EcomWriteBench, a real-world benchmark containing 3,861 queries from 69 e-commerce writing tasks across 13 categories and five languages. Through task-level extraction, cross-task consolidation, and refinement guided by human feedback, EcomWriteBench constructs a shared pool of 37 abilities and identifies the subset applicable to each task. Ability-wise scoring enables us to compare state-of-the-art LLMs on EcomWriteBench and characterize their relative strengths and weaknesses across fine-grained e-commerce writing abilities. We further propose a preference-calibrated weight-learning framework that converts human pairwise preferences into interpretable scoring rubrics through global, category-level, and task-level aggregation weights. This framework provides a reusable approach for translating human preferences into automated evaluation by combining ability discovery, ability-wise scoring, and preference-calibrated aggregation, and can potentially be applied to a broad range of benchmarks beyond EcomWriteBench. On held-out queries, our scoring framework achieves 88.96% agreement with human preferences, compared with 78.54% for conventional LLM-as-a-judge scoring.

translation.title: EcomWriteBench：面向电商写作任务的真实世界基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在电商工作流中被越来越多地用于生成影响购买决策和支持客户互动的内容。评估这些系统需要考虑用户需求、产品证据、结构约束和业务要求，而通用写作基准无法完全涵盖这些因素。我们提出EcomWriteBench，一个真实世界基准，包含来自13个类别、五种语言的69个电商写作任务的3,861条查询。通过任务级抽取、跨任务整合以及由人类反馈引导的精炼，EcomWriteBench构建了一个包含37项能力的共享能力池，并识别出适用于每个任务的能力子集。基于能力的评分使我们能够在EcomWriteBench上比较最先进的LLM，并刻画它们在细粒度电商写作能力上的相对优劣。我们进一步提出一个偏好校准的权重学习框架，通过全局、类别级和任务级聚合权重将人类成对偏好转换为可解释的评分准则。该框架通过结合能力发现、基于能力的评分和偏好校准聚合，提供了一种将人类偏好转化为自动化评估的可复用方法，并有望应用于EcomWriteBench之外的广泛基准。在留出查询上，我们的评分框架与人类偏好的一致率达到88.96%，而传统LLM-as-a-judge评分为78.54%。
translation.brief: 针对通用写作基准无法评估电商写作任务的问题，构建了多语言电商写作基准EcomWriteBench，并提出基于能力评分与偏好校准权重学习的自动评估框架。

papers.title: Testing for Coordination Failures in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Deep parallel cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (CMARL)} trains multiple agents that all act at every time step to optimize a common objective. Like single-agent RL, CMARL can produce unsafe behaviors that violate implicit safety requirements not captured by the reward, and these behaviors are hard to explain. However, testing CMARL policies for safety has received less attention than the safety testing of single-agent RL policies. In this paper, we propose DisQ, a test case selection method that identifies failure-revealing states in value-based CMARL by exploiting a signal specific to trained Q-learning agents. The signal is the Q-value gap, an explainable metric that flags a state when the agents' estimates of the achievable return diverge by more than a calibrated threshold. DisQ selects such states for execution and skips those without a gap. Our experiments in four CMARL benchmark environments show that, in most of the evaluated configurations, DisQ improves failure detection over single-agent RL testing methods applied to CMARL, namely random testing and search-based testing with genetic algorithms. Our main contributions are the Q-value gap, an indicator of potential miscoordination computable from a single state without executing the system, and DisQ, a test case selection method that adapts existing single-agent testing methods to CMARL.

translation.title: 协作式多智能体强化学习中的协调失效测试
translation.abstract: 深度并行协作式多智能体强化学习（CMARL）训练多个在每个时间步都采取行动的智能体以优化共同目标。与单智能体RL一样，CMARL可能产生违反奖励未涵盖的隐式安全要求的不安全行为，且这些行为难以解释。然而，与单智能体RL策略的安全测试相比，CMARL策略的安全测试受到的关注较少。本文提出DisQ，一种测试用例选择方法，通过利用训练后的Q-learning智能体特有的信号来识别基于价值的CMARL中揭示失效的状态。该信号是Q值差距，一种可解释的指标，当智能体对可实现回报的估计分歧超过校准阈值时标记该状态。DisQ选择此类状态执行，并跳过没有差距的状态。我们在四个CMARL基准环境中的实验表明，在大多数评估配置中，DisQ在失效检测上优于应用于CMARL的单智能体RL测试方法，即随机测试和基于遗传算法的搜索测试。我们的主要贡献是Q值差距——一种无需执行系统即可从单个状态计算的潜在协调失效指标——以及DisQ——一种将现有单智能体测试方法适配到CMARL的测试用例选择方法。
translation.brief: 针对协作式多智能体强化学习策略安全测试不足的问题，提出利用Q值差距信号选择易揭示协调失效状态的测试用例选择方法DisQ。

papers.title: AMARIS: Merging Generalist and Specialist LLMs via Adaptive Subspace Inheritance
papers.abstract: Domain specialization of large language models (LLMs) often improves target-domain performance but degrades broad capabilities. Model merging is an attractive training-free alternative, yet common parameter-space strategies (for example, interpolation and sparsified averaging) provide limited control over task-specific interference. We introduce Adaptive Model Alignment via Ranked Inherited Subspaces (AMARIS), a covariance-driven framework that transfers specialist updates only along selected activation directions. AMARIS formulates merging as budgeted subspace inheritance: it seeks high specialist activation capture under a regularized base-output perturbation budget, then builds a low-rank projection gate from ranked generalized eigendirections. This yields a single static merged checkpoint that concentrates transfer in high-utility, low-interference directions. We evaluate AMARIS on Qwen3-based merges (8B and 32B) across finance, instruction-following, and multilingual SEA specialization. In our evaluated settings, AMARIS reaches Pareto operating points that are competitive with strong training-free baselines, including 98.37% specialist retention with 95.16% core retention for the 8B finance setting, 103.55% core retention with 90.28% specialist retention for the 8B instruction-following setting, and 99.20% core retention with 94.80% specialist retention for the 32B SEA setting. These results support subspace-constrained merging as a practical route to compositional capability integration without additional training.

translation.title: AMARIS：通过自适应子空间继承融合通用与专用LLM
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的领域专业化通常能提升目标领域性能，但会损害广泛能力。模型合并是一种有吸引力的免训练替代方案，但常见的参数空间策略（例如插值和稀疏化平均）对任务特定干扰的控制有限。我们提出AMARIS（通过排序继承子空间的自适应模型对齐），一个由协方差驱动的框架，仅沿选定的激活方向传递专家更新。AMARIS将合并表述为带预算的子空间继承：它在正则化的基础输出扰动预算下寻求高专家激活捕获，然后从排序的广义特征方向构建低秩投影门控。这产生一个单一的静态合并检查点，将传递集中在高效用、低干扰的方向上。我们在基于Qwen3的合并（8B和32B）上评估AMARIS，涵盖金融、指令遵循和多语言SEA专业化。在评估设置中，AMARIS达到了与强大免训练基线具有竞争力的Pareto工作点，包括8B金融设置中98.37%的专家保留率和95.16%的核心保留率，8B指令遵循设置中103.55%的核心保留率和90.28%的专家保留率，以及32B SEA设置中99.20%的核心保留率和94.80%的专家保留率。这些结果支持子空间约束合并作为无需额外训练即可实现组合能力集成的实用途径。
translation.brief: 针对模型合并中任务特定干扰难以控制的问题，提出基于协方差的子空间继承框架AMARIS，仅沿低干扰高效用激活方向传递专家模型更新。

papers.title: Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation of RL Experts: Toward Continual Post-Training
papers.abstract: RL post-training typically produces domain experts that must then be consolidated into one model, and as new experts keep arriving, this consolidation becomes a continual process. Weight merging and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) must re-consolidate the whole model whenever an expert is added, and can erode capabilities outside the target domains. We propose Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation (CSPD), which keeps the pre-RL model frozen, distills each RL expert independently into a soft prompt, and composes experts by concatenating their prompts without joint training. A single soft prompt suffices to distill an RL expert, recovering at least 90% of the teacher's gain in 22 of 23 math, code, and agent settings. Independently trained prompts compose well. In a multi-expert setting, the average rises with every expert added, and the full composition matches MOPD (67.83 vs. 67.79). The composition generalizes best across six held-out benchmarks. Input-space adaptation adds little serving overhead, keeping throughput within 1.5% of the unadapted backbone and reaching 2.40x that of rank-4 LoRA. These results point toward continual post-training on a fixed backbone.

translation.title: RL专家的可组合软提示蒸馏：迈向持续后训练
translation.abstract: RL后训练通常产生领域专家，随后必须将其整合到一个模型中，而随着新专家不断到来，这种整合成为一个持续过程。权重合并和多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）在每次添加专家时都必须重新整合整个模型，并可能损害目标领域之外的能力。我们提出可组合软提示蒸馏（CSPD），它保持预RL模型冻结，将每个RL专家独立蒸馏到一个软提示中，并通过拼接提示来组合专家而无需联合训练。单个软提示足以蒸馏一个RL专家，在23个数学、代码和智能体设置中的22个中恢复了至少90%的教师增益。独立训练的提示组合良好。在多专家设置中，平均值随每个专家的加入而上升，完整组合与MOPD相当（67.83对67.79）。该组合在六个留出基准上泛化最佳。输入空间自适应几乎不增加服务开销，吞吐量保持在未自适应骨干的1.5%以内，并达到rank-4 LoRA的2.40倍。这些结果指向在固定骨干上进行持续后训练。
translation.brief: 针对RL专家持续整合需反复重训且损害其他能力的问题，提出将每个RL专家独立蒸馏为软提示并通过拼接组合的CSPD方法，实现固定骨干上的持续后训练。

papers.title: VMSA: Video Memory Skill Agent for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Long-video question answering requires retrieving and integrating relevant evidence from videos spanning hours or even days. Recent agentic approaches organize video information into external memories and iteratively retrieve evidence to answer questions. However, effective retrieval and reasoning remain challenging, as agents must determine what information to search for, which memory sources to access, and how to connect evidence across distant temporal intervals. To address these challenges, we propose Video Memory Skill Agent (VMSA), a framework that jointly designs structured video memories and memory skills for long-video understanding. VMSA constructs three complementary memory components. Segment Caption Memory and Entity Event Memory serve as searchable evidence sources, while Entity-Aware Episode Memory provides broad yet detailed video context to guide evidence retrieval and reasoning. To further support effective memory utilization, VMSA induces memory skills from successful agent trajectories, incrementally refining or extending a compact skill library to guide iterative evidence retrieval, reasoning, and verification. Across seven long-video question-answering benchmarks, VMSA achieves the highest accuracy on all three week-long egocentric benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 9.4% on Ego-R1 Bench, and the best or competitive performance on four additional benchmarks. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contributions of all three memory components and memory skills, with memory skills also improving temporal evidence localization.

papers.title: What Stays in the Picture? From Redundant Instructions to Dependency-Aware Image Editing
papers.abstract: We introduce complex redundant-instruction image editing, where a single request specifies multiple objects, their attributes, and spatial relations while revising or canceling earlier editing requirements. Direct editing can fail to recover this intent, while splitting the request into successive steps can preserve obsolete edits and visual errors. Our key insight is to resolve the revision history into a final editing target that jointly guides planning and verification, so that obsolete requests do not become visual edits. Based on this insight, CRIE-Agent learns to consolidate revisions into object-level final intent and executes the retained objects in reference-first blocks, establishing referenced objects before their dependents. Verification then guides complete re-execution from the source image, with conditional layout hints, preventing visual errors from failed attempts from being carried into subsequent ones. We also construct CRIE-S, a benchmark containing 10,000 complex and redundant editing instructions with exact final intent annotations. Across five image-editing backends on CRIE-S, CRIE-Agent raises complete editing success from 0% under direct editing to 27.5--50.0%.

translation.title: What Stays in the Picture? From Redundant Instructions to Dependency-Aware Image Editing
translation.abstract: We introduce complex redundant-instruction image editing, where a single request specifies multiple objects, their attributes, and spatial relations while revising or canceling earlier editing requirements. Direct editing can fail to recover this intent, while splitting the request into successive steps can preserve obsolete edits and visual errors. Our key insight is to resolve the revision history into a final editing target that jointly guides planning and verification, so that obsolete requests do not become visual edits. Based on this insight, CRIE-Agent learns to consolidate revisions into object-level final intent and executes the retained objects in reference-first blocks, establishing referenced objects before their dependents. Verification then guides complete re-execution from the source image, with conditional layout hints, preventing visual errors from failed attempts from being carried into subsequent ones. We also construct CRIE-S, a benchmark containing 10,000 complex and redundant editing instructions with exact final intent annotations. Across five image-editing backends on CRIE-S, CRIE-Agent raises complete editing success from 0% under direct editing to 27.5--50.0%.

papers.title: Evidence sufficiency assessment enables cost-effective review allocation in on-premise clinical AI agents
papers.abstract: On-premise clinical AI agents must auto-accept high-confidence diagnoses, deferring others to clinician review, yet token probabilities and self-reported confidence miss errors, while more reliable five-run consistency incurs fivefold compute. We propose training-free decision-point evidence sufficiency assessment and a three-tier sequential triage protocol. Masking reasoning and diagnosis, the same 4B model scores sufficiency from objective evidence via prior-debiased probabilities over five ordered levels. Calibration freezes a nominal top-50% threshold, selecting single-run, five-run consistency, or full-deferral tiers by whether the one-sided 95% Wilson lower confidence bound of pass rate among accepted cases meets the 95% clinical target line. Across 1,605 MIRA-v2, CDM, VivaBench, and in-hospital liver malignancy primary cohort cases, MIRA-v2 single-run top-50% pass rate reached 98.91%, matching five-run consistency, saving ~80% compute; CDM achieved 96.00% test attainment by escalating to the five-run consistency tier; cross-specialty, missing-imaging, and combined enriched cohorts entered the full-deferral tier, capping calibration false-certification rate at 0.00%-3.50%.

papers.title: Beyond Future Views: Exploring Future-State World Models for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation(VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through unseen 3D environments, where the target spaces often lie beyond the current observation. Navigation world models address this challenge by predicting future views either as pixels or latent representations, providing valuable look-ahead information for action decision. Both paradigms define the future primarily through what the agent may observe, raising a fundamental question: is predicting future views the ultimate form to represent the future for VLN? Cognitive studies show that the human hippocampus prospectively represents both future goals and intervening locations along planned routes. Inspired by this predictive-map view, we organize the navigation-relevant future around goal-directed spatial states and route structure. We instantiate this perspective with two complementary abstractions: a short-horizon waypoint that specifies the next local state to reach, and a mid-horizon corridor that captures the spatial support of the upcoming route. Based on this design, we propose FS-Nav, a future-state world modeling framework that predicts waypoint-corridor states from spatial memory and language instructions, and communicates them to a VLM navigator through top-down and first-person interfaces. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that FS-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance. This highlights navigation-relevant future-state modeling as a promising direction for representing the future in VLN.

papers.title: Jagged Robustness: Uneven Safety Transfer and Emerging Vulnerabilities under LLM Quantization
papers.abstract: Quantization enables efficient inference in language models through model parameter compression. This work audits the impact of quantization on capability and safety domains including model safeguards, instruction-following, ethics and bias. Through benchmarks, we find that model safeguards and bias can degrade under quantization, while other capabilities such as truthfulness remain more stable in Qwen3-4B. We define this uneven transfer of LLM capabilities under quantization as Jagged Robustness. We find multiple factors driving Jagged Robustness: task complexity, evaluation method and generation coherence. Moreover, we verify the degradation of model safeguards by observing increased compliance with unsafe requests under quantization, and demonstrate universal adversarial suffix attacks that are benign for the full model but jailbreak quantized models. The findings indicate that it is risky to assume that the performance and robustness can transfer evenly across different capability domains from full models to quantized models.

papers.title: TrojanMaxxing: One-shotting VLM Backdoors with Weight-Space Programming
papers.abstract: Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can reason directly about the weights of other neural networks. Given only a natural-language objective, an LLM can inspect a model's weights, understand what they compute, and edit them directly without gradient-based optimization. This capability, termed weight-space programming (WSP), has been used to improve model performance on math reasoning, medical QA and other benchmarks. We propose TrojanMaxxing, a novel strategy to backdoor vision-language models (VLMs), by reframing it as a WSP task. We use Claude Opus 5.5 and Mythos 5.2 agents to backdoor VLMs without any optimization or training methods. The agents inspect the model weights, apply targeted edits, and co-design an imperceptible visual trigger that activates the backdoor. We then study the agents' strategies and present a thorough evaluation of the trojaned models on various benchmark datasets. TrojanMaxxing achieves attack success rates of 93%-100% on content moderation and 78%-100% on OCR while maintaining clean accuracy. Perhaps most consequentially, we show that injecting backdoors in a training-free manner is possible by simply, "asking an agent to do it".

papers.title: Cleave: Severing Guardrails and Auditing Spectral Coupling in Open-Weight LLMs
papers.abstract: Open-weight Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely downloaded for their strong coding and reasoning capabilities and deployed locally beyond the provider's control. To prevent misuse, developers embed safety guardrails into these models before release. However, we find that these guardrails rely on the residual writing weights to trigger refusals. Based on this insight, we propose Cleave, a training-free attack that directly edits these weights to remove safety restrictions while preserving general capabilities. With Cleave, malicious users can either remove all guardrails or selectively lift only cybersecurity restrictions. Because this selective removal retains up to a 99% refusal rate on other harmful requests and avoids weight rank collapse, it evades both behavioral spot-checks and static weight audits. Across five open-weight LLMs from 7B to 320B parameters, Cleave achieves up to a 67.97% attack success rate on seven safety benchmarks, substantially outperforming existing white-box baselines. On 356 cybersecurity tasks and 15 live vulnerable services, it further boosts executable exploit generation by up to 24.0 times and compromises up to 66.7% of the targets. To counter this threat, we propose a dual-stage defense that combines pre-release subspace diagnostics with post-release weight-coupling audits, achieving 100% detection recall at a 1% false-positive rate.

papers.title: No Audio, No Transcripts, No Problem: LLM-based ASR Adaptation Using Only Domain Documents
papers.abstract: Can a speech recognizer be adapted to a new domain with no target audio and no transcripts, using only written documentation? This is the realistic onboarding setting: a new customer hands over raw documentation, not the transcripts that text-only adaptation normally assumes. We turn a domain's documents into adaptation text in two ways, directly as written sentences or rendered by a large language model (LLM) into synthetic spoken dialogs, and feed them to a recently proposed denoising-based text-only adaptation method. We show that, across in-domain, out-of-domain, and cross-domain settings on two corpora, document-only adaptation can match or closely approach real transcriptions; whether written or conversational rendering is best depends on speaking style and the amount of text generated. To our knowledge, this is the first study of document-only adaptation of LLM-based ASR. As no existing corpus pairs audio, transcripts, and documents, we also built and released a document-grounded benchmark.

papers.title: THRIFTY: Cost-Constrained Reasoning-Data Synthesis for Small Language Models
papers.abstract: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly attractive for efficient, specialized deployment, and are typically trained on reasoning trajectories distilled from a larger teacher LLM. Generating this synthetic data is a major cost of the pipeline, especially when the teacher is a frontier model. Existing collection methods, however, are largely cost-unaware, or at best spread a fixed sampling budget uniformly across queries. Such allocation ignores the wide variation in problem difficulty and the strategic over- or under-sampling it invites. Thus, we propose THRIFTY, a Thompson-sampling bandit controller that spends a fixed generation-token budget to collect diverse correct reasoning trajectories, casting the task as a bandits-with-knapsacks problem with a novel diversity-aware objective. It tracks each problem's success probability with an online Beta posterior and spends each token where it expects the most new distinct correct solutions. Because repeated solutions add progressively less value, THRIFTY adaptively stops resampling saturated problems, concentrates budget on under-covered ones, and retires the unsolvable at the budget's opportunity cost. On math (AIME, MATH-500) and code (LiveCodeBench) benchmarks, THRIFTY gathers up to 22% more diverse correct trajectories per generation token than both the standard uniform-sampling recipe and the strongest adaptive baseline, with the largest gains in the scarce-budget and hard-problem regimes.

papers.title: Learning When to Ask: Advisor-Aware Post-Training for SLM Agents
papers.abstract: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly attractive for cheap, high-throughput agentic deployment, but they remain weak at multi-step reasoning and tool use that long-horizon tasks demand. We study how to post-train an SLM to seek advice from a stronger model and act on that advice itself, following an advisor-executor pattern. Out of the box, this pattern fails across open- and closed-source small-model families: wiring an SLM to an advisor is a harness-design matter that is not enough on its own. A post-training recipe is needed to teach the model when to ask, in a cost-aware fashion, and how to follow advice across steps. Our method, ADAPT (ADvisor-Aware Post-Training), is a multi-stage recipe that instills this behavior, learning entirely from the policy's own rollouts supervised by the environment's outcome, with no learned reward model or human annotation. Across three domains, compared to an untrained harness baseline, ADAPT improves success rate in embodied text reasoning (TextWorld) from 24.5% to 77.3%, code generation (LiveCodeBench) from 21.8% to 56.0%, and deep web search (GAIA) from 17.5% to 49.3%, while querying the advisor sparingly (~1.0-2.1 calls per task). On the two long-horizon domains it closes 70-85% of the gap to an oracle that perfectly times when to ask for advice, and on code generation it exceeds that oracle. The gains persist when the advisor is replaced by one unseen in training, showing that the learned help-seeking policy is robust to a changing advisor rather than tied to the one it was trained with.
