papers.title: Silent Arbitration: How Large Language Models Resolve Co-Authoritative Conflicting Instructions
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly receive high-level instructions about roles, values, interests, and communication style. Such instructions can conflict even when a prompt assigns them equal authority and provides no priority rule. We study co-authoritative persona conflict, in which a single prompt jointly assigns two opposing personas. Across eight conflict types grounded in published source material and five LLMs, we measure conflict acknowledgment, resolution strategy, and directional stance. Models acknowledge incompatibility in 72% of direct checks but explicitly surface it in only 22% of task responses, revealing silent arbitration. Dominance accounts for 45% of dual-persona responses, and 35% of compromise-labeled responses retain directional lean. Prompt framing further changes the visible form of arbitration substantially more than ordinary paraphrase variation. These findings show that evaluating instruction following should assess whether models disclose conflicts, how they resolve them, and which persona their responses favor.

translation.title: 沉默仲裁：大语言模型如何解决同等权威的冲突指令
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地接收关于角色、价值观、兴趣和沟通风格的高层指令。即使提示词赋予这些指令同等权威且未提供优先级规则，它们之间也可能发生冲突。我们研究了同等权威的角色冲突，即单个提示词同时指派两个对立的角色。基于已发表源材料的八种冲突类型和五个LLM，我们测量了冲突确认、解决策略和方向性立场。模型在直接检查中有72%承认不兼容，但在任务响应中仅有22%明确指出冲突，揭示了沉默仲裁现象。支配策略占双角色响应的45%，而35%被标记为折中的响应仍保留方向性倾向。提示词框架对仲裁可见形式的改变远大于普通的改写变化。这些发现表明，评估指令遵循应考察模型是否披露冲突、如何解决冲突，以及其响应偏向哪个角色。
translation.brief: 研究LLM在提示词中同时指派两个对立角色时的冲突处理，通过测量冲突确认、解决策略和立场倾向揭示模型进行“沉默仲裁”的行为。

papers.title: Structurally Different, Functionally Persistent: Capability Regions Under Model Optimization
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) capabilities have been associated with localized parameter regions, enabling targeted model editing and intervention. However, it remains unclear whether a region identified before model optimization remains an effective intervention target afterward. We evaluate the functional persistence and parameter overlap of coding capability regions across three instruction-tuned models under quantization, pruning, and LoRA-based adaptation. Although re-extracted regions exhibit substantial parameter reorganization, ablating the original region after optimization eliminates or nearly eliminates coding performance in almost all conditions, while magnitude-matched controls preserve performance. Partition analysis further shows that the shared subset of the original and re-extracted regions accounts for most of the observed ablation effect in the majority of conditions. These results demonstrate that parameter overlap and functional persistence are distinct: capability regions can remain causally effective intervention targets even when their parameter realization changes substantially.

translation.title: 结构不同，功能持久：模型优化下的能力区域
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的能力已被认为与局部参数区域相关，从而支持有针对性的模型编辑和干预。然而，模型优化前识别的区域在优化后是否仍是有效的干预目标尚不清楚。我们在三个指令微调模型上，评估了量化、剪枝和基于LoRA的适配下编码能力区域的功能持久性和参数重叠。尽管重新提取的区域表现出显著的参数重组，但在几乎所有条件下，优化后消融原始区域会消除或几乎消除编码性能，而幅度匹配的对照区域则保持性能。划分分析进一步表明，在大多数条件下，原始区域与重新提取区域的共享子集解释了大部分观察到的消融效应。这些结果表明参数重叠与功能持久性是不同的：即使能力区域的参数实现发生显著变化，它们仍可作为因果有效的干预目标。
translation.brief: 研究模型优化后能力区域是否仍是有效干预目标，通过量化、剪枝和LoRA适配下的消融实验发现功能持久性与参数重叠是两个独立的现象。

papers.title: Answering the persona, not the person: Over-determination in the construction of synthetic respondents
papers.abstract: Persona-prompted large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic survey respondents and digital twins. We examine how LLMs generate individual survey responses and why synthetic responses can show algorithmic fidelity in aggregate while tracking individual respondents poorly. We constructed 14,000 synthetic respondents from attributes of participants in Round 11 of the European Social Survey across 28 countries. Gemini 2.5 Flash and GPT-5-mini answered 15 attitude questions. We compared their outputs with each participant's answers and with the estimated human conditional mean for that profile. Synthetic responses tracked the conditional mean more closely than matched human responses did: correlations were 0.59 for Gemini and 0.55 for GPT-5-mini, compared with 0.44 for humans. Correlations with the matched individual's answers were only 0.28 and 0.26. Persona attributes accounted for 0.617 and 0.468 of synthetic response variance, compared with 0.192 in human data. Synthetic profiles occupied about five effective dimensions, versus nearly ten for humans. Repeated generation added only 12% of the human residual variation. Personal values accounted for most of the predictable component, while a few semantically relevant cues dominated response formation. Removing the three strongest cues reduced persona-explained variation by about half, after which the models re-anchored on the remaining attributes. We call this pattern over-determination: personas constrain synthetic answers much more strongly than they constrain the people they describe. The results suggest synthetic respondents may support questionnaire pretesting, directional exploration, and broad segment comparisons, but not individual digital twins or within-segment analysis. Validation of synthetic responses should assess conditional variance, dimensional structure, and individual heterogeneity.

translation.title: 回答角色而非回答个人：合成受访者的过度决定性
translation.abstract: 基于角色提示的大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作合成调查受访者和数字孪生。我们考察LLM如何生成个体调查响应，以及为什么合成响应在总体上可呈现算法保真度，却难以追踪个体受访者。我们基于European Social Survey第11轮28个国家参与者的属性构建了14,000个合成受访者，由Gemini 2.5 Flash和GPT-5-mini回答15个态度问题，并将其输出与每位参与者的真实答案及该画像的估计人类条件均值进行比较。合成响应比匹配的人类响应更贴近条件均值：Gemini的相关系数为0.59，GPT-5-mini为0.55，而人类为0.44；但与匹配个体的答案相关性仅为0.28和0.26。角色属性解释了合成响应方差的0.617和0.468，而人类数据中仅为0.192。合成画像仅占据约五个有效维度，而人类接近十个。重复生成仅增加了人类残差变异的12%。个人价值观构成了可预测成分的大部分，而少数语义相关线索主导了响应的形成。移除三个最强线索后，角色解释的变异减少约一半，此后模型重新锚定于剩余属性。我们将这一模式称为过度决定性：角色对合成答案的约束远强于其对所描述人群的约束。结果表明合成受访者可用于问卷预测试、方向性探索和粗粒度群体比较，但不适用于个体数字孪生或群体内分析。合成响应的验证应评估条件方差、维度结构和个体异质性。
translation.brief: 研究LLM合成调查受访者为何总体保真却难以追踪个体，通过大规模对比实验发现角色属性对合成答案的约束远强于对真实人群的“过度决定性”现象。

papers.title: On the Challenges of Using LLMs in High-Risk AI Recruitment: Guiding Questions for Legal Conformity with the AI Act
papers.abstract: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (AI Act) imposes detailed obligations on providers of high-risk AI systems but offers limited operational guidance, particularly when these systems integrate third-party General-Purpose AI (GPAI) models. This paper introduces a toolkit that fosters the development of legal-by-design AI-assisted recruitment systems by translating the core legal obligations of the AI Act's conformity assessment---specifically Articles 9--15 and Annex IV---into techno-normative requirements and corresponding guiding questions. While recruitment pipelines may involve components with varying technical complexity and differing levels of algorithmic transparency, this paper focuses on the most challenging case: the integration of third-party GPAI models into critical stages of the selection process, including resume and job description parsing, applicant scoring, and shortlist generation. This scenario presents significant challenges for downstream providers of high-risk AI systems, as it underscores the difficulties in obtaining the technical information needed to demonstrate compliance with the AI Act's techno-normative requirements, both prior to and during market deployment. After introducing the toolkit and illustrating its application through a simplified example, the paper explores informational dependencies between upstream and downstream GPAI model providers. These dependencies may produce informational gaps across the AI supply chain, potentially hindering the collection of evidence necessary for the AI system provider to ensure legal compliance. The resulting lack of technical transparency negatively affects the deployer, who may struggle to maintain meaningful oversight of the system, and ultimately impacts the persons subject to the AI output.

translation.title: 论在高风险AI招聘中使用LLM的挑战：符合AI法案的指导性问题
translation.abstract: 欧盟《人工智能法案》（AI Act）对高风险AI系统提供商规定了详细义务，但提供的操作性指导有限，尤其当这些系统集成了第三方通用AI（GPAI）模型时。本文介绍了一个工具包，通过将AI法案符合性评估的核心法律义务（特别是第9至15条和附件IV）转化为技术规范要求和相应的指导性问题，促进法律即设计（legal-by-design）的AI辅助招聘系统开发。虽然招聘流程可能包含技术复杂度和算法透明度各异的组件，本文聚焦最具挑战性的情形：将第三方GPAI模型集成到招聘流程的关键环节，包括简历与职位描述解析、申请人评分和入围名单生成。这一情形给高风险AI系统的下游提供商带来重大挑战，凸显了在市场部署前和部署期间获取证明符合AI法案技术规范要求所需技术信息的困难。在介绍工具包并通过简化示例说明其应用后，本文探讨了上游与下游GPAI模型提供商之间的信息依赖关系。这些依赖可能在AI供应链中产生信息缺口，阻碍AI系统提供商收集确保法律合规所需的证据。由此导致的技术透明度缺失会对部署者产生负面影响，使其难以对系统保持有效监督，并最终影响受AI输出约束的个人。
translation.brief: 针对集成第三方GPAI模型的高风险AI招聘系统，将AI法案合规义务转化为技术规范要求和指导性问题，并分析供应链中的信息缺口问题。

papers.title: Communication-constrained multiagent risk estimation: a simulation benchmark for adult sore throat
papers.abstract: Distributed predictive agents may need to approach a shared estimate under limited, unreliable communication. We evaluated classical symmetric pairwise gossip among five agents initialized from frozen calibrated predictions in a synthetic adult sore-throat benchmark. Ninety runs across three fixed generator families supplied 270,000 underlying test encounters, each observed through four missingness views. Complete, ring and star graphs were compared at eight interaction budgets and transaction failure probabilities of 0, 0.2 and 0.5. The coordination extension was designed after inspection of the predictive benchmark and is exploratory. Outcomes were disagreement around the conserved arithmetic mean and its exact decomposition of mean-agent Brier error. In the base view at eight attempted pairs and 0.2 failure, disagreement variance was 0.000109 for the complete graph, 0.000134 for the ring and 0.000175 for the star. The paired complete-minus-ring difference was -0.000024 (95% Monte Carlo interval -0.000030 to -0.000019). The centralized mean had base Brier 0.069781, compared with 0.069368 for Kumo alone. Agreement therefore does not establish superiority to the strongest individual predictor. Code, fixed probability inputs and results support replay without model refitting. The study quantifies finite-budget coordination under specified simulation assumptions; it proposes no new gossip algorithm and establishes no clinical accuracy or utility.

translation.title: 通信受限的多智能体风险估计：成人咽炎仿真基准
translation.abstract: 分布式预测智能体可能需要在有限且不可靠的通信下逼近共享估计。我们在一个合成的成人咽痛基准中，评估了由冻结校准预测初始化的五个智能体之间的经典对称成对gossip算法。三个固定生成器族共90次运行提供了270,000个底层测试场景，每个场景通过四种缺失视图观察。在八种交互预算和0、0.2、0.5三种事务失败概率下比较了完全图、环形图和星形图。协调扩展是在检查预测基准后设计的，属于探索性内容。结果指标为围绕守恒算术均值的分歧及其对平均智能体Brier误差的精确分解。在基础视图、八次尝试配对和0.2失败概率下，完全图的分歧方差为0.000109，环形图为0.000134，星形图为0.000175。完全图减环形图的配对差值为-0.000024（95%蒙特卡洛区间-0.000030至-0.000019）。集中式均值的基准Brier为0.069781，而Kumo单独为0.069368。因此达成一致并不能证明优于最强的个体预测器。代码、固定概率输入和结果支持无需重新拟合模型的复现。本研究量化了特定仿真假设下有限预算的协调行为；未提出新的gossip算法，也未确立临床准确性或实用性。
translation.brief: 研究通信受限下多个预测智能体如何通过经典成对gossip算法逼近共享风险估计，构建成人咽痛仿真基准比较不同图结构和交互预算下的协调效果。

papers.title: From Manufacturing Event Logs to Simulation: Enabling SMEs with Agentic AI for SimPy Simulation Generation
papers.abstract: High expertise and cost barriers exclude small and medium-sized enterprises from discrete-event simulation (DES). We introduce GenAI4SimPy, a multi-agent framework powered by Qwen 3.6 (27B), an open-weight large language model, that automates end-to-end DES generation from manufacturing event logs to executable SimPy models through tool-augmented reasoning and human-in-the-loop validation. Evaluated on three execution blocks from a public smart factory dataset, the framework achieved a mean absolute percentage error of 7.9\% and coverage of failure rate for all three blocks and of throughput for two of three. A fidelity paradox was observed: accurate process-level parameters did not ensure system-level behavioral fidelity, with flow-time and throughput errors driven by misinterpreted observation-window truncation and absent system-level calibration. These results demonstrate that local open-weight models can perform DES generation at accuracy comparable to cloud-based alternatives, while identifying parameter extraction as necessary but insufficient for behavioral validity. Source code and results are available at this https URL

translation.title: 从制造事件日志到仿真：利用Agentic AI为中小企业生成SimPy仿真
translation.abstract: 高昂的专业知识和成本门槛将中小企业排除在离散事件仿真（DES）之外。我们提出GenAI4SimPy，一个由开源权重大型语言模型Qwen 3.6（27B）驱动的多智能体框架，通过工具增强推理和人机协同验证，实现从制造事件日志到可执行SimPy模型的端到端DES自动生成。在一个公开智慧工厂数据集的三个执行块上评估，该框架在所有三个块上实现了7.9%的平均绝对百分比误差和失败率覆盖，并在三个块中的两个上实现了吞吐量覆盖。我们观察到一个保真度悖论：准确的过程级参数并不能保证系统级行为保真度，流时间和吞吐量误差源于对观测窗口截断的误解以及缺乏系统级校准。这些结果表明，本地开源权重模型可以以与云端替代方案相当的精度执行DES生成，同时表明参数提取是行为有效性的必要但非充分条件。源代码和结果见此 https URL
translation.brief: 解决中小企业难以负担离散事件仿真的问题，提出基于开源大语言模型的多智能体框架，从制造事件日志自动生成可执行的SimPy仿真模型。

papers.title: Fix Where It Fails: Root-Cause-Guided Agentic Harness Optimization for Scene Graph Generation
papers.abstract: Scene graph generation (SGG) aims to detect objects in an image and predict the relationships between them. The standard PredCls, SGCls, and SGDet settings show how much performance drops without ground-truth boxes and labels, but not where or why a model fails. Knowing this would allow fixing a model where it fails, without retraining. We propose RoHa-SGG (Root-cause-guided Harness optimization for SGG), which extends agentic harness optimization to SGG. It optimizes the harness, the inference code around a frozen SGG model. RoHa-SGG has two main LLM agents. A root-cause analysis (RCA) agent finds the components where the model fails and diagnoses why, and a proposer agent searches for a harness that fixes these causes. We evaluate RoHa-SGG on Visual Genome and PSG with representative two-stage, one-stage, and multimodal-LLM SGG models. The analysis shows that the components where ground-truth triplets are lost differ across models and datasets. RoHa-SGG improves every metric on all five model-dataset combinations. Graph-constrained R@100 and mR@100 rise by up to 15.8 and 26.4 points for the multimodal LLM and by up to 3.6 and 10.1 points for the two-stage and one-stage models. With root-cause guidance, the harness search reaches the final score of an unguided search up to three times faster.

translation.title: 在哪里失败就修复哪里：面向场景图生成的根因引导Agentic Harness优化
translation.abstract: 场景图生成（SGG）旨在检测图像中的物体并预测它们之间的关系。标准的PredCls、SGCls和SGDet设置显示了在没有真值框和标签时性能下降多少，但没有显示模型在哪里或为什么失败。了解这一点可以在不重新训练的情况下，在模型失败之处进行修复。我们提出RoHa-SGG（面向SGG的根因引导Harness优化），将agentic harness优化扩展到SGG。它优化的是harness，即围绕冻结SGG模型的推理代码。RoHa-SGG有两个主要的LLM智能体：根因分析（RCA）智能体找出模型失败的组件并诊断原因，提议者智能体搜索能修复这些原因的harness。我们在Visual Genome和PSG上用代表性的两阶段、一阶段和多模态LLM SGG模型评估RoHa-SGG。分析表明，真值三元组丢失的组件因模型和数据集而异。RoHa-SGG在所有五个模型-数据集组合上提升了所有指标。图约束的R@100和mR@100在多模态LLM上分别提升高达15.8和26.4点，在两阶段和一阶段模型上分别提升高达3.6和10.1点。在根因引导下，harness搜索达到无引导搜索最终分数的速度最高快三倍。
translation.brief: 解决SGG模型失败原因不透明、需重训练才能改进的问题，提出用LLM智能体进行根因分析并优化冻结模型周围的推理harness。

papers.title: Alliance Rupture and Repair in Simulating Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Dialogues
papers.abstract: In cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), routine work can strain the client-counselor working alliance, and the counselor must then notice the rupture, repair it, and adapt the work that follows. Existing CBT simulators model client resistance and follow structured treatment plans, but rarely track alliance state or allow counselors to repair ruptures over multiple turns and revise their plans accordingly. We present ALLY, a simulation framework that brings alliance rupture, repair, and replanning into ongoing CBT dialogue. Each client has a hidden alliance state that governs how openly the client engages. Like a real counselor, the counselor agent sees only the dialogue. It must notice when the client pulls back or pushes against the work, repair the rupture, and replan the rest of the session around what it has learned. Automatic evaluation shows that ALLY's counselors are closer to real CBT counselors than those of existing public synthetic datasets in strategy flow and emotional dynamics, and that ALLY is rated highest overall in counseling quality (CTRS) and interpersonal skill (FIS-T). An expert evaluation with 20 licensed therapists also finds the simulated ruptures plausible and the repairs and replanning largely appropriate.

translation.title: 模拟认知行为疗法对话中的治疗联盟破裂与修复
translation.abstract: 在认知行为疗法（CBT）中，常规工作可能使来访者与咨询师的工作联盟紧张，咨询师随后必须察觉破裂、修复它，并调整后续工作。现有的CBT模拟器对来访者阻抗建模并遵循结构化治疗计划，但很少追踪联盟状态，也不允许咨询师在多轮对话中修复破裂并相应修改计划。我们提出ALLY，一个将联盟破裂、修复和重新规划引入持续CBT对话的模拟框架。每个来访者有一个隐藏的联盟状态，控制其参与的开放程度。与真实咨询师一样，咨询师智能体只能看到对话。它必须察觉来访者何时退缩或抵触工作，修复破裂，并根据所学重新规划会话的剩余部分。自动评估表明，ALLY的咨询师在策略流程和情绪动态上比现有公开合成数据集的咨询师更接近真实CBT咨询师，且ALLY在咨询质量（CTRS）和人际技能（FIS-T）上总体评分最高。由20位持证治疗师参与的专家评估也认为模拟的破裂是合理的，修复和重新规划基本恰当。
translation.brief: 解决现有CBT对话模拟器不追踪治疗联盟状态、无法模拟破裂修复与计划调整的问题，提出带隐藏联盟状态的ALLY模拟框架。

papers.title: Epistemic Social Learning: Latent Behavioral Structure under Endogenous Multi-Agent Interaction
papers.abstract: In multi-agent interaction, a learner's actions shape the observations from which it infers other agents' behavior. A behavioral model may predict these observations well yet support poor adaptation when opponents change. We introduce Epistemic Social Learning (ESL), which couples fast, interaction-specific Bayesian beliefs with slower online learning of population-shared behavioral prototypes. Belief-conditioned decisions influence subsequent observations and, in turn, the representations learned from them. Under explicit regularity and averaging assumptions, we provide a conditional stochastic-approximation characterization of these coupled dynamics. Across twelve synthetic $3\times3$ cooperative, coordination, and adversarial games, ESL achieves the lowest aggregate post-switch regret among the evaluated online latent-adaptation methods, including a switch-aware Bayesian filter. Additional experiments examine observation loss, noise, and asymmetric incentives. These findings illustrate how predictive fit can differ from decision-relevant adaptation under policy-dependent interaction.

translation.title: 认知社会学习：内生多智能体交互下的潜在行为结构
translation.abstract: 在多智能体交互中，学习者的动作塑造了它据以推断其他智能体行为的观测。一个行为模型可能对这些观测预测良好，却在对手改变时支持糟糕的适应。我们提出认知社会学习（ESL），它将快速的、交互特定的贝叶斯信念与较慢的、对种群共享行为原型的在线学习相结合。信念条件化的决策影响后续观测，进而影响从中学到的表示。在明确的规律性和平均假设下，我们为这些耦合动力学提供了条件随机逼近刻画。在十二个合成的3×3合作、协调和对抗博弈中，ESL在所评估的在线潜在适应方法（包括一个感知切换的贝叶斯滤波器）中取得了最低的切换后总遗憾。额外实验考察了观测丢失、噪声和非对称激励。这些发现说明了在策略依赖的交互下，预测拟合如何区别于决策相关的适应。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体交互中预测准确但对手变化时适应差的问题，提出将快速贝叶斯信念与慢速种群行为原型在线学习相耦合的ESL方法。

papers.title: Altair-Nidhogg: Which Model-Merging Theories Hold for a One-Pass Decision Encoder? Soups, Task Arithmetic, TIES and DARE Against Joint Training and Prediction Ensembling
papers.abstract: Laya is a small model that answers a multiple-choice question in one pass: each option has a name and a written description. A new skill costs a training run, so we test whether published recipes for merging fine-tuned models (weight averaging, task arithmetic, TIES, DARE) work for it, and whether the theories behind them hold. All 156 models start from one released checkpoint: four plain fine-tunes, five specialists (each adds one kind of training row), joint fine-tunes on all rows, and prediction ensembles. Items are held-out, synthetic and LLM-labelled. In-family, each skill is scored on new items of its own kind, and "kept" is the share of a specialist's gain over the plain fine-tune. Averaging four specialists keeps 52% [38, 64] with +1.7 points of general accuracy; adding the full vectors keeps 42% [3, 63] with -9.0; TIES, which trims and resolves sign conflicts, keeps 64% [50, 76] with +1.5; joint fine-tunes, which see all the rows, keep 120% [104, 162] and 116% [104, 149]. DARE does not repair the full sum (-0.4 points), and ensembles of the models' predictions keep 26% to 54% depending on how they are combined. Swapping the seed of one specialist moves the average by up to 8 points (23 for the full sum). Of 10 predictions fixed in advance, 1 held, 1 held partly, 7 failed and 1 could not be tested. Out-of-family (benchmark questions, code-mixed tickets), the four-way average, joint models and ensemble stay within 2.6 points of the plain fine-tune, but full-vector sums lose up to 7.7. Labels are LLM-made, data synthetic, one base model.

translation.title: Altair-Nidhogg：哪些模型合并理论适用于单次通过决策编码器？模型汤、任务算术、TIES和DARE对比联合训练与预测集成
translation.abstract: Laya是一个单次通过回答多项选择题的小模型：每个选项都有名称和文字描述。学习一项新技能需要一次训练，因此我们测试已发表的微调模型合并配方（权重平均、任务算术、TIES、DARE）是否适用于它，以及其背后的理论是否成立。全部156个模型都从一个已发布的检查点出发：四个普通微调模型、五个专家模型（每个增加一种训练行）、在所有行上的联合微调模型，以及预测集成。测试项为留出、合成且由LLM标注的数据。在家族内，每项技能在其自身类型的新项上评分，"保留率"是专家模型相对普通微调的增益保留份额。平均四个专家模型保留52% [38, 64]，通用准确率提升1.7点；加入完整向量保留42% [3, 63]，下降9.0点；修剪并解决符号冲突的TIES保留64% [50, 76]，提升1.5点；见过所有行的联合微调保留120% [104, 162]和116% [104, 149]。DARE无法修复完整求和（-0.4点），模型预测的集成根据组合方式保留26%到54%。更换一个专家模型的随机种子会使平均值移动最多8点（完整求和为23点）。预先设定的10个预测中，1个成立，1个部分成立，7个失败，1个无法检验。在家族外（基准问题、混合语言工单）上，四路平均、联合模型和集成与普通微调相差在2.6点以内，但完整向量求和最多损失7.7点。标签由LLM生成，数据为合成数据，仅一个基础模型。
translation.brief: 检验权重平均、任务算术、TIES、DARE等模型合并方法及其理论在单次通过决策编码器上是否有效，并与联合训练和预测集成进行系统对比。

papers.title: Bringing AI Assistance to the Beznau Nuclear Power Plant: A Hierarchical System of LLM Agents for Reactor Monitoring
papers.abstract: Beznau Unit 1 in Switzerland, in operation since 1969, is the most experienced nuclear reactor still running worldwide. Five decades of incremental modernization have left its monitoring systems, alarm logs, variable catalogs, technical specifications and investigation reports in separate silos that were never designed to be queried together. As a result, investigating a core instrumentation anomaly means slow, manual gathering of knowledge scattered across databases, documents, and experienced colleagues. We present a hierarchical multi-agent assistant built on large language models (LLMs) to support these investigations and reduce the need for tedious manual searches in SAP systems. An orchestrating agent breaks down an engineer's question and hands the parts to specialized sub-agents, each with read-only access to one source. Domain expertise is written as natural-language procedures that plant engineers can read, review and revise. The system is strictly advisory, with every answer traced back to its sources. We also report organizational lessons from introducing agentic AI into a culture built on safety, traceability and conservative change. Beyond the technical architecture, the Beznau case study examines how an assistant can be introduced into a setting where evidence must be traceable, changes carefully reviewed, and operational decisions retained by plant personnel, paving the way for the responsible use of agentic AI in industrial plant monitoring.

translation.title: 将AI辅助引入Beznau核电站：用于反应堆监控的分层LLM智能体系统
translation.abstract: 瑞士Beznau 1号机组自1969年运行至今，是全球仍在运行的历史最悠久的核反应堆。五十年的渐进式现代化使其监控系统、报警日志、变量目录、技术规范和调查报告分散在彼此隔离的系统中，从未被设计为可联合查询。因此，调查堆芯仪表异常意味着要在数据库、文档和资深同事之间缓慢、手动地收集分散的知识。我们提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的分层多智能体助手，以支持这些调查并减少在SAP系统中繁琐的手动检索。一个编排智能体将工程师的问题分解，并将各部分交给专门的子智能体，每个子智能体对单一数据源拥有只读访问权限。领域专业知识以自然语言流程编写，电站工程师可以阅读、审查和修改。该系统严格限于咨询用途，每个答案都可追溯至其来源。我们还报告了在一个以安全、可追溯性和保守变更为核心的文化中引入智能体AI的组织经验。除技术架构之外，Beznau案例研究还探讨了如何将助手引入一个证据必须可追溯、变更需仔细审查、运营决策权保留在电站人员手中的环境，为智能体AI在工业电站监控中的负责任使用铺平道路。
translation.brief: 针对核电站监控知识分散、调查异常需大量手动检索的问题，提出基于LLM的分层多智能体助手，由编排智能体分解问题并交由只读访问各数据源的子智能体处理。

papers.title: Can Language Models See the Circuit in Pixelated RFIC Passives?
papers.abstract: The emergence of inverse-designed, pixelated passives for microwave and millimeter-wave applications has been a major development in the field of RFIC design. These devices, which appear to be QR-code-like in structure, exist in a generalizable, high-dimensional design space that includes conventional passive topologies. However, these structures are naturally unintuitive for designers, and failures or deviations in performance are difficult to debug. In this work, we ask whether a frontier language model can understand, predict, and edit the responses and layout structure of pixelated passives. The agent, run with all tools disabled, is first asked to read layouts on 18x18 and 27x27 tile grids and, in a single reply, predict the input impedance and loss of the structure from 20-100 GHz. On eight GA-synthesized layouts and five random fills, the predicted Smith-chart locus follows full-wave simulation results closely, with a systematic shift that places features about 16% lower in frequency than EM. On multipath loop structures it identifies notches successfully but shows a smaller frequency bias, about half that of an ideal transmission-line model that ignores bends. The agent is then asked to debug seven designs that fail their specification, and given a budget of five EM simulations and at most twelve changed tiles, it is able to improve all seven and bring five designs within specification. These experiments suggest language models can serve as an interpretability and debugging tool for traditionally non-intuitive inverse-designed passives.

translation.title: 语言模型能看懂像素化RFIC无源器件中的电路吗？
translation.abstract: 面向微波和毫米波应用的逆向设计像素化无源器件的出现，是RFIC设计领域的一项重大进展。这些结构看似二维码般的器件存在于一个可泛化的高维设计空间中，其中也包含传统无源拓扑。然而，这些结构对设计者而言天然不直观，性能失效或偏差难以调试。在本工作中，我们探究前沿语言模型能否理解、预测并编辑像素化无源器件的响应和版图结构。该智能体在禁用所有工具的情况下运行，首先被要求读取18x18和27x27瓦片网格上的版图，并在单次回复中预测结构在20-100 GHz的输入阻抗和损耗。在八个GA合成的版图和五个随机填充上，预测的Smith圆图轨迹与全波仿真结果 closely 吻合，仅存在一个系统性偏移，使特征频率比电磁仿真低约16%。在多路径环形结构上，它能成功识别陷波点，但频率偏差更小，约为忽略弯折的理想传输线模型偏差的一半。随后，智能体被要求调试七个未达规格的设计，在五次EM仿真和最多修改十二个瓦片的预算下，它改进了全部七个设计，并使其中五个达到规格。这些实验表明，语言模型可以作为传统上不直观的逆向设计无源器件的可解释性与调试工具。
translation.brief: 针对逆向设计像素化RFIC无源器件不直观、难以调试的问题，探究前沿语言模型在无工具条件下直接读取版图预测射频响应并调试失效设计的能力。

papers.title: TITAN: DRL-Based Dynamic Scheduling and Resource Allocation for Tactile Internet
papers.abstract: Tactile Internet (TI) applications require ultra-reliable, low-latency tactile communication alongside video traffic. However, tactile Quality of Service (QoS) requirements vary with the interaction context, making fixed resource allocation inefficient. In this paper, we propose TITAN (Two-Timescale Integrated Tactile Internet over 5G Access Networks), a dynamic scheduling and resource allocation (SRA) scheme. TITAN receives time-varying tactile QoS profiles from a higher-layer module and adapts SRA to the current QoS profile and network state. A deep reinforcement learning-based agent splits the available network bandwidth between tactile and video streams at a slow timescale, while a fast-timescale scheduler allocates resource blocks among active user equipment. Through simulations, we show that TITAN simultaneously satisfies both tactile and video QoS targets and achieves a performance gain of 7.64 percentage points (pp) in the joint satisfaction rate over the best-performing static SRA baseline.

translation.title: TITAN：基于DRL的触觉互联网动态调度与资源分配
translation.abstract: 触觉互联网（TI）应用需要超可靠、低时延的触觉通信与视频流量并存。然而，触觉服务质量（QoS）需求随交互场景变化，固定的资源分配因此效率低下。本文提出TITAN（Two-Timescale Integrated Tactile Internet over 5G Access Networks），一种动态调度与资源分配（SRA）方案。TITAN从上层模块接收时变的触觉QoS配置，并根据当前QoS配置和网络状态自适应调整SRA。基于深度强化学习的智能体在慢时间尺度上划分触觉流与视频流之间的可用网络带宽，而快时间尺度调度器则在活跃用户设备之间分配资源块。仿真表明，TITAN同时满足触觉和视频QoS目标，联合满足率相比性能最佳的静态SRA基线提升7.64个百分点（pp）。
translation.brief: 针对触觉互联网中触觉QoS需求时变导致固定资源分配低效的问题，提出基于深度强化学习的双时间尺度动态调度与资源分配方案TITAN。

papers.title: Exploring the Potential of Ultra-Low-Bit Inference on LLM Accelerators
papers.abstract: Vector quantization (VQ) enables ultra-low-bit compression of large language models (LLMs) by encoding groups of values as compact codebook indexes. However, reconstructing these values for computation requires frequent codebook lookups, which conflict with the dataflows of conventional LLM accelerators and limit the performance gains from VQ compression. Consequently, prior work has resorted to VQ-specific accelerator designs, which either incur substantial additional hardware overhead or support only a limited range of inference scenarios. In this work, we argue that existing systolic-array-based LLM accelerators already possess the essential hardware resources for efficient VQ inference, but lack the mechanisms to effectively exploit them. To bridge this gap, we present VQACC, an architectural enhancement that jointly redesigns the existing operand buffer's access logic and data mapping to reuse its storage and port resources for codebook lookups, seamlessly integrating dequantization into the normal operand-addressing dataflow. Evaluation shows that VQACC achieves a 2.63$\times$ speedup over the EVA baseline, with additional hardware occupying only 0.17\% of the compute array's area.

translation.title: 探索LLM加速器上超低比特推理的潜力
translation.abstract: 向量量化（VQ）通过将一组值编码为紧凑的码本索引，实现大语言模型（LLM）的超低比特压缩。然而，为进行计算而重构这些值需要频繁的码本查找，这与传统LLM加速器的数据流相冲突，限制了VQ压缩带来的性能收益。因此，先前的工作不得不采用VQ专用加速器设计，这些设计要么带来大量额外硬件开销，要么仅支持有限的推理场景。在本工作中，我们认为现有的基于脉动阵列的LLM加速器已经具备高效VQ推理所需的核心硬件资源，只是缺乏有效利用它们的机制。为弥合这一差距，我们提出VQACC，一种架构增强方案，它联合重新设计现有操作数缓冲区的访问逻辑和数据映射，复用其存储和端口资源进行码本查找，将反量化无缝集成到正常的操作数寻址数据流中。评估表明，VQACC相比EVA基线实现2.63倍加速，额外硬件仅占计算阵列面积的0.17%。
translation.brief: 针对VQ超低比特压缩的码本查找与现有LLM加速器数据流冲突的问题，提出VQACC架构增强，复用操作数缓冲区资源将反量化无缝融入寻址数据流。

papers.title: Mjolnir: Finding and Reproducing Vulnerabilities in Root-of-Trust Firmware and RTL with Project-Grounded Agents
papers.abstract: A root of trust (RoT) anchors secure boot and attestation for the system above it, so a bug in RoT firmware or hardware undermines every layer that trusts it. LLM agents now find real vulnerabilities in general-purpose software, but RoT code presents two challenges. First, many security-relevant bugs depend on project-specific trust boundaries and fault-injection countermeasures rather than generic vulnerability patterns, and may cause no crash. Second, without RoT hardware, agents must exercise RoT inputs through the project's own hardware model, mocks, or RTL testbenches. We present Mjolnir, an agentic pipeline that supplies each project's threat model and design conventions to discovery and skeptical review agents, and reproduces surviving findings as proof-of-concept tests in the project's own toolchain. We evaluate Mjolnir on six firmware and RTL targets in Caliptra, OpenTitan, and OpenPRoT. On Caliptra's runtime firmware, it reaches 83.3%-100% precision across three models under blind expert labeling, including 100% on Gemini 3.8 Flash versus 66.7%-78.6% for four single-agent baselines on the same model. On 34 known security-relevant bugs in Caliptra's core firmware fixed after the models' training cutoffs, it finds 10 with Gemini 3.8 Flash versus 7 for the best baseline, and 17 with Gemini 4 Argon versus 12. Across our evaluation scans, maintainers have confirmed 64 of Mjolnir's findings as previously unknown security-relevant bugs: 37 across three models on Caliptra's runtime firmware and 27 across single scans of the other five targets.

translation.title: Mjolnir：基于项目上下文智能体发现并复现信任根固件与RTL中的漏洞
translation.abstract: 信任根（RoT）为其上层系统锚定安全启动和远程证明，因此RoT固件或硬件中的漏洞会危及信任它的每一层。LLM智能体如今已能在通用软件中发现真实漏洞，但RoT代码带来两大挑战。第一，许多安全相关漏洞依赖于项目特定的信任边界和故障注入对抗措施，而非通用漏洞模式，且可能不引发崩溃。第二，在没有RoT硬件的情况下，智能体必须通过项目自身的硬件模型、mock或RTL测试平台来驱动RoT输入。我们提出Mjolnir，一个智能体流水线，它向发现智能体和怀疑式审查智能体提供每个项目的威胁模型和设计约定，并将幸存的发现复现为项目自身工具链中的概念验证测试。我们在Caliptra、OpenTitan和OpenPRoT的六个固件和RTL目标上评估Mjolnir。在Caliptra运行时固件上，在盲测专家标注下，它在三个模型上达到83.3%-100%的精确率，其中Gemini 3.8 Flash达到100%，而同一模型上四个单智能体基线仅为66.7%-78.6%。在模型训练截止后修复的Caliptra核心固件34个已知安全相关漏洞中，它用Gemini 3.8 Flash发现10个（最佳基线为7个），用Gemini 4 Argon发现17个（基线为12个）。在我们的评估扫描中，维护者已确认Mjolnir的64个发现为此前未知的安全相关漏洞：其中37个来自三个模型对Caliptra运行时固件的扫描，27个来自对其余五个目标的单次扫描。
translation.brief: 针对RoT固件与RTL漏洞依赖项目特定信任边界且难以复现的问题，提出Mjolnir智能体流水线，注入项目威胁模型进行漏洞发现与怀疑式审查，并在项目自身工具链中复现为概念验证测试。

papers.title: WEIR: Watershed Exploration and Drift-Aware Prefix Shrinkage for Multi-Turn Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Multi-turn language model agents often receive only a single binary reward at the end of a long interaction trajectory, making it difficult to separate decisive decisions from routine steps or estimate accurate intermediate values. Prefix-tree methods improve sample efficiency by merging trajectories that share action histories, yet two structural flaws remain: naive pooling mixes stale off-policy outcomes into critic targets with fixed weights, and uniform or entropy-driven branching wastes continuations on dead-end states whose outcome is already settled. We introduce WEIR (Watershed Exploration and Intrinsic-Drift Shrinkage), an actor-critic reinforcement learning framework grounded in a Doob turn-variance conservation identity. WEIR maintains a cross-iteration canonical action-prefix tree with exponentially discounted visit counts and trains a prefix-conditioned critic toward a minimax drift-aware shrinkage target that adapts from single-trajectory returns at rare nodes to pooled empirical means at dense nodes. Using the same pre-update critic, WEIR allocates rollout budgets across tasks via Neyman stratification $B_q \propto \sqrt{\hat{p}_q(1-\hat{p}_q)}$ and directs within-task branches to watershed forks where high survival-headroom uncertainty coincides with steep value cliffs. Across four multi-hop QA benchmarks, ALFWorld, and WebShop on Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct, WEIR achieves $32.18\%$ and $37.85\%$ average QA exact match and $84.83\%$ and $87.81\%$ ALFWorld success rates, outperforming CAPO by $1.50$--$3.74$ points while generating $28$--$29\%$ fewer rollout tokens than chain sampling.

translation.title: WEIR：面向多轮智能体强化学习的分水岭探索与漂移感知前缀收缩
translation.abstract: 多轮语言模型智能体通常只在长交互轨迹末尾获得一个单一的二元奖励，这使得难以将决定性决策与常规步骤区分开，也难以估计准确的中介价值。前缀树方法通过合并共享动作历史的轨迹来提升样本效率，但仍存在两个结构性缺陷：朴素池化以固定权重将陈旧的离策略结果混入critic目标，而均匀或熵驱动的分支会在结果已定的死胡同状态上浪费后续展开。我们提出WEIR（分水岭探索与内在漂移收缩），一个基于Doob轮次方差守恒恒等式的actor-critic强化学习框架。WEIR维护一棵跨迭代的标准动作前缀树，采用指数折扣的访问计数，并训练一个以前缀为条件的critic，其目标是最小极大漂移感知收缩目标——在稀疏节点上自适应为单轨迹回报，在稠密节点上自适应为池化经验均值。利用同一个更新前的critic，WEIR通过Neyman分层 $B_q \propto \sqrt{\hat{p}_q(1-\hat{p}_q)}$ 在任务间分配rollout预算，并将任务内分支引导至高生存余量不确定性与陡峭价值悬崖重合的分水岭分叉点。在四个多跳问答基准、ALFWorld和WebShop上，基于Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct，WEIR分别取得32.18%和37.85%的平均问答精确匹配率以及84.83%和87.81%的ALFWorld成功率，比CAPO高出1.50至3.74个百分点，同时比链式采样少生成28%至29%的rollout token。
translation.brief: 针对多轮智能体强化学习中稀疏奖励难以区分关键决策的问题，提出基于前缀树与Doob方差守恒的actor-critic框架WEIR，通过漂移感知critic目标和分水岭分支分配来提升样本效率。

papers.title: PRISM: Validation-Free Online Batch Selection for LLM Fine-Tuning via Preconditioned Conic Ghost Matching
papers.abstract: Online batch selection lowers the cost of fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) by replacing each candidate batch with a smaller informative subset. Existing selectors typically depend on a held-out validation or proxy set, or else rely on Euclidean facility-location objectives over unpreconditioned gradients whose diameter-shifted similarities are distorted by heavy-tailed gradient norms and cross-layer anisotropy. We introduce PRISM (Preconditioned Ray-Isotropic Submodular Matching), a validation-free online batch selector that aligns candidate gradients in a factored second-moment metric and casts subset construction as conic facility location over positive ray projections. Computing the required pairwise geometry through factored preconditioned ghost inner products avoids materializing per-example parameter gradients, while the conic objective remains normalized, nonnegative, and monotone submodular---guaranteeing a $(1-1/e)$ greedy approximation whose additive error scales with total batch gradient energy rather than the worst-case outlier diameter. Assigning each candidate to its best-aligned selected ray induces closed-form radial projection weights that automatically shrink orthogonal or noisy examples toward zero. We derive a nonconvex convergence bound showing that optimization error is governed directly by the conic representation cost. Across four LLM fine-tuning configurations spanning 1.5B to 8B parameters, PRISM outperforms full-batch training, Euclidean facility location, and zeroth-order selectors, and rivals or surpasses validation-guided baselines without held-out data.

translation.title: PRISM：基于预条件锥形幽灵匹配的无验证在线批选择方法用于LLM微调
translation.abstract: 在线批选择通过将每个候选批次替换为更小的信息子集来降低大语言模型（LLM）微调的成本。现有选择器通常依赖留出的验证集或代理集，否则就依赖在未预条件化梯度上的欧氏设施选址目标，其受重尾梯度范数和跨层各向异性扭曲的直径偏移相似度会失真。我们提出PRISM（预条件射线各向同性次模匹配），一种无验证的在线批选择器，它在分解的二阶矩度量中对齐候选梯度，并将子集构建转化为正射线投影上的锥形设施选址问题。通过分解预条件的幽灵内积计算所需的成对几何关系，避免了显式生成每个样本的参数梯度，同时锥形目标保持归一化、非负且单调次模——保证 $(1-1/e)$ 的贪心近似，其加性误差随总批次梯度能量而非最坏情况离群直径缩放。将每个候选分配到其最佳对齐的选中射线，可导出闭式径向投影权重，自动将正交或含噪样本的权重收缩至零。我们推导了非凸收敛界，表明优化误差直接由锥形表示代价决定。在四个覆盖1.5B至8B参数的LLM微调配置上，PRISM优于全批训练、欧氏设施选址和零阶选择器，并在无需留出数据的情况下媲美或超越验证引导的基线。
translation.brief: 针对在线批选择依赖验证集或欧氏相似度失真的问题，提出PRISM，通过预条件二阶矩度量下的锥形设施选址实现无验证集的子集选择。

papers.title: Isonomy: Isolating Every Request from Timing Side Channels at Nearly Full-Sharing Throughput in Multi-Instance LLM Prefill
papers.abstract: Many long prompts share a prefix, and reusing its cached keys and values saves prefill computation. A cache hit, however, makes the first token arrive earlier and can reveal that another request used the same prefix, so providers share the cache only within an account. Under least privilege, even permission to send and pay for requests should not expose other requests' prompts in the same account. This matters because agents send unreviewed requests carrying private data, resellers pool users behind one account, and creden-tials can be stolen. Isonomy therefore isolates each request by default and lets requests opt into explicit sharing groups. Rather than give up reuse, it keeps one cache shared across accounts and hides only hits on prefixes cached outside a request's group. We target deployments where clients cannot observe one another's load, because there it suffices to hide these hits in the request's own timing. On three commercial APIs, our listeners could not distinguish added prefill work from a short request beyond measurement noise. Built on vLLM, Isonomy's gateway applies the deployment's routing rule to load and visible cache entries only, which yields the instance where the request would run if hidden hits missed. On that instance, the prediction mode estimates when the first token would be ready from the queue and the visible prefix, and gates its release. The execution mode instead reserves the work a hidden hit skips and fills it with other requests' prompts where possible. In direct-probe tests on two, four, and eight instances with every request isolated, both modes kept the upper bound on a probe's advantage within measure-ment noise at both prefix lengths. At saturation, the prediction mode retains 0.98 of unprotected sharing's throughput on two workloads with account labels, whereas isolation by account retains 0.95, or 0.80 where more reuse crosses accounts.

translation.title: Isonomy：在多实例LLM预填充中以接近全共享吞吐量隔离每个请求免受时序侧信道攻击
translation.abstract: 许多长提示词共享前缀，复用其缓存的键值可节省预填充计算。然而缓存命中会使首个token更早到达，可能泄露另一请求使用了相同前缀，因此服务商只在账户内共享缓存。在最小权限原则下，即使拥有发送并支付请求的权限，也不应暴露同一账户中其他请求的提示词。这一点很重要，因为智能体会发送携带私有数据的未审查请求，转售商会将多个用户汇集在一个账户之后，且凭证可能被盗。因此Isonomy默认隔离每个请求，并允许请求显式选择加入共享组。它并不放弃复用，而是保留跨账户共享的单一缓存，仅隐藏对请求所在组之外缓存前缀的命中。我们针对客户端无法相互观察负载的部署场景，因为在那里只需将这些命中隐藏在请求自身的时序中即可。在三个商业API上，我们的监听器无法在测量噪声之外区分新增的预填充工作与短请求。Isonomy基于vLLM构建，其网关仅根据负载和可见缓存条目应用部署的路由规则，从而得到隐藏命中未发生时请求本应运行的实例。在该实例上，预测模式根据队列和可见前缀估计首个token何时就绪，并控制其释放时机；执行模式则保留隐藏命中跳过的工作，并尽可能用其他请求的提示词填充。在两、四、八实例且每个请求均被隔离的直接探测测试中，两种模式都将探测者的优势上界保持在测量噪声之内。在饱和负载下，预测模式在两个带账户标签的工作负载上保留了无保护共享吞吐量的0.98，而按账户隔离保留0.95，在更多复用跨账户的场景下为0.80。
translation.brief: 针对共享前缀缓存命中造成的时序侧信道泄露提示词隐私问题，提出Isonomy，通过预测或保留隐藏命中所需工作来掩盖缓存命中时序，同时保持接近全共享的吞吐量。

papers.title: PromptTTSD: Controllable Text to Spoken Dialogue Synthesis with Open-Ended Text Descriptions
papers.abstract: Spoken dialogue synthesis aims to generate multi-turn conversational speech from dialogue scripts while maintaining speaker consistency and contextual appropriateness. However, existing models largely lack fine-grained controllability, which is critical for capturing the dynamic, context-dependent style shifts in natural conversations. While prompt-based TTS has enabled such control for single-speaker speech, existing datasets heavily rely on predefined tags, which fundamentally limits their capacity to capture open-ended styles. To address this gap, we propose a scalable pipeline for extracting conversational speech from multi-narrator audiobooks, featuring an improved two-stage alignment algorithm to preserve dialogue continuity, paired with LLM-based extraction of style descriptions directly from narrative text. We release PromptDialog, a large-scale multi-speaker conversational speech dataset comprising 8,383 hours of Chinese speech and 120 hours of English speech, with open-ended style descriptions for 79% of utterances. We further introduce PromptTTSD, a spoken dialogue synthesis model built via a prompt-aware fine-tuning strategy that integrates style prompts into text-speech interleaved sequences. PromptTTSD is an open-source spoken dialogue synthesis model that supports both zero-shot voice cloning and natural language style control. Experiments demonstrate that PromptTTSD not only maintains strong fundamental synthesis capabilities but also achieves competitive open-ended style control compared with proprietary models, and substantially improves contextual appropriateness in multi-turn dialogues.

translation.title: PromptTTSD：基于开放式文本描述的可控文本到口语对话合成
translation.abstract: 口语对话合成旨在从对话脚本生成多轮会话语音，同时保持说话人一致性和上下文适宜性。然而，现有模型在很大程度上缺乏细粒度可控性，而这对捕捉自然对话中动态的、依赖上下文的风格转换至关重要。虽然基于提示的TTS已为单说话人语音实现了这种控制，但现有数据集严重依赖预定义标签，从根本上限制了其捕捉开放式风格的能力。为填补这一空白，我们提出一个从多叙述人有声书中提取会话语音的可扩展流水线，其特点是采用改进的两阶段对齐算法以保持对话连续性，并配合基于LLM直接从叙述文本提取风格描述。我们发布了PromptDialog，一个大规模多说话人会话语音数据集，包含8383小时中文语音和120小时英文语音，其中79%的话语带有开放式风格描述。我们进一步提出PromptTTSD，一个通过提示感知微调策略构建的口语对话合成模型，该策略将风格提示整合到文本-语音交错序列中。PromptTTSD是一个开源口语对话合成模型，同时支持零样本声音克隆和自然语言风格控制。实验表明，PromptTTSD不仅保持了强大的基础合成能力，还在开放式风格控制上与专有模型相比具有竞争力，并显著提升了多轮对话中的上下文适宜性。
translation.brief: 针对口语对话合成缺乏细粒度开放式风格控制的问题，构建了带开放式风格描述的大规模对话语音数据集PromptDialog，并通过提示感知微调训练开源模型PromptTTSD。

papers.title: Potential emergence in LLM agents: a statistical physics perspective
papers.abstract: There has been significant recent interest in understanding the behaviour of LLM agents from the perspective of human preferences or corpus statistics. In this paper we propose agent states as intermediate variables through which post-training can be measured and predicted. From a statistical physics perspective, we study the emergence of a global potential which governs the transition of state in LLM agent reasoning. We introduce a partition function to model the ideal KL-regularised transition distribution and track potential structure, mean reward and state entropy. We demonstrate our approach in two Qwen3.5-9B tasks: safety-test selection and physics-reasoning auditing. We observe that the potential structure strengthens during post-training as predicted from our framework, while joint changes in reward and state entropy provide consistency evidence. States thus provide a quantitative description of how post-training organises agent behaviour.

translation.title: LLM智能体中的势能涌现：统计物理视角
translation.abstract: 近来，从人类偏好或语料库统计的角度理解LLM智能体行为引起了极大兴趣。本文提出将智能体状态作为中间变量，通过它们可以测量和预测后训练的效果。从统计物理视角出发，我们研究了支配LLM智能体推理中状态转移的全局势能的涌现。我们引入配分函数来建模理想的KL正则化转移分布，并追踪势能结构、平均奖励和状态熵。我们在Qwen3.5-9B的两个任务上验证了该方法：安全测试选择和物理推理审计。我们观察到，正如框架所预测的，势能结构在后训练过程中得到强化，而奖励与状态熵的联合变化提供了一致性证据。因此，状态为后训练如何组织智能体行为提供了定量描述。
translation.brief: 针对如何定量刻画后训练对LLM智能体行为的影响，提出以智能体状态为中间变量、用统计物理中的势能与配分函数建模状态转移的分析框架。

papers.title: Benchmarks' Last Exam
papers.abstract: Public benchmarks guide model selection, post-training rewards and claims of progress in artificial intelligence, yet leaderboards report aggregate scores without verifying whether each task's prompt, environment and grader agree on what counts as success. How often that agreement fails in contemporary evaluations, and in which direction confirmed defects move scores, has remained unmeasured across grading designs. Here we synthesize task-level quality reviews of 749 tasks across eight frontier benchmarks and 767 public model evaluations spanning closed-form question answering, document rubrics and agentic execution to assess whether prompts, environments and graders align. Task validity stratifies sharply by grading architecture. Closed-form benchmarks revised after public error reporting reach 92.5% verified validity, compared with 29.3% across six multi-step suites that nevertheless already supply 161 verified complex tasks. Rubric suites fail through mismatches between prompts and reference checklists, whereas execution harnesses add incomplete state assertions, shared-channel leaks and grading-time collisions. Across confirmed defects, 71.7% withhold credit from compliant solutions while 28.3% permit shortcut passes, indicating that raw leaderboard ceilings understate frontier capability on many practical tasks. Grading committed patches inside a fresh container cuts confirmed runtime bypasses from 14.7% in shared containers to 2.7% (a 5.5x drop, and 0% in read-only or static suites), showing how targeted maintenance restores existing benchmarks at low cost. As the initial milestone of the long-term Benchmarks' Last Exam initiative, this synthesis launches sustained expansion across wider benchmark coverage and deeper evaluation-quality dimensions so that pursuing leaderboard gains directly advances genuine model capability.

papers.title: Learning Inside Types: Epistemic Typestates for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Type disciplines make programs safe by construction: components checked against each other's types compose into programs that cannot go wrong in the ways the types exclude. Types suit reinforcement learning: a type constrains what an agent may choose, not how it chooses, so the guarantee holds for every policy a learner produces. We introduce epistemic typestates, a type discipline for safe multi-agent reinforcement learning. An agent's type is a protocol whose states record its beliefs, the worlds it cannot rule out from its own observations and actions, and permits only actions that are safe in every world of the belief, whatever the others do within their public types. Agents learn inside their types, which are built and checked one agent at a time and run without communication. We prove type soundness and team safety, give a synthesis that is sound and complete, build types from guards when worlds are infinite, and show that shields are a special case. All proofs are mechanised in Rocq. On nine benchmarks, no typed learner causes a safety violation, and task performance does not differ significantly from that of two recent multi-agent shielding methods. Where a contract-based method fails at five and ten agents, types for ten agents are built in under a second. In the two continuous benchmarks, Lagrangian learners cause thousands of violations in every training run.

papers.title: Report2Alpha-Bench: Evaluating LLM Agents on End-to-End Quantitative Research
papers.abstract: We evaluate whether LLM agents can independently carry out a several-hour quantitative research project: read a brokerage research report, make a plan, and over 7 rounds of iteration propose hypotheses, write factor code and improve it from backtest feedback, seeing only 2022-2023 market data. Like Terminal-Bench-Science, the task evaluates overall research ability; unlike it, there is no directly checkable unique answer: the model must repeatedly propose hypotheses on very noisy data, revise its understanding from experiments, disentangle multiple factors and design ablations without overfitting in-sample, much like complex real-world decisions with many interacting factors. After the research, a fixed rule using only 2022-2023 results selects a low-correlated factor pool from all candidates the model produced, and scores it on unseen 2024-2025 data after removing common style returns such as size and momentum; the same rule on round-0 candidates alone gives a report baseline that "implements the report without iterating". We run gpt-6.1-sol (reasoning effort xhigh), gpt-6.1-terra (xhigh), muse-spark-1.3 (xhigh) and deepseek-v4.1-flash (max) once on each of 7 reports. Of the 28 runs, 19 factor pools pass the usability threshold; the average score is 48.4 (0-100 scale), against 25.4 for the report baseline and 35.9 for the models' own picks. From similar report baselines (17.0-31.0), the models separate after iteration to 74.7 (gpt-6.1-sol), 56.6 (gpt-6.1-terra), 35.8 (deepseek-v4.1-flash) and 26.2 (muse-spark-1.3); their candidates look equally good in training and diverge only in testing, with the leaders proposing more diverse ideas per round and ending with more effective factors in the pool. Evaluating research agents thus requires scoring on frozen future data after removing styles, and measuring "what the research produced" separately from "what was finally picked".

papers.title: MoHA: Model-Conditioned Harness Adaptation for Long-Video Agents
papers.abstract: Long-video understanding increasingly relies on agentic systems that actively acquire evidence rather than process fixed video representations. Their execution harnesses must coordinate language-level planning with video-level observation and evidence acquisition, yet are typically fixed across model stacks. We therefore introduce MoHA, a framework for model-conditioned harness adaptation that adapts a common initial execution harness to the specific planner and observer models it hosts. MoHA treats the harness itself as a model-conditioned optimization object: under the same task distribution and initialization, different planner-observer stacks can benefit from different executable harnesses. Starting from a common initial harness, MoHA analyzes failed calibration traces to diagnose model-harness mismatches and adapts both planner-side reasoning support, such as overview, memory, and verification, and observer-side capability assignments, including OCR and ASR specialists. After structural adaptation, MoHA separately calibrates observer execution configurations for the hosted model stack. Across three frozen planner stacks, MoHA improves Video-MME Full accuracy by 6.2-27.1 percentage points and Video-Holmes accuracy by 3.1-20.1 points over the fixed initial harness. Cross-model transfer further shows that the adapted harnesses generalize only partially to other models, highlighting the harness as a model-conditioned optimization layer for long-video understanding. Code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: Beyond Sample Hardness: Adaptive Data Selection through Learning Dynamics
papers.abstract: Data selection has emerged as an effective approach to reducing the model training costs. However, most existing methods often rely heavily on sample hardness, which may overlook differences in sample learning dynamics and lead to suboptimal sample selection. In this paper, we propose LeDAS, an end-to-end Learning Dynamics-Aware Selection framework for dynamic data selection, which jointly characterizes sample importance through hardness, learning progress, and deterioration, enabling adaptive sample prioritization throughout training with marginal additional computational overhead. Specifically, we track per-sample loss dynamics using exponential moving averages (EMA) to obtain three complementary signals that capture current learning difficulty, ongoing learning improvements, and potential degradation. To accommodate evolving training dynamics, we introduce Adaptive Metric Fusion, a contextual bandit-based mechanism that dynamically adjusts the relative importance of these signals based on training feedback. Furthermore, a bounded staleness compensation mechanism accounts for historical selection patterns by increasing the selection priority of samples that have not been selected for extended periods. Extensive experiments across diverse vision and language tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of LeDAS. Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, LeDAS consistently achieves superior performance, matching or surpassing full-dataset training at a 50\% selection ratio on ImageNet-1K and in LLM supervised fine-tuning. Moreover, its modular and task-agnostic design enables the integration of complementary selection signals, demonstrating strong robustness to noisy and corrupted datasets.

papers.title: Hierarchical Agentic Mid-Band Agility for Reliable Low-Latency Space-Air-Ground Integrated V2X Networks
papers.abstract: Upper-mid-band spectrum offers bandwidth opportunities for the integrated networks of ground vehicles, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), and low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites to support 6G wide-area vehicle-to-everything (V2X) connectivity. However, V2X services' latency and reliability are sensitive to the mid-band selection due to frequency-dependent propagation and rain attenuation. This paper investigates environment-aware spectrum agility over candidate frequency range 3 (FR3) bands within 7.125-24.25 GHz, jointly with end-to-end (E2E) multi-path traffic splitting and transmit power control. Each data packet is partitioned into non-overlapping subflows over direct and UAV-assisted paths, with failed sky-link subflows selectively retransmitted subject to retransmission and freshness constraints. We formulate latency- and reliability-oriented problems, followed by a unified sequential optimization problem incorporating band-switching costs and average quality-of-service (QoS) violation budgets. To coordinate optimization decisions across heterogeneous timescales, we develop an agentic AI-assisted hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning (AA-HMARL) framework. A high-level agentic supervisor integrates recurrent memory, analytical evaluation of candidate bands, and event-triggered replanning to coordinate slow environmental adaptation with fast channel and retransmission dynamics, while distributed ground vehicles and UAV agents optimize data splitting and power using constrained MAPPO. Simulation results demonstrate an adjustable reliability-latency trade-off. Particularly, AA-HMARL reduces the mean E2E completion latency and the mean number of retransmission rounds among successfully delivered updates by 17.8-25.5% and 57.6-61.5%, respectively, and reduces the mean age of information (AoI) by 12.7-14.6% relative to fixed-band MAPPO across two traffic types.

translation.title: 面向可靠低时延空天地一体化V2X网络的分层智能体式中频段敏捷性
translation.abstract: 上中频段频谱为地面车辆、无人机（UAV）与低轨（LEO）卫星的一体化网络提供带宽机会，以支持6G广域车联网（V2X）连接。然而，由于频率相关的传播特性和雨衰，V2X服务的时延与可靠性对中频段选择十分敏感。本文研究在7.125-24.25 GHz内候选频率范围3（FR3）频段上的环境感知频谱敏捷性，并与端到端（E2E）多路径流量切分和发射功率控制联合优化。每个数据包被划分为互不重叠的子流，经由直连路径和无人机辅助路径传输，失败的天空链路子流在重传与新鲜度约束下被选择性地重传。我们构建了面向时延与可靠性的问题，并进一步形成包含频段切换代价和平均服务质量（QoS）违约预算的统一序贯优化问题。为协调跨异构时间尺度的优化决策，我们提出智能体AI辅助的分层多智能体强化学习（AA-HMARL）框架。高层智能体监督器结合循环记忆、候选频段解析评估和事件触发重规划，协调慢速环境适应与快速信道及重传动态；分布式地面车辆与无人机智能体则使用约束MAPPO优化数据切分与功率。仿真结果表明该框架可实现可调的可靠性-时延权衡。特别是，相对于固定频段MAPPO，AA-HMARL在两类流量下将平均E2E完成时延和成功交付更新的平均重传轮数分别降低17.8-25.5%和57.6-61.5%，并将平均信息年龄（AoI）降低12.7-14.6%。
translation.brief: 针对FR3中频段选择影响V2X时延与可靠性的问题，提出结合频谱敏捷、多路径流量切分与功率控制的AA-HMARL分层多智能体强化学习框架进行联合优化。

papers.title: GeoScaffold: From Latent to Realized Geometry in Collaborative Detection
papers.abstract: Most collaborative 3D detectors fuse bird's-eye-view (BEV) features from connected vehicles and roadside infrastructure to aggregate complementary observations. Although modern communication, alignment, and fusion pipelines encode rich latent geometry in the fused BEV features, the standard readout pipeline inherited from single-agent detectors, i.e., anchor scoring, box decoding, and non-maximum suppression (NMS), does not fully exploit these geometric cues. We empirically identify and quantify this gap on UrbanIng-V2X. Collaboration improves localization at about two-thirds of positive anchors, yet when NMS resolves two overlapping collaborative boxes of one object, it keeps the better-localized box less than half of the time. A key cause is a supervision mismatch: classification scores are trained only for foreground-background discrimination, so nothing in training requires them to rank boxes by localization quality. To address this limitation, we introduce GeoScaffold, a lightweight training-only auxiliary objective. It predicts a foreground mask at each positive anchor, i.e., the cells of a grid over the anchor that lie inside the ground-truth box, to supply the dense spatial supervision that the seven-dimensional box code leaves implicit. Its loss, added to the detection loss, updates the encoder and fusion modules through the fused BEV and trains the detector toward a better-localized box at every positive anchor, including the top-scored one. The auxiliary head is removed at inference, preserving the original detector architecture, communication logic, and inference cost. GeoScaffold raises AP@0.5 and AP@0.7 by 0.98 and 0.55 points on average across all 11 fusion methods on the UrbanIng-V2X validation split, with gains extending to most methods on an unseen intersection and to all ten methods that produce detections on V2V4Real.

translation.title: GeoScaffold：协同检测中从潜在几何到实现几何
translation.abstract: 大多数协同3D检测器融合来自联网车辆与路侧基础设施的鸟瞰图（BEV）特征，以聚合互补观测。尽管现代通信、对齐与融合流水线在融合BEV特征中编码了丰富的潜在几何信息，但从单智能体检测器继承的标准读出流水线，即锚框打分、框解码与非极大值抑制（NMS），并未充分利用这些几何线索。我们在UrbanIng-V2X上实证识别并量化了这一差距：协同在约三分之二的正锚框上改善了定位，但当NMS在属于同一目标的两个重叠协同框之间做取舍时，保留定位更优框的比例不到一半。一个关键原因是监督不匹配：分类分数仅被训练用于前景-背景判别，训练中没有任何约束要求其按定位质量对框排序。为解决这一局限，我们提出GeoScaffold，一种仅用于训练的轻量辅助目标。它在每个正锚框处预测前景掩码，即锚框网格中位于真值框内的单元，为七维框编码所隐含的空间信息提供稠密监督。其损失加到检测损失上，通过融合BEV更新编码器与融合模块，训练检测器在每个正锚框（包括得分最高的框）上输出定位更优的框。辅助头在推理时被移除，保持原始检测器架构、通信逻辑与推理成本不变。GeoScaffold在UrbanIng-V2X验证集上使全部11种融合方法的AP@0.5和AP@0.7平均分别提升0.98和0.55点，增益在未见过的路口场景扩展到大多数方法，并在V2V4Real上扩展到所有产生检测结果的十种方法。
translation.brief: 针对协同3D检测中NMS常丢弃定位更优框的问题，提出仅训练阶段的辅助前景掩码监督GeoScaffold，使分类分数能反映定位质量。

papers.title: FOREST: Coordinating Tree-based HBF, RRAM, and HBM for Efficient Speculative LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by combining lightweight drafting with parallel target-model verification. However, its stages impose distinct resource demands: target verification requires high-throughput access to large weight sets, sequential drafting executes a compact model under tight latency constraints, and long-context attention processes growing key-value (KV) caches. Conventional GPU-centric SD systems serve these workloads through shared HBM-centric memory and general-purpose compute, creating mismatches in capacity, bandwidth, and computation. These mismatches constrain deployable model-context configurations and limit the efficiency of bandwidth-bound and latency-sensitive operations. We propose FOREST, a heterogeneous memory-centric architecture coordinating HBF, 3D-stacked RRAM, and HBM memory-compute trees for efficient SD. It features: (1) compute-aligned 3D RRAM, combining ultra-wide, low-frequency reads with clock-decoupled interfaces and overlapped SRAM-DCIM weight refills for latency-sensitive drafting; (2) cross-tree numerical co-design, moving block-scaled Q/K/V preprocessing to HBF and RRAM root plates and enabling block-floating-point (BFP) attention with pipelined softmax reduction in the HBM tree; and (3) HBF-aware SD design-space exploration, revealing how bandwidth-compute provisioning and model scale determine performance, energy, and cost trade-offs. Evaluated across six SD configurations spanning 32B-405B target models, FOREST achieves up to 5.5x end-to-end speedup, 11.46x higher decode throughput, and 16.5x higher decode energy efficiency over NVIDIA A800 GPU-based SD baselines. Under a modeled total cost of ownership, FOREST delivers up to 6.73x higher token-generation cost efficiency.

translation.title: FOREST：协同基于树的HBF、RRAM与HBM以实现高效投机式LLM推理
translation.abstract: 投机解码（SD）通过轻量草稿与并行目标模型验证相结合来加速大语言模型（LLM）推理。然而其各阶段资源需求差异显著：目标验证需要对大权重集的高吞吐访问，顺序草稿生成在严格时延约束下执行紧凑模型，而长上下文注意力需处理不断增长的键值（KV）缓存。传统以GPU为中心的SD系统通过共享的以HBM为中心的内存和通用计算来服务这些负载，造成容量、带宽与计算上的错配。这些错配限制了可部署的模型-上下文配置，并降低了带宽受限和时延敏感操作的效率。我们提出FOREST，一种协调HBF、3D堆叠RRAM与HBM内存-计算树的异构以内存为中心架构，用于高效SD。其特点包括：(1) 计算对齐的3D RRAM，结合超宽低频读取、时钟解耦接口与重叠的SRAM-DCIM权重填充，服务时延敏感的草稿生成；(2) 跨树数值协同设计，将块缩放的Q/K/V预处理移至HBF与RRAM根板，并在HBM树中实现带流水线softmax归约的块浮点（BFP）注意力；(3) HBF感知的SD设计空间探索，揭示带宽-计算供给与模型规模如何决定性能、能耗与成本权衡。在覆盖32B-405B目标模型的六种SD配置上评估，FOREST相对基于NVIDIA A800 GPU的SD基线实现最高5.5倍端到端加速、11.46倍更高解码吞吐和16.5倍更高解码能效。在建模的总拥有成本下，FOREST的token生成成本效率最高提升6.73倍。
translation.brief: 针对投机解码各阶段资源需求错配的问题，提出FOREST异构内存中心架构，协同HBF、3D RRAM与HBM树并配合数值协同设计以高效支持LLM推理。

papers.title: MetaRigor: From Agentic Automation to Verifiable End-to-End Meta-Analysis Through Scientific Decision Boundaries
papers.abstract: Automated meta-analysis requires not only accurate numerical extraction but also the consistent preservation of result identity across stages, including the associated study, comparison, population, outcome, time point, and analysis conditions. We present MetaRigor, an LLM workflow framework for verifiable end-to-end evidence synthesis. MetaRigor organizes study results as Study x Target units and operationalizes scientific decision boundaries at the task level through Task Contracts, programmatic rules, and source binding. The model performs semantic interpretation that depends on study context, whereas programs execute formalizable rules, computations, validation, and source verification. We conducted controlled evaluations across five stages: evidence acquisition, data extraction, risk of bias assessment, certainty of evidence assessment, and manuscript generation. MetaRigor achieved an F1 score of 86.29% for complete result delivery and 80.20% agreement for domain-level certainty of evidence judgments. Generated manuscripts received scores of 86.00 under human evaluation, exceeding all three baselines. A seven-case downstream end-to-end evaluation further yielded an aggregate F1 score of 77.01%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 9.78 percentage points. Cross-system tracing of archived outputs from three systems further showed that local mismatches or omissions in result identity could alter statistical inputs and the objects subjected to risk of bias assessment, with these errors subsequently propagating into the final report. Ablation experiments showed that task constraints and programmatic rules played distinct roles across different stages. These findings indicate that, in LLM-driven evidence synthesis workflows, consistently maintaining explicit result identity, decision boundaries, and provenance relationships is critical to improving end-to-end verifiability.

translation.title: MetaRigor：通过科学决策边界实现从智能体自动化到可验证的端到端元分析
translation.abstract: 自动化元分析不仅需要准确的数值抽取，还需要在各阶段一致地保持结果身份，包括相关研究、比较、人群、结局、时间点和分析条件。我们提出MetaRigor，一个用于可验证端到端证据合成的LLM工作流框架。MetaRigor将研究结果组织为Study x Target单元，并通过任务契约（Task Contracts）、程序化规则和来源绑定在任务层面落实科学决策边界。模型执行依赖研究上下文的语义解释，而程序执行可形式化的规则、计算、验证与来源核验。我们在五个阶段进行了受控评估：证据获取、数据抽取、偏倚风险评估、证据确定性评估和文稿生成。MetaRigor在完整结果交付上达到86.29%的F1分数，在领域级证据确定性判断上达到80.20%的一致性。生成的文稿在人工评估中获得86.00分，超过全部三个基线。七案例的下游端到端评估进一步取得77.01%的总体F1分数，超过最强基线9.78个百分点。对三个系统存档输出的跨系统追踪进一步表明，结果身份的局部不匹配或遗漏可能改变统计输入和偏倚风险评估对象，且这些错误会随后传播到最终报告。消融实验显示任务约束与程序化规则在不同阶段发挥不同作用。这些发现表明，在LLM驱动的证据合成工作流中，一致地维护显式结果身份、决策边界与溯源关系对提升端到端可验证性至关重要。
translation.brief: 针对自动化元分析中结果身份跨阶段不一致的问题，提出MetaRigor框架，用任务契约、程序化规则与来源绑定划分LLM语义解释与程序化执行的决策边界，实现可验证的端到端证据合成。

papers.title: Decision Models for Multilingual Emotion Classification: A Comparative Study Against LLMs and Encoders
papers.abstract: Decision models receive a question with a closed list of answers and return a probability for each answer instead of free text. They promise low latency and robustness to prompt wording, but no study has compared several of them with fine-tuned encoders across languages. We ask whether systems used without training on labelled data (zero-shot) can replace fine-tuning, and what the decision format adds over a general-purpose large language model (LLM). We compare three decision models (Jev, OpenAI Decisions, Strands Decider 2B) and two LLMs (GPT-6 Luna, Qwen3.5-2B), given Italian instructions, with two fine-tuned multilingual encoders (tabularisai, XLM-EMO) on four emotions (joy, sadness, anger, fear) in 10 social-media datasets in five languages, with paired difference and equivalence tests. The three best zero-shot systems (two decision models and one LLM) score on average about one macro-F1 point below an encoder fine-tuned on the target dataset; our test sets cannot exclude a gap of 4-5 points, and on single datasets either approach wins by up to 22 points. They beat encoders fine-tuned on another dataset by 8-15 points, though against XLM-EMO this may not extend to new datasets, and instructions in each text's language change their results by under 1 point. Exploratorily, they beat the strongest public emotion model used as is by about 6 points. OpenAI's decision endpoint matches GPT-6 Luna, the LLM it runs on, at a fifth of its median latency, and a 2-billion-parameter decision model beats a same-size general LLM by 10 points, owing to its training, not the decision format. The best zero-shot systems, the LLM included, have an SD of about 1 point across prompts. Without labelled data they are a strong default, and decision models add lower latency and, unlike generative LLM use, per-option probabilities. Fine-tuning won by a wide margin only on the largest dataset, GoEmotions.

translation.title: 多语言情感分类的决策模型：与LLM及编码器的对比研究
translation.abstract: 决策模型接收一个问题及一个封闭答案列表，并为每个答案返回概率而非自由文本。它们承诺低时延和对提示措辞的鲁棒性，但尚无研究将多种此类模型与微调编码器进行跨语言比较。我们探究未经标注数据训练（零样本）使用的系统能否替代微调，以及决策格式相比通用大语言模型（LLM）有何增益。我们在五种语言的10个社交媒体数据集上，对四种情感（喜悦、悲伤、愤怒、恐惧），以意大利语指令比较三个决策模型（Jev、OpenAI Decisions、Strands Decider 2B）和两个LLM（GPT-6 Luna、Qwen3.5-2B）与两个微调多语言编码器（tabularisai、XLM-EMO），采用配对差异与等价性检验。三个最佳零样本系统（两个决策模型和一个LLM）平均比在目标数据集上微调的编码器低约1个macro-F1点；我们的测试集无法排除4-5点的差距，且在单个数据集上任一方法最多可胜出22点。它们比在另一数据集上微调的编码器高8-15点，但相对XLM-EMO这一优势可能无法推广到新数据集；使用与文本语言一致的指令对其结果影响不足1点。探索性地，它们比直接使用的最强公开情感模型高约6点。OpenAI的决策端点在五分之一的中位时延下与运行其上的GPT-6 Luna表现相当，而一个20亿参数的决策模型比同规模通用LLM高10点，这归功于其训练而非决策格式。包括LLM在内的最佳零样本系统在不同提示下的标准差约为1点。在没有标注数据时它们是强有力的默认选择，而决策模型额外提供更低时延，且不同于生成式LLM使用，可给出每个选项的概率。微调仅在最大数据集GoEmotions上大幅胜出。
translation.brief: 针对零样本情感分类系统能否替代微调编码器的问题，在五种语言十个数据集上系统对比决策模型、LLM与微调编码器的性能、时延与鲁棒性。

papers.title: A Cognitive Agentic AI Framework for Interactive Process Analysis and Optimization
papers.abstract: Complex multivariable process analysis and optimization require coordinated access to simulation, structured data, machine learning (ML), optimization, and scientific literature, often across disconnected software tools. We present a Cognitive Agentic AI Framework (CAAF) that enables interactive, iterative process investigation through natural-language prompts within an established flowsheet. Following harness-engineering principles, CAAF assigns task interpretation, planning, knowledge synthesis, and context management to a large language model while delegating numerical calculations to specialized tools. Dedicated providers connect databases, scientific-document retrieval, ML-assisted Bayesian optimization (BO), and COCO process simulation. The framework is demonstrated on methyl acetate production. Guided by successive prompts, an engineer explored multivariable relationships, conducted 4,000 BO iterations to maximize carbon conversion yield (C-Yield) and minimize specific energy cost (C-SEC), refined operating bounds, and verified selected candidates through process simulation. Re-simulation of 16 candidates within the restricted domain showed close agreement with ML predictions, with a mean absolute C-Yield error of 0.0085 (0.85 percentage points). The highest BO-derived C-Yield, verified by COCO, was 0.921 versus approximately 0.81 in the initial dataset, an improvement of about 11 percentage points. CAAF also detects and reports non-converged simulations, excludes invalid outputs, and continues subsequent evaluations. The results demonstrate how human-guided agentic coordination can combine engineering tools for iterative analysis and optimization with rigorous simulation-based verification under a fixed process topology.

papers.title: Do Alice and Bob Dream of the Oracle? Wishful Cryptanalysis
papers.abstract: For two millennia, offense and defense have forged cryptographic security boundaries. Tools automated calculation and search, while humans drove discovery. Foundation models now mark a shift from automated computation to intelligent scientific discovery. Because cryptanalysis rests on exact mathematical definitions and immediately executable truth, it offers a proving ground for autonomous intelligence to move past security reliant on scarce human attention and explore structures beyond human working memory. Unguided models stall between two opposite traps: authority hallucination, where they surrender whenever prior literature declares a route blocked, and reasoning hallucination, where they produce subtle, unverifiable flaws. Closed platforms and generic agent loops further impede sustained open inquiry. We introduce wishful cryptanalysis, a harness-agnostic methodology that pairs constructive optimism against entrenched assumptions with blinded, zero-import verification against error. Agents first compress reduced-scale theory within provisioned compute so live witnesses certify their mathematics automatically. They then co-adapt primitive, algorithm, and hardware, and climb parameter ladders toward high-round theory. Applied across frontier open-weight and proprietary models with minimal human intervention beyond targets and compute, this paradigm yielded novel attack techniques and thirteen verifiable practical results across Keccak (SHA-3) and AES. These include breaking a fifteen-year-open public challenge and closing longstanding practical gaps, released alongside an early-preview open-source workbench (agent-framework). Extending Kerckhoffs's principle into the AI era, we envision an Open Oracle, an open and auditable public infrastructure that frees cryptographers to legislate security goals, challenge assumptions, distill theory, and co-design resilient standards.

papers.title: AutoOntologyBench: A Task-Grounded Benchmark for Agentic Knowledge Engineering
papers.abstract: Foundation-model agents are increasingly extending beyond software engineering (SWE) into autonomous scientific research, where acquiring and integrating domain knowledge remains a critical challenge. Recent industrial advances have increasingly adopted knowledge graphs and ontology-based semantic layers to organize heterogeneous knowledge into reusable representations. We ask: Can autonomous agents construct ontologies that help them solve real tasks, and do they offer measurable benefits over alternative knowledge representations? Existing benchmarks evaluate ontology correctness or agent task success in isolation, leaving the value of autonomously acquired knowledge unresolved. We therefore introduce AutoOntologyBench, a task-grounded benchmark comprising 19,947 audited tasks grounded in 18 real-world knowledge sources across 7 domains, with source-native verification. Spanning Application, Repair, Organization, and Construction, AutoOntologyBench compares nine frontier-model agents under matched knowledge representations. Layered on retrieval, agent-built ontologies add 6.1 points of task success, yet trail an expert-derived reference by 13.0, identifying autonomous knowledge acquisition as the bottleneck to scalable scientific research. Code and resources are available at this https URL.

papers.title: Can Vision-Language Models Synthesize Executable Game-Playing Programs?
papers.abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have endowed multimodal agents with increasingly strong visual perception and long-horizon reasoning capabilities, making VLM-based autonomous game playing feasible. Existing game benchmarks primarily evaluate whether an agent can select appropriate actions from the current visual state across different scenarios and games. However, most of them adopt a step-by-step interaction paradigm where the current visual observation is sent to the agent before each action. In practical deployment, this paradigm introduces two fundamental limitations: the game loop must wait for model inference, making real-time interaction impractical, and repeated VLM calls incur substantial cost. Therefore, we propose PlayScriptBench, a script-based game benchmark that evaluates whether VLMs can synthesize an executable game-playing program from game states. This setting jointly evaluates visual grounding, understanding of game dynamics, long-horizon strategic reasoning, and executable program synthesis, providing a more comprehensive assessment of game-playing agents. To support more tractable evaluation for current general-purpose VLMs, we further introduce a four-stage pipeline --- Explore, Perception, API Construction, and Strategy Composition --- that decomposes controller synthesis into game exploration, state perception, interface construction, and strategic control, enabling agents to progressively construct an executable program. Experiments on 16 games spanning 4 genres show that even strong VLMs struggle on our benchmark, revealing a substantial gap between passive visual game understanding and executable closed-loop game control. These results establish script-based controller synthesis as a complementary direction for benchmarking VLM-based game-playing agents.

papers.title: Shared Understanding in Human-AI Teams: Coordination Continuity in Evolving Work
papers.abstract: People are increasingly working with AI agents as part of extended, asynchronous workflows. In these settings, shared access to information does not guarantee a shared basis for action: goals, plans, and roles may persist while their current significance changes. We introduce coordination continuity, the extent to which collaborators sustain a workable basis for interdependent action as work progresses. Drawing on research on collaborative work, along with two qualitative team studies and a reflexive case from our own repository-based environment, we present a framework of three elements: durable representations of collaborative work; relative coordination properties that support interpretation of representations in the moment; and interaction mechanisms through which the status of representations can be understood and altered. We use a build-act-drift-rebuild heuristic and the notion of consequential moments to characterise when rebuilding may be needed. We draw eight design implications for collaborative AI infrastructure.
